translations.translation: allAha ke nAma se, jo atyanta kRpAzIla tathA dayAvAn hai|
saba prazaMsAyeM allAha[1] ke lie haiM, jo sAre saMsAroM kA pAlanahAra[2] hai|
jo atyaMta kRpAzIla aura dayAvAn[1] hai|
jo pratikAra[1] (badale) ke dina kA mAlika hai|
(he allAha!) hama kevala tujhI ko pUjate haiM aura kevala tujhI se sahAyatA mAMgate[1] haiM|
hameM supatha (sIdhA mArga) dikhA|
unakA mArga, jinapara tUne puraskAra kiyA|[1] unakA nahIM, jinapara terA prakopa[2] huA aura na hI unakA, jo kupatha (gumarAha) ho gaye|
alifa, lAma, mIma|
ye pustaka hai, jisameM koI saMzaya (saMdeha) nahIM, unheM sIdhI Dagara dikhAne ke lie hai, jo (allAha se) Darate haiM|
jo g2aiba (parokSa)[1] para ImAna (vizvAsa) rakhate haiM tathA namAz2a kI sthApanA karate haiM aura jo kucha hamane unheM diyA hai, usameM se dAna karate haiM|
tathA jo Apa (he nabI!) para utArI gayI (pustaka qurAna) tathA Apase pUrva utArI gayI (pustakoM)[1] para ImAna rakhate haiM tathA Aqhirata (paraloka)[2] para bhI vizvAsa rakhate haiM|
vahI apane pAlanahAra kI batAI sIdhI Dagara para haiM tathA vahI saphala hoMge|
vAstava[1] meM, jo kAfira (vizvAsahIna) ho gaye, (he nabI!) unheM Apa sAvadhAna kareM yA na kareM, ve ImAna nahIM lAyeMge|
allAha ne unake diloM tathA kAnoM para muhara lagA dI hai aura unakI AMkhoM para parde par3e haiM tathA unhIM ke lie ghora yAtanA hai|
aura[1] kucha loga kahate haiM ki hama allAha tathA Aqhirata (paraloka) para ImAna le Aye, jabaki ve ImAna nahIM rakhate|
ve allAha tathA jo ImAna lAye, unheM dhokhA dete haiM| jabaki ve svayaM apane-Apa ko dhokhA dete haiM, parantu ve ise samajhate nahIM|
unake diloM meM roga (duvidhA) hai, jise allAha ne aura adhika kara diyA aura unake lie jhUTha bolane ke kAraNa dukhadAyI yAtanA hai|
aura jaba unase kahA jAtA hai ki dharatI meM upadrava na karo, to kahate haiM ki hama to kevala sudhAra karane vAle haiM|
sAvadhAna! vahI loga upadravI haiM, parantu unheM isakA bodha nahIM|

aura[1] jaba unase kahA jAtA hai ki jaise aura loga ImAna lAye, tumabhI ImAna lAo, to kahate haiM ki kyA mUrkhoM ke samAna hamabhI vizvAsa kara leM? sAvadhAna! vahI mUrkha haiM, parantu ve jAnate nahIM|

tathA jaba ve ImAna vAloM se milate haiM, to kahate haiM ki hama ImAna lAye aura jaba akele meM apane zaitAnoM (pramukhoM) ke sAtha hote haiM, to kahate haiM ki hama tumhAre sAtha haiM| hama to mAtra parihAsa kara rahe haiM|
allAha unase parihAsa kara rahA hai tathA unheM, unake kukarmoM meM bahakane kA avasara de rahA hai|
ye ve loga haiM, jinhoMne sIdhI Dagara (supatha) ke badale gumarAhI (kupatha) kharIda lI| parantu unake vyApAra meM lAbha nahIM huA aura na unhoMne sIdhI Dagara pAyI|

unakI[1] dazA unake jaisI hai, jinhoMne agni sulagAyI aura jaba unake Asa-pAsa ujAlA ho gayA, to allAha ne unakA ujAlA chIna liyA tathA unheM aise andheroM meM chor3a diyA, jinameM unheM kucha dikhAI nahIM detA|
ve gU~ge, bahare, aMdhe haiM| ataH aba ve lauTane vAle nahIM|

athavA[1] (unakI dazA) AkAza kI varSA ke samAna hai, jisameM aMdhere aura kar3aka tathA viddhuta ho, ve kar3aka ke kAraNa, mRtyu ke bhaya se, apane kAnoM meM uMgaliyA~ DAla lete haiM aura allAha, kAfiroM ko apane niyaMtraNa meM lie hue hai|

viddhuta unakI A~khoM ko ucaka lene ke samIpa ho jAtI hai| jaba unake lie camakatI hai, to usake ujAle meM calane lagate haiM aura jaba aMdherA ho jAtA hai, to khar3e ho jAte haiM aura yadi allAha cAhe, to unake kAnoM ko baharA aura unakI A~khoM kA aMdhA kara de| nizcaya allAha jo cAhe, kara sakatA hai|
he logo! kevala apane usa pAlanahAra kI ibAdata (vaMdanA) karo, jisane tumheM tathA tumase pahale vAle logoM ko paidA kiyA, isI meM tumhArA bacAva[1] hai|

jisane dharatI ko tumhAre lie bichaunA tathA gagana ko chata banAyA aura AkAza se jala barasAyA, phira usase tumhAre lie pratyeka prakAra ke khAdya padArtha upajAye, ataH, jAnate hue[1] bhI usake sAjhI na banAo|

aura yadi tumheM usameM kucha saMdeha ho, jo (athavA qurAna) hamane apane bhakta para utArA hai, to usake samAna koI sUraha le Ao? aura apane samarthakoM ko bhI, jo allAha ke sivA hoM, bulA lo, yadi tuma sacce[1] ho|
aura yadi ye na kara sako tathA kara bhI nahIM sakoge, to usa agni (naraka) se baco, jisakA IMdhana mAnava tathA patthara hoMge|

(he nabI!) una logoM ko zubha sUcanA do, jo ImAna lAye tathA sadAcAra kiye ki unake lie aise svarga haiM, jinameM nahareM baha rahI hoMgI| jaba unakA koI bhI phala unheM diyA jAyegA, to kaheMgeH ye to vahI hai, jo isase pahale hameM diyA gayA aura unheM samarUpa phala diye jAyeMge tathA unake lie unameM nirmala patniyA~ hoMgI aura ve unameM sadAvAsI hoMge|

allAha,[1] macchara athavA usase tuccha cIz2a se upamA (misAla) dene se nahIM lajjAtA| jo ImAna lAye, ve jAnate haiM ki ye unake pAlanahAra kI ora se ucita hai aura jo kAfira (vizvAsahIna) ho gaye, ve kahate haiM ki allAha ne isase upamA dekara kyA nizcaya kiyA hai? allAha isase bahutoM ko gumarAha (kupatha) karatA hai aura bahutoM ko mArgadarzana detA hai tathA jo avajJAkArI haiM, unhIM ko kupatha karatA hai|
jo allAha se pakkA vacana karane ke bAda use bhaMga kara dete haiM tathA jise allAha ne jor3ane kA Adeza diyA, use tor3ate haiM aura dharatI meM upadrava karate haiM, vahI loga kSati meM par3eMge|

tuma allAha kA inkAra kaise karate ho? jabaki pahale tuma nirjIva the, phira usane tumheM jIvana diyA, phira tumheM mauta degA, phira tumheM (paraloka meM) jIvana pradAna karegA, phira tuma usI kI ora lauTAye[1] jAoge!
vahI hai, jisane dharatI meM jo bhI hai, sabako tumhAre lie utpanna kiyA, phira AkAza kI ora AkRSTa huA, to barAbara sAta AkAza banA diye aura vaha pratyeka cIz2a kA jAnakAra hai|

aura (he nabI! yAda karo) jaba Apake pAlanahAra ne fariztoM se kahA ki maiM dharatI meM eka qhalIfA[1] banAne jA rahA hU~| ve boleH kyA tU usameM use banAyega, jo usameM upadrava karegA tathA rakta bahAyegA? jabaki hama terI prazaMsA ke sAtha tere guNa aura pavitratA kA gAna karate haiM! (allAha) ne kahAH jo maiM jAnatA hU~, vaha tuma nahIM jAnate|
aura usane Adama[1] ko sabhI nAma sikhA diye, phira unheM fariztoM ke samakSa prastuta kiyA aura kahAH mujhe inake nAma batAo, yadi tuma sacce ho!
sabane kahAH tU pavitra hai| hama to utanA hI jAnate haiM, jitanA tUne hameM sikhAyA hai| vAstava meM, tU ati jJAnI tatvajJa[1] hai|

(allAha ne) kahAH he Adama! inheM inake nAma batAo aura Adama ne jaba unake nAma batA diye, to (allAha ne) kahAHkyA maiMne tumase nahIM kahA thA ki maiM AkAzoM tathA dharatI kI kSipta bAtoM ko jAnatA hU~ tathA tuma jo bolate aura mana meM rakhate ho, saba jAnatA hU~?
aura jaba hamane fariztoM se kahAH Adama ko sajdA karo, to iblIsa ke sivA sabane sajdA kiyA, usane inkAra tathA abhimAna kiyA aura kAfiroM meM se ho gayA|
aura hamane kahAH he Adama! tuma aura tumhArI patnI svarga meM raho tathA isameM se jisa sthAna se cAho, manamAnI khAo aura isa vRkSa ke samIpa na jAnA, anyathA atyAcAriyoM meM se ho jAoge|

to zaitAna ne donoM ko usase bhaTakA diyA aura jisa (sukha) meM the, usase unheM nikAla diyA aura hamane kahAH tuma saba usase utaro, tuma eka-dUsare ke zatru ho aura tumhAre lie dharatI meM rahanA tathA eka nizcita avadhi[1] taka upabhogya hai|
phira Adama ne apane pAlanahAra se kucha zabda sIkhe, to usane use kSamA kara diyA| vaha bar3A kSamI dayAvAn[1] hai|
hamane kahAH isase saba utaro, phira yadi tumhAre pAsa merA mArgadarzana Aye, to jo mere mArgadarzana kA anusaraNa kareMge, unake lie koI Dara nahIM hogA aura na ve udAsIna hoMge|
tathA jo asvIkAra kareMge aura hamArI AyatoM ko mithyA kaheMge, to vahI nArakI haiM aura vahI usameM sadAvAsI hoMge|
he banI isrAIla![1] mere usa puraskAra ko yAda karo, jo maiMne tumapara kiyA tathA mujhase kiyA gayA vacana pUrA karo, maiM tumheM apanA diyA vacana pUrA karU~gA tathA mujhI se Daro|[2]

tathA usa (qurAna) para ImAna lAo, jo maiMne utArA hai, vaha usakA pramANakArI hai, jo tumhAre pAsa[1] hai aura tuma, sabase pahale isake nivartI na bana jAo tathA merI AyatoM ko tanika mUlya para na beco aura kevala mujhI se Daro|
tathA satya ko asatya se na milAo aura na satya ko jAnate hue chupAo|[1]
tathA namAz2a kI sthApanA karo aura z2akAta do tathA jhukane vAloM ke sAtha jhuko (rukU karo)
kyA tuma, logoM ko sadAcAra kA Adeza dete ho aura apane-Apako bhUla jAte ho? jabaki tuma pustaka (taurAta) kA adhyayana karate ho! kyA tuma samajha nahIM rakhate?[1]
tathA dhairya aura namAz2a kA sahArA lo, nizcaya namAz2a bhArI hai, parantu vinItoM para (bhArI nahIM)|[1]
jo samajhate haiM ki unheM apane pAlanahAra se milanA hai aura unheM phira usI kI ora (apane karmoM kA phala bhogane ke lie) jAnA hai|
he banI isrAIla! mere usa puraskAra ko yAda karo, jo maiMne tumapara kiyA aura ye ki tumheM saMsAra vAsiyoM para pradhAnatA dI thI|
tathA usa dina se Daro, jisa dina koI kisI ke kucha kAma nahIM AyegA aura na usakI koI anuzaMsA (sifAriza) mAnI jAyegI aura na usase koI arthadaNDa liyA jAyegA aura na unheM koI sahAyatA mila sakegI|

tathA (vaha samaya yAda karo) jaba hamane tumheM firaauniyoM[1] se mukti dilAI| ve tumheM kar3I yAtanA de rahe the; ve tumhAre putroM ko vadha kara rahe the tathA tumhArI nAriyoM ko jIvita rahane dete the| isameM tumhAre pAlanahAra kI ora se kar3I parIkSA thI|
tathA (yAda karo) jaba hamane tumhAre lie sAgara ko phAr3a diyA, phira tumheM bacA liyA aura tumhAre dekhate-dekhate firaauniyoM ko Dubo diyA|
tathA (yAda karo) jaba hamane mUsA ko (taurAta pradAna karane ke lie) cAlIsa rAtri kA vacana diyA, phira unake pIche tumane bachar3e ko (pUjya) banA liyA aura tuma atyAcArI the|
phira hamane isake pazcAt tumheM kSamA kara diyA, tAki tuma kRtajJa bano|
tathA (yAda karo) jaba hamane mUsA ko pustaka (taurAta) tathA furqAna[1] pradAna kiyA, tAki tuma sIdhI Dagara pA sako|

tathA (yAda karo) jaba mUsA ne apanI jAti se kahAH tumane bachar3e ko pUjya banAkara apane Upara atyAcAra kiyA hai, ataH tuma apane utpattikAra ke Age kSamA yAcanA karo, vo ye ki Apasa meM eka-dUsare[1] ko vadha karo| isI meM tumhAre utpattikAra ke samIpa tumhArI bhalAI hai| phira usane tumhArI taubA svIkAra kara lI| vAstava meM, vaha bar3A kSamAzIla, dayAvAn hai|

tathA (yAda karo) jaba tumane mUsA se kahAH hama tumhArA vizvAsa nahIM kareMge, jaba taka hama allAha ko A~khoM se dekha nahIM leMge, phira tumhAre dekhate-dekhate tumheM kar3aka ne dhara liyA (jisase saba nirjIva ho kara gira gaye)|
phira (nirjIva hone ke pazcAt) hamane tumheM jIvita kara diyA, tAki tuma hamArA upakAra mAno|

aura hamane tumapara bAdaloM kI chA~va[1] kI tathA tumapara 'manna'[2] aura 'salavA' utArA, to una svaccha cIz2oM meM se, jo hamane tumheM pradAna kI haiM, khAo aura unhoMne hamapara atyAcAra nahIM kiyA, parantu ve svayaM apane Upara hI atyAcAra kara rahe the|

aura (yAda karo) jaba hamane kahA ki isa bastI[1] meM praveza karo, phira isameM se jahA~ se cAho, manamAnI khAo aura usake dvAra meM sajdA karate (sira jhukAye) hue praveza karo aura kSamA-kSamA kahate jAo, hama tumhAre pApoM ko kSamA kara deMge tathA sukarmiyoM ko adhika pradAna kareMge|
phira ina atyAcAriyoM ne jo bAta inase kahI gayI thI, use dUsarI bAta se badala diyA| to hamane ina atyAcAriyoM para AkAza se inakI avajJA ke kAraNa prakopa utAra diyA|

tathA (yAda karo) jaba mUsA ne apanI jAti ke lie jala kI prArthanA kI, to hamane kahAH apanI lAThI patthara para mAro| to usase bAraha[1] sote phUTa par3e aura pratyeka parivAra ne apane pIne ke sthAna ko pahacAna liyA| allAha kA diyA khAo aura pio aura dharatI meM upadrava karate na phiro|

tathA (yAda karo) jaba tumane kahAH he mUsA! hama eka prakAra kA khAnA sahana nahIM kareMge| tuma apane pAlanahAra se prArthanA karo ki hamAre lie dharatI kI upaja; sAga, kakar3I, lahasuna, pyAz2a, dAla Adi nikAle| (mUsA ne) kahAH kyA tuma uttama ke badale tuccha mAMgate ho? to kisI nagara meM utara par3o, jo tumane mAMgA hai, vahA~ vaha milegA! aura unapara apamAna tathA daridratA thopa dI gayI aura ve allAha ke prakopa ke sAtha phire| ye isalie ki ve allAha kI AyatoM ke sAtha kufra kara rahe the aura nabiyoM kI akAraNa hatyA kara rahe the| ye isalie ki unhoMne avajJA kI tathA (dharma kI) sImA kA ullaMghana kiyA|

vastutaH, jo ImAna lAye tathA jo yahUdI hue aura nasArA (IsAI) tathA sAbI, jo bhI allAha tathA antima dina (pralaya) para ImAna lAyegA aura satkarma karegA, unakA pratiphala unake pAlanahAra ke pAsa hai aura unheM koI Dara nahIM hogA aura na hI ve udAsIna hoMge|[1]

aura (yAda karo) jaba hamane tUra (parvata) ko tumhAre Upara karake tumase vacana liyA ki jo hamane tumheM diyA hai, use dRr3hatA se pakar3a lo aura usameM jo (Adeza-nirdeza) haiM, unheM yAda rakho; tAki tuma yAtanA se baca sako|
phira usake bAda tuma mukara gaye, to yadi tumapara allAha kI anugraha aura dayA na hotI, to tuma kSatigrastoM meM ho jAte|
aura tuma unheM jAnate hI ho, jinhoMne zanivAra ke bAre meM (dharma kI) sImA kA ullaMghana kiyA, to hamane kahA ki tuma tiraskRta baMdara[1] ho jAo|
phira hamane use, usa samaya ke tathA bAda ke logoM ke lie cetAvanI aura allAha se Darane vAloM ke lie zikSA banA diyA|

tathA (yAda karo) jaba mUsA ne apanI jAti se kahAH allAha tumheM eka gAya vadha karane kA Adeza detA hai| unhoMne kahAH kyA tuma hamase upahAsa kara rahe ho? (mUsA ne) kahAH maiM allAha kI zaraNa mA~gatA hU~ ki mUrkhoM meM se ho jAU~|

vaha bole ki apane pAlanahAra se hamAre lie nivedana karo ki hameM batA de ki vaha gAya kaisI ho? (mUsA ne) kahAH vaha (arthAtaHallAha) kahatA hai ki vaha na bUr3hI ho aura na bachiyA ho, isake bIca Ayu kI ho| ataH jo Adeza tumheM diyA jA rahA hai, use pUrA karo|
ve bole ki apane pAlanahAra se hamAre lie nivedana karo ki hameM usakA raMga batA de| (mUsA ne) kahAH vaha kahatA hai ki pIle gahare raMga kI gAya ho, jo dekhane vAloM ko prasanna kara de|

ve bole ki apane pAlanahAra se hamAre lie nivedana karo ki hameM batAye ki vaha kisa prakAra kI ho? vAstava meM, hama gAya ke bAre meM duvidhA meM par3a gaye haiM aura yadi allAha ne cAhA to hama (usa gAya kA) patA lagA leMge|

mUsA boleH vaha kahatA hai ki vaha aisI gAya ho, jo sevA kArya na karatI ho, na kheta (bhUmi) jotatI ho aura na kheta sIMcatI ho, vaha svastha ho aura usameM koI dhabbA na ho| ve boleH aba tumane ucita bAta batAI hai| phira unhoMne use vadha kara diyA| jabaki ve samIpa the ki ye kAma na kareM|
aura (yAda karo) jaba tumane eka vyakti kI hatyA kara dI tathA eka-dUsare para (doSa) thopane lage aura allAha ko use vyakta karanA thA, jise tuma chupA rahe the|
ataH hamane kahA ki use (nihata vyakti ke zava ko) usa (gAya) ke kisI bhAga se mAro|[1] isI prakAra allAha murdoM ko jIvita karegA aura vaha tumheM apanI nizAniyA~ dikhAtA hai; tAki tuma samajho|

phira ye (nizAniyA~ dekhane) ke bAda tumhAre dila pattharoM ke samAna yA unase bhI adhika kaThora ho gaye; kyoMki pattharoM meM kucha aise hote haiM, jinase nahareM phUTa par3atI haiM aura kucha phaTa jAte haiM aura unase pAnI nikala AtA hai aura kucha allAha ke Dara se gira par3ate haiM aura allAha tumhAre karatUtoM se nizceta nahIM hai|

kyA tuma AzA rakhate ho ki (yahUdI) tumhArI bAta mAna leMge, jabaki unameM eka giroha aisA thA, jo allAha kI vANI (taurAta) ko sunatA thA aura samajha jAne ke bAda jAna-bUjha kara usameM parivartaNa kara detA thA?

tathA jaba ve ImAna vAloM se milate haiM, to kahate haiM ki hama bhI ImAna lAye aura jaba ekAnta meM Apasa meM eka-dUsare se milate haiM, to kahate haiM ki tuma unheM vo bAteM kyoM batAte ho, jo allAha ne tumapara kholI[1] haiM? isalie ki pralaya ke dina tumhAre pAlanahAra ke pAsa ise tumhAre virudhda pramANa banAyeM? kyA tuma samajhate nahIM ho?
kyA ve nahIM jAnate ki ve jo kucha chupAte tathA vyakta karate haiM, vo saba allAha jAnatA hai?
tathA unameM kucha anapar3ha haiM, ve pustaka (taurAta) kA jJAna nahIM rakhate, parantu nirAdhAra kAmanAyeM karate tathA kevala anumAna lagAte haiM|

to vinAza hai unake lie[1] jo apane hAthoM se pustaka likhate haiM, phira kahate haiM ki ye allAha kI ora se hai, tAki usake dvArA tanika mUlya kharIdeM! to vinAza hai unake apane hAthoM ke lekha ke kAraNa! aura vinAza hai unakI kamAI ke kAraNa!

tathA unhoMne kahA ki hameM naraka kI agni ginatI ke kucha dinoM ke sivA sparza nahIM karegI| (he nabI!) unase kaho ki kyA tumane allAha se koI vacana le liyA hai ki allAha apanA vacana bhaMga nahIM karegA? balki tuma allAha ke bAre meM aisI bAteM karate ho, jinakA tumheM jJAna nahIM|
kyoM[1] nahIM, jo bhI burAI kamAyegA tathA usakA pApa use ghera legA, to vahI nArakIya haiM aura vahI usameM sadAvAsI hoMge|
tathA jo ImAna lAyeM aura satkarma kareM, vahI svargIya haiM aura ve usameM sadAvAsI hoMge|

aura (yAda karo) jaba hamane banI isrAIla se dRr3ha vacana liyA ki allAha ke sivA kisI kI ibAdata (vaMdanA) nahIM karoge tathA mAtA-pitA ke sAtha upakAra karoge aura samIpavartI saMbaMdhiyoM, anAthoM, dIna-dukhiyoM ke sAtha aura logoM se bhalI bAta bologe tathA namAz2a kI sthApanA karoge aura z2akAta doge, phira tumameM se thor3e ke sivA sabane mu~ha phera liyA aura tuma (abhI bhI) mu~ha phere hue ho|
tathA (yAda karo) jaba hamane tumase dRr3ha vacana liyA ki Apasa meM raktapAta nahIM karoge aura na apanoM ko apane gharoM se nikAloge| phira tumane svIkAra kiyA aura tuma usake sAkSI ho|

phira[1] tuma vahI ho, jo apanoM kI hatyA kara rahe ho tathA apanoM meM se eka giroha ko unake gharoM se nikAla rahe ho aura pApa tathA atyAcAra ke sAtha unake virudhda sahAyatA karate ho aura yadi ve baMdI hokara tumhAre pAsa AyeM, to unakA arthadaNDa cukAte ho, jabaki unheM nikAlanA hI tumapara ha़rAma (avaidha) thA, to kyA tuma pustaka ke kucha bhAga para ImAna rakhate ho aura kucha kA inkAra karate ho? phira tumameM se jo aisA karate hoM, to unakA daNDa kyA hai, isake sivA ki sAMsArika jIvana meM apamAna tathA pralaya ke dina ati kar3I yAtanA kI ora phere jAyeM? aura allAha tumhAre karatUtoM se nizceta nahIM hai!
unhoMne hI Aqhirata (paraloka) ke badale sAMsArika jIvana qharIda liyA| ataH unase yAtanA maMda nahIM kI jAyegI aura na unakI sahAyatA kI jAyegI|

tathA hamane mUsA ko pustaka (taurAta) pradAna kI aura usake pazcAt nirantara rasUla bheje aura hamane maryama ke putra IsA ko khulI nizAniyA~ dIM aura rUha़ula qudusa[1] dvArA use samarthana diyA, to kyA jaba bhI koI rasUla tumhArI apanI manamAnI ke virudhda koI bAta tumhAre pAsa lekara AyA, to tuma akar3a gaye, ataH kucha nabiyoM ko jhuThalA diyA aura kucha kI hatyA karane lage?
tathA unhoMne kahA ki hamAre dila to baMda[1] haiM| balki unake kufra (inkAra) ke kAraNa allAha ne unheM dhikkAra diyA hai| isIlie unameM se bahuta thor3e hI ImAna lAte haiM|

aura jaba unake pAsa allAha kI ora se eka pustaka (qurAna) A gayI, jo unake sAtha kI pustaka kA pramANakArI hai, jabaki isase pUrva ve svayaM kAfiroM para vijaya kI prArthanA kara rahe the, to jaba unake pAsa vaha cIz2a A gayI, jise ve pahacAna bhI gaye, phira bhI usakA inkAra kara[1] diyA, to kAfiroM para allAha kI dhikkAra hai|

allAha kI utArI huI (pustaka)[1] kA inkAra karake bure badale para inhoMne apane prANoM ko beca diyA, isa dveSa ke kAraNa ki allAha ne apanA pradAna (prakAzanA), apane jisa bhakta[1] para cAhA, utAra diyA| ataH ve prakopa para prakopa ke adhikArI bana gaye aura aise kAfiroM ke lie apamAnakArI yAtanA hai|

aura jaba unase kahA jAtA hai ki allAha ne jo utArA[1] hai, usapara Imana lAo, to kahate haiM: hama to usIpara ImAna rakhate haiM, jo hamapara utarA hai aura isake sivA jo kucha hai, usakA inkAra karate haiM| jabaki vaha satya hai aura usakA pramANkArI hai, jo unake pAsa hai| kaho ki phira isase pUrva allAha ke nabiyoM kI hatyA kyoM karate the, yadi tuma ImAna vAle the to?
tathA mUsA tumhAre pAsa khulI nizAniyA~ lekara Aye| phira tumane atyAcAra karate hue bachar3e ko pUjya banA liyA|

phira usa dRr3ha vacana ko yAda karo, jo hamane tumhAre Upara tUra (parvata) ko uThAkara liyA| (hamane kahAH) pakar3a lo, jo hamane diyA hai tumheM dRr3hatA se aura suno| to unhoMne kahAH hamane sunA aura avajJA kI| aura unake diloM meM bachar3e kA prema pilA diyA gayA, unakI avajJA ke kAraNa| (he nabI!) Apa kaha dIjiyeH burA hai vaha jisakA Adeza de rahA hai tumheM tumhArA ImAna, yadi tuma ImAna vAle ho|
(ai nabI!) Apa kaha dIjie: yadi Aqhirata kA ghara allAha ke pAsa saba logoM ko chor3akara vizeSa rUpa se tumhAre hI lie hai, to tuma mauta kI kAmanA karo, yadi tuma sacce ho|
aura ve kadApi usakI kAmanA nahIM kareMge, unake kartUtoM ke kAraNa aura allAha atyAcAriyoM se adhika sUcita hai|

tuma inheM, sabase bar3hakara jIne kA lobhI pAoge aura mizraNavAdiyoM se (bhI)| inameM se pratyeka vyakti cAhatA hai ki use eka-eka haz2Ara varSa kI Ayu mila jAye| ha़AlA~ki ye (lambI) Ayu bhI use yAtanA se bacA nahIM sakatI aura allAha dekhane vAlA hai jo ve kara rahe haiM|

(he nabI!)[1] kaha do ki jo vyakti jibrIla kA zatru hai, (to rahe)| usane to allAha kI anumati se isa saMdeza (qurAna) ko Apake dila para utArA hai, jo isase pUrva kI sabhI pustakoM kA pramANakArI tathA ImAna vAloM ke lie mArgadarzana evaM (saphalatA) kA zubha samAcAra hai|
jo allAha tathA usake fariztoM aura usake rasUloM aura jibrIla tathA mIkAIla kA zatru ho, to allAha (una) kAfiroM kA zatru hai|[1]
aura (he nabI!) hamane Apa para khulI AyateM utArI haiM aura inakA inkAra kevala vahI loga[1] kareMge, jo kukarmI haiM|
kyA aisA nahIM huA hai ki jaba kabhI unhoMne koI vacana diyA, to unake eka giroha ne use bhaMga kara diyA? balki inameM bahutere aise haiM, jo ImAna nahIM rakhate|

tathA jaba unake pAsa allAha kI ora se eka rasUla, usa pustaka kA samarthana karate hue, jo unake pAsa hai, A gayA,[1] to unake eka samudAya ne jinaheM pustaka dI gayI, allAha kI pustaka ko aise pIche DAla diyA, jaise ve kucha jAnate hI na hoM|

tathA sulaimAna ke rAjya meM zaitAna jo mithyA bAteM banA rahe the, unakA anusaraNa karane lage| jabaki sulaimAna ne kabhI kufra (jAdU) nahIM kiyA, parantu kufra to zaitAnoM ne kiyA, jo logoM ko jAdU sikhA rahe the tathA ve una bAtoM kA (anusaraNa karane lage) jo bAbila (nagara) ke do fariztoM; hArUta aura mArUta para utArI gayIM, jabaki ve donoM kisI ko jAdU nahIM sikhAte, jaba taka ye na kaha dete ki hama kevala eka parIkSA haiM, ataH, tU kufra meM na par3a| phira bhI ve una donoM se vo cIz2a sIkhate, jisake dvArA ve pati aura patnI ke bIca judAI DAla deM aura ve allAha kI anumati binA isake dvArA kisI ko koI hAni nahIM pahu~cA sakate the, parantu phira bhI aisI bAteM sIkhate the, jo unake lie hAnikAraka hoM aura lAbhakArI na hoM aura ve bhalI-bhA~ti jAnate the ki jo isakA qharIdAra banA, paraloka meM usakA koI bhAga nahIM tathA kitanA burA upabhogya hai, jisake badale ve apane prANoM kA saudA kara rahe haiM[1], yadi ve jAnate hote!
aura yadi ve ImAna lAte aura allAha se Darate, to allAha ke pAsa isakA jo pratikAra (badalA) milatA, vaha unake lie uttama hotA, yadi ve jAnate hote|
he ImAna vAlo! tuma 'rAinA'[1] na kaho, 'unz2uranA' kaho aura dhyAna se bAta suno tathA kAfiroM ke lie dukhadAyI yAtanA hai|

ahle kitAba meM se jo kAfira ho gaye tathA jo mizraNavAdI ho gaye, ve nahIM cAhate ki tumhAre pAlanahAra kI ora se tumapara koI bhalAI utArI jAye aura allAha jisapara cAhe, apanI vizeSa dayA karatA hai aura allAha bar3A dAnazIla hai|
hama apanI koI Ayata nirasta kara dete athavA bhulA dete haiM, to usase uttama athavA usake samAna lAte haiM| kyA tuma nahIM jAnate ki allAha jo cAhe[1], kara sakatA hai?
kyA tuma ye nahIM jAnate ki AkAzoM tathA dharatI kA rAjya allAha hI ke lie hai aura usake sivA tumhArA koI rakSaka aura sahAyaka nahIM hai?
kyA tuma cAhate ho ki apane rasula se usI prakAra prazna karo, jaise mUsA se prazna kiye jAte rahe? aura jo vyakti ImAna kI nIti ko kufra se badala legA, to vaha sIdhI Dagara se vicalita ho gayA|

ahale kitAba meM se bahuta-se cAhate haiM ki tumhAre ImAna lAne ke pazcAt apane dveSa ke kAraNa tumheM kufra kI ora pheMka deM| jabaki satya unake lie ujAgara ho gayA| phira bhI tuma kSamA se kAma lo aura jAne do| yahA~ taka ki allAha apanA nirNaya kara de| nizcaya allAha jo cAhe, kara sakatA hai|
tathA tuma namAz2a kI sthApanA karo aura z2akAta do aura jo bhI bhalAI apane lie kiye rahoge, use allAha ke yahA~ pAoge| tuma jo kucha kara rahe ho, allAha use dekha rahA hai|
tathA unhoMne kahA ki koI svarga meM kadApi nahIM jAyegA, jaba taka yahUdI athavA nasArA[1] (IsAI) na ho| ye unakI kAmanAyeM haiM| unase kaho ki yadi tuma satyavAdI ho, to koI pramANa prastuta karo|

kyoM nahIM?[1] jo bhI svayaM ko allAha kI AjJA pAlana ke lie samarpita kara degA tathA sadAcArI hogA, to usake pAlanahAra ke pAsa usakA pratiphala hai aura unapara koI bhaya nahIM hogA aura na ve udAsIna hoMge|

tathA yahUdiyoM ne kahA ki IsAIyoM ke pAsa kucha nahIM aura IsAIyoM ne kahA ki yahUdiyoM ke pAsa kucha nahIM hai| jabaki ve dharma pustaka[1] par3hate haiM| isI jaisI bAta unhoMne bhI kahI, jinake pAsa dharma pustaka kA koI jJAna[2] nahIM| ye jisa viSaya meM vibheda kara rahe haiM, usakA nirNaya allAha pralaya ke dina unake bIca kara degA|

aura usase bar3A atyAcArI kauna hogA, jo allAha kI masjidoM meM usake nAma kA varNana karane se roke aura unheM ujAr3ane kA prayatna kare?[1] unhIM ke lie yogya hai ki usameM Darate hue praveza kareM, unhIM ke lie saMsAra meM apamAna hai aura unhIM ke lie Aqhirata (paraloka) meM ghora yAtanA hai|
tathA pUrva aura pazcima allAha hI ke haiM; tuma jidhara bhI mukha karo[1], udhara hI allAha kA mukha hai aura allAha vizAla ati jJAnI hai|
tathA unhoMne kahA[1] ki allAha ne koI saMtAna banA lI| vaha isase pavitra hai| AkAzoM tathA dharatI meM jo bhI hai, vaha usI kA hai aura saba usI ke AjJAkArI haiM|
vaha AkAzoM tathA dharatI kA aviSkAraka hai| jaba vaha kisI bAta kA nirNaya kara letA hai, to usake lie basa ye Adeza detA hai ki "ho jA|" aura vaha ho jAtI hai|

tathA unhoMne kahA jo jJAna[1] nahIM rakhate ki allAha hamase bAta kyoM nahIM karatA yA hamAre pAsa koI Ayata kyoM nahIM AtI? isI prakAra kI bAta inase pUrva ke logoM ne kahI thI| inake dila eka samAna ho gaye| hamane unake lie nizAniyA~ ujAgara kara dI haiM, jo vizvAsa rakhate haiM|
(he nabI!) hamane Apako satya ke sAtha zubha sUcanA dene tathA sAvadhAna[1] karane vAlA banAkara bhejA hai aura Apase nArakiyoM ke viSaya meM prazna nahIM kiyA jAyegA|

(he nabI!) Apase yahUdI tathA IsAI sahamata (prasanna) nahIM hoMge, jaba taka Apa unakI rIti para na caleM| kaha do ki sIdhI Dagara vahI hai, jo allAha ne batAI hai aura yadi Apane unakI AkAMkSAoM kA anusaraNa kiyA, isake pazcAta ki Apake pAsa jJAna A gayA, to allAha (kI pakar3a) se ApakA koI rakSaka aura sahAyaka nahIM hogA|
aura hamane jinheM pustaka pradAna kI hai aura use vaise par3hate haiM, jaise par3hanA cAhiye, vahI usapara ImAna rakhate haiM aura jo use nakArate haiM, vahI kSatigrastoM meM se haiM|
he banI isrAIla! mere usa puraskAra ko yAda karo, jo maiMne tumapara kiyA hai aura ye ki tumheM (apane yuga ke) saMsAra-vasiyoM para pradhAnatA dI thI|

tathA usa dina se Daro, jaba koI vyakti kisI vyakti ke kucha kAma nahIM AyegA aura na usase koI arthadaNDa svIkAra kiyA jAyegA aura na use koI anuzaMsA (sifAriza) lAbha pahu~cAyegI aura na unakI koI sahAyatA kI jAyegI|

aura (yAda karo) jaba ibrAhIma kI usake pAlanahAra ne kucha bAtoM se parIkSA lI aura vaha usameM pUrA utarA, to usane kahA ki maiM tumheM saba insAnoM kA imAma (dharmaguru) banAne vAlA hU~| (ibrAhIma ne) kahAH tathA merI saMtAna se bhI| (allAha ne kahAH) merA vacana unake lie nahIM, jo atyAcArI[1] haiM|

aura (yAda karo) jaba hamane isa ghara (arthAtaHkAbA) ko logoM ke lie bAra-bAra Ane kA keMdra tathA zAMti sthala nirdhArita kara diyA tathA ye Adeza de diyA ki 'maqAme ibrAhIma' ko namAz2a kA sthAna[1] banA lo tathA ibrAhIma aura ismAIla ko Adeza diyA ki mere ghara ko tavAfa (parikramA) tathA etikAfa[2] karane vAloM aura sajdA tathA rukU karane vAloM ke lie pavitra rakho|

aura (yAda karo) jaba ibrAhIma ne apane pAlanahAra se prArthanA kIH he mere pAlanahAra! isa chetra ko zAMti kA nagara banA de tathA isake vAsiyoM ko, jo unameM se allAha aura aMtima dina (pralaya) para ImAna rakhe, vibhinna prakAra kI upaja (phaloM) se AjIvikA pradAna kara| (allAha ne) kahAH tathA jo kAfira hai, use bhI maiM thor3A lAbha dUMgA, phira use naraka kI yAtanA kI ora bAdhya kara dU~gA aura vaha bahuta burA sthAna hai|

aura (yAda karo) jaba ibrAhIma aura ismAIla isa ghara kI nIMva U~cI kara rahe the tathA prArthanA kara rahe theH he hamAre pAlanahAra! hamase ye sevA svIkAra kara le| tU hI saba kucha sunatA aura jAnatA hai|

he hamAre pAlanahAra! hama donoM ko apanA AjJAkArI banA tathA hamArI saMtAna se eka aisA samudAya banA de, jo terA AjJAkArI ho aura hameM hamAre (hajja kI) vidhiyA~ batA de tathA hameM kSamA kara| vAstava meM, tU ati kSamI, dayAvAn hai|

he hamAre pAlanahAra! unake bIca unhIM meM se eka rasUla bheja, jo unheM terI AyateM sunAye aura unheM pustaka (qurAna) tathA ha़ikmata (sunnata) kI zikSA de aura unheM zudhda tathA AjJAkArI banA de| vAstava meM, tU hI prabhutvazAlI tatvajJa[1] hai|

tathA kauna hogA, jo IbrAhIma ke dharma se vimukha ho jAye, parantu vahI jo svayaM ko mUrkha banA le? jabaki hamane use saMsAra meM cuna[1] liyA tathA Aqhirata (paraloka) meM usakI gaNanA sadAcAriyoM meM hogI|
tathA (yAda karo) jaba usake pAlanahAra ne usase kahAH merA AjJAkArI ho jA| to usane turanta kahAH maiM vizva ke pAlanahAra kA AjJAkArI ho gayA|

tathA ibrAhIma ne apane putroM ko tathA yAqUba ne, isI bAta para bala diyA ki he mere putro! allAha ne tumhAre lie ye dharma (islAma) nirvAcita kara diyA hai| ataH marate samaya taka tuma isI para sthira rahanA|

kyA tuma yAqUba ke marane ke samaya upasthita the; jaba yAqUba ne apane putroM se kahAH merI mRtyu ke pazcAt tuma kisakI ibAdata (vaMdanA) karoge? unhoMne kahAH hama tere tathA tere pitA ibrAhIma aura ismAIla tathA isha़Aqa ke ekamAtra pUjya kI ibAdata (vaMdanA) kareMge aura usI ke AjJAkArI raheMge|
ye eka samudAya thA, jo jA cukA| unhoMne jo karma kiye, ve unake lie haiM tathA jo tumane kiye, ve tumhAre lie aura unake kiye kA prazna tumase nahIM kiyA jAyegA|

aura ve kahate haiM ki yahUdI ho jAo athavA IsAI ho jAo, tumheM mArgadarzana mila jAyegA| Apa kaha deM, nahIM! hama to ekezvaravAdI ibrAhIma ke dharma para haiM aura vaha mizraNavAdiyoM meM se nahIM thA|

(he musalamAno!) tuma saba kaho ki hama allAha para ImAna lAye tathA usapara jo (qurAna) hamArI ora utArA gayA aura usapara jo ibrAhIma, ismAIla, isha़Aqa, yAqUba tathA unakI saMtAna kI ora utArA gayA aura jo mUsA tathA IsA ko diyA gayA tathA jo dUsare nabiyoM ko, unake pAlanahAra kI ora se diyA gayA| hama inameM se kisI ke bIca antara nahIM karate aura hama usI ke AjJAkArI haiM|

to yadi ve tumhAre hI samAna ImAna le AyeM, to ve mArgadarzana pA leMge aura yadi vimukha hoM, to ve virodha meM lIna haiM| unake virudhda tumhAre lie allAha basa hai aura vaha saba sunane vAlA aura jAnane vAlA hai|
tuma saba allAha ke raMga[1] (svabhAvika dharma) ko grahaNa kara lo aura allAha ke raMga se acchA kisakA raMga hogA? hama to usI kI ibAdata (vaMdanA) karate haiM|

(he nabI!) kaha do ki kyA tuma hamase allAha ke (eka hone ke) viSaya meM jhagar3ate ho, jabaki vahI hamArA tathA tumhArA pAlanahAra hai?[1] phira hamAre lie hamArA karma hai aura tumhAre lie tumhArA karma hai aura hama to basa usI kI ibAdata (vaMdanA) karane vAle haiM|

(he ahle kitAba!) kyA tuma kahate ho ki ibrAhIma, ismAIla, isha़Aqa, yAqUba tathA unakI saMtAna yahUdI yA IsAI thI? unase kaha do ki tuma adhika jAnate ho athavA allAha? aura usase bar3A atyAcArI kauna hogA, jisake pAsa allAha kA sAkSya ho aura use chupA de? aura allAha tumhAre karatUtoM se aceta to nahIM hai[1]|
ye eka samudAya thA, jo jA cukA| unake lie unakA karma hai tathA tumhAre lie tumhArA karma hai| tumase unake karmoM ke bAre meM prazna nahIM kiyA jAyegA[1]|

zIghra hI mUrkha loga kaheMge ki unheM jisa qibale[1] para ve the, usase kisa bAta ne phera diyA? (he nabI!) unheM batA do ki pUrva aura pazcima saba allAha ke haiM| vaha jise cAhe, sIdhI rAha para lagA detA hai|

aura isI prakAra hamane tumheM madhyavartI ummata (samudAya) banA diyA; tAki tuma, sabapara sAkSI[1] bano aura rasUla tumapara sAkSI hoM aura hamane vaha qibalA jisapara tuma the, isIlie banAyA thA, tAki ye bAta khola deM ki kauna (apane dharma se) phira jAtA hai aura ye bAta bar3I bhArI thI, parantu unake lie nahIM, jinheM allAha ne mArgadarzana de diyA hai aura allAha aisA nahIM ki tumhAre ImAna (arthAta baitula maqdisa kI dizA meM namAz2a par3hane) ko vyartha kara de[2], vAstava meM allAha logoM ke lie atyaMta karuNAmaya tathA dayAvAn hai|

(he nabI!) hama Apake mukha ko bAra-bAra AkAza kI ora phirate dekha rahe haiM| to hama avazya Apako usa qibale (kAbA) kI ora phera deMge, jisase Apa prasanna ho jAyeM| to (aba) apane mukha masjide ha़rAma kI ora phera lo[1] tathA (he musalamAnoM!) tuma bhI jahA~ raho, usI kI ora mukha kiyA karo aura nizcaya ahle kitAba jAnate haiM ki ye unake pAlanahAra kI ora se satya hai[2] aura allAha unake karmoM se asUcita nahIM hai|

aura yadi Apa ahle kitAba ke pAsa pratyeka prakAra kI nizAnI lA deM, taba bhI ve Apake qibale kA anusaraNa nahIM kareMge aura na Apa unake qibale kA anusaraNa kareMge aura na unameM se koI dUsare ke qibale kA anusaraNa karegA aura yadi jJAna Ane ke pazcAt Apane unakI AkAMkSAoM kA anusaraNa kiyA, to Apa atyAcAriyoM meM se ho jAyeMge|
jinheM hamane pustaka dI hai, ve Apako aise hI[1] pahacAnate haiM, jaise apane putroM ko pahacAnate haiM aura unakA eka samudAya jAnate hue bhI satya ko chupA rahA hai|
satya vahI hai, jo Apake pAlanahAra kI ora se utArA gayA| ataH, Apa kadApi saMdeha karane vAloM meM na hoM|

pratyeka ke lie eka dizA hai, jisakI ora vaha mukha kara hA hai| ataH tuma bhalAIyoM meM agrasara bano| tuma jahA~ bhI rahoge, allAha tuma sabhI ko (pralaya ke dina) le AyegA| nizcaya allAha jo cAhe, kara sakatA hai|
aura Apa jahA~ bhI nikaleM, apanA mukha masjide ha़rAma kI ora phereM| niHsaMdeha ye Apake pAlanahAra kI ora se satya (Adeza) hai aura allAha tumhAre karmoM se asUcita nahIM hai|

aura Apa jahA~ se bhI nikaleM, apanA mukha masjide ha़rAma kI ora phereM aura (he musalamAnoM!) tuma jahA~ bhI raho, apane mukhoM ko usI kI ora phero; tAki unheM tumhAre virudhda kisI vivAda kA avasara na mile, magara una logoM ke atirikta, jo atyAcAra kareM| ataH unase na Daro| mujhI se Daro aura tAki maiM tumapara apanA puraskAra (dharma vidhAna) pUrA kara dU~ aura tAki tuma sIdhI Dagara pAo|

jisa prakAra hamane tumhAre lie tumhIM meM se eka rasUla bhejA, jo tumheM hamArI AyateM sunAtA tathA tumheM zudhda AjJAkArI banAtA hai aura tumheM pustaka (kurAna) tathA ha़ikmata (sunnata) sikhAtA hai tathA tumheM vo bAteM sikhAtA hai, jo tuma nahIM jAnate the|
ataH, mujhe yAda karo[1], maiM tumheM yAda karU~gA[2] aura mere AbhArI raho aura mere kRtaghna na bano|
he ImAna vAlo! dhairya tathA namAz2a kA sahArA lo, nizcaya allAha dhairyavAnoM ke sAtha hai|
tathA jo allAha kI rAha meM mAre jAyeM, unheM murdA na kaho, balki ve jIvita haiM, parantu tuma (unake jIvana kI dazA) nahIM samajhate|
tathA hama avazya kucha bhaya, bhUka tathA dhanoM aura prANoM tathA khAdya padArthoM kI kamI se tumhArI parIkSA kareMge aura dhairyavAnoM ko zubha samAcAra sunA do|
jinapara koI ApadA A par3e, to kahate haiM ki hama allAha ke haiM aura hameM usI ke pAsa phira kara jAnA hai|
inhIM para inake pAlanahAra kI kRpAyeM tathA dayA haiM aura yahI sIdhI rAha pAne vAle haiM|

bezaka safA tathA maravA pahAr3I[1] allAha (ke dharma) kI nizAniyoM meM se haiM| ataH jo allAha ke ghara kA ha़ja yA umaraha kare, to usapara koI doSa nahIM ki una donoM kA pherA lagAye aura jo svecchA se bhalAI kare, to niHsaMdeha allAha usakA guNagrAhI ati jJAnI hai|

tathA jo hamArI utArI huI AyatoM (antima nabI ke guNoM) tathA mArgadarzana ko, isake pazcAt ki hamane pustaka[1] meM use logoM ke lie ujAgara kara diyA hai, chupAte haiM, unhIM ko allAha dhikkAratA hai[2] tathA saba dhikkArane vAle dhikkArate haiM|
jina logoM ne taubA (kSamA yAcanA) kara lI aura sudhAra kara liyA aura ujAgara kara diyA, to maiM unakI taubA svIkAra kara lU~gA tathA maiM atyaMta kSamAzIla, dayAvAn hU~|
vAstava meM, jo kAfira (avizvAsI) ho gaye aura isI dazA meM mare, to vahI haiM, jinapara allAha tathA fariztoM aura saba logoM kI dhikkAra hai|
vaha isa (dhikkAra) meM sadAvAsI hoMge, unase yAtanA maMda nahIM kI jAyegI aura na unako avakAza diyA jAyegA|
aura tumhArA pUjya eka hI[1] pUjya hai, usa atyaMta dayAlu, dayAvAna ke sivA koI pUjya nahIM|

bezaka AkAzoM tathA dharatI kI racanA meM, rAta tathA dina ke eka-dUsare ke pIche nirantara Ane-jAne meM, una nAvoM meM, jo mAnava ke lAbha ke sAdhanoM ko lie, sAgaroM meM calatI-phiratI haiM aura varSA ke usa pAnI meM, jise allAha AkAza se barasAtA hai, phira dharatI ko usake dvArA, usake maraN (sUkhane) ke pazcAt jIvita karatA hai aura usameM pratyeka jIvoM ko phailAtA hai tathA vAyuoM ko pherane meM aura una bAdaloM meM, jo AkAza aura dharatI ke bIca usakI AjJA[1] ke adhIna rahate haiM, (ina saba cIz2oM meM) agaNita nizAniyA~ (lakSNa) haiM, una logoM ke lie, jo samajha-bUjha rakhate haiM|

kucha aise loga bhI haiM, jo allAha ke sivA dUsaroM ko usakA sAjhI banAte haiM aura unase, allAha se prema karane jaisA prema karate haiM tathA jo ImAna lAye, ve allAha se sarvAdhika prema karate haiM aura kyA hI acchA hotA, yadi ye atyAcArI yAtanA dekhane ke samaya[1] jo bAta jAneMge, isI samaya[2] jAnate ki saba zakti tathA adhikAra allAha hI ko hai aura allAha kA daNDa bhI bahuta kar3A hai, (to allAha ke sivA dUsare kI pUjA arAdhanA nahIM karate|)
jaba ye dazA[1] hogI ki jinakA anusaraNa kiyA gayA[2], ve apane anuyAyiyoM se virakta ho jAyeMge aura unake Apasa ke sabhI sambaMdha[3] TUTa jAyeMge|

tathA jo anuyAyI hoMge, ve ye kAmanA kareMge ki eka bAra aura hama saMsAra meM jAte, to inase aise hI virakta ho jAte, jaise ye hamase virakta ho gaye haiM! aise hI allAha unake karmoM ko unake lie saMtApa banAkara dikhAegA aura ve agni se nikala nahIM sakeMge|
he logo! dharatI meM jo ha़lAla (vaidha) svaccha cIz2eM haiM, unheM khAo aura zaitAna kI batAI rAhoM para na calo[1], vaha tumhArA khulA zatru hai|
vaha tumheM burAI tathA nirlajjA kA Adeza detA hai aura ye ki allAha para usa cIz2a kA Aropa[1] dharo, jise tuma nahIM jAnate ho|

aura jaba unase[1] kahA jAtA hai ki jo (qurAna) allAha ne utArA hai, usapara calo, to kahate haiM ki hama to usI rIti para caleMge, jisapara apane pUrvajoM ko pAyA hai| kyA yadi unake pUrvaja kucha na samajhate rahe tathA kupatha para rahe hoM, (taba bhI ve unhIM kA anusaraNa karate raheMge?)

unakI dazA jo kAfira ho gaye, usake samAna hai, jo use (arthAta pazu ko) pukAratA hai, jo hA~ka-pukAra ke sivA kucha[1] nahIM sunatA, ye (kAfira) bahare, goMge tathA aMdhe haiM| isalie kucha nahIM samajhate|
he ImAna vAlo! una svaccha cIz2oM meM se khAo, jo hamane tumheM dI haiM tathA allAha kI kRtajJatA kA varNana karo, yadi tuma kevala usI kI ibAdata (vaMdanA) karate ho|

(allAha) ne tumapara murdAra[1] tathA (bahatA) rakta aura suara kA mA~sa tathA jisapara allAha ke sivA kisI aura kA nAma pukArA gayA ho, unheM ha़rAma (niSedha) kara diyA hai| phira bhI jo vivaza ho jAye, jabaki vaha niyama na tor3a rahA ho aura AvazyaktA kI sImA kA ullaMghana na kara rahA ho, to usapara koI doSa nahIM| allAha ati kSamAzIla, dayAvAn hai|[1]

vAstava meM, jo loga allAha kI utArI pustaka (kI bAtoM) ko chupA rahe haiM aura unake badale tanika mUlya prApta kara lete haiM, ve apane udara meM kevala agni bhara rahe haiM tathA allAha unase bAta nahIM karegA aura na unheM vizudhda karegA aura unhIM ke lie duHkhadAyI yAtanA hai|
yahI ve loga haiM, jinhoMne supatha (mArgadarzana) ke badale kupatha kharIda liyA hai tathA kSamA ke badale yAtanA| to naraka kI agni para ve kitane sahanazIla haiM?
isa yAtanA ke adhikArI ve isalie hue ki allAha ne pustaka satya ke sAtha utArI aura jo pustaka meM vibheda kara baiThe, ve vAstava meM, virodha meM bahuta dura nikala gaye|

bhalAI ye nahIM hai ki tuma apanA mukha pUrva athavA pazcima kI ora phera lo! bhalA karma to usakA hai, jo allAha aura antima dina (pralaya) para ImAna lAyA tathA fariztoM, saba pustakoM, nabiyoM para (bhI ImAna lAyA), dhana kA moha rakhate hue, samIpavartiyoM, anAthoM, nirdhanoM, yAtriyoM tathA yAcakoM (kAfiroM) ko aura dAsa mukti ke lie diyA, namAz2a kI sthApanA kI, z2akAta dI, apane vacana ko, jaba bhI vacana diyA, pUrA karate rahe evaM nirdhanatA aura roga tathA yudhda kI sthiti meM dhairyavAna rahe| yahI loga sacce haiM tathA yahI (allAha se) Darate[1] haiM|

he ImAna vAlo! tumapara nihata vyaktiyoM ke bAre meM qisAsa (barAbarI kA badalA) anivArya[1] kara diyA gayA hai| svataMtra kA badalA svataMtra se liyA jAyegA, dAsa kA dAsa se aura nArI kA nArI se| jisa aparAdhI ke lie usake bhAI kI ora se kucha kSamA kara[2] diyA jAye, to use sAmAnya niyama kA anusaraNa (anupAlana) karanA cAhiye| nihata vyakti ke vArisa ko bhalAI ke sAtha diyata (arthadaNDa) cukA denA cAhiye| ye tumhAre pAlanahAra kI ora se suvidhA tathA dayA hai| isapara bhI jo atyAcAra[3] kare, to usake lie duHkhadAyI yAtanA hai|
aura he samajha vAlo! tumhAre lie qisAsa (ke niyama meM) jIvana hai, tAki tuma raktapAta se baco|[1]

aura jaba tumameM se kisI ke nidhana kA samaya ho aura vaha dhana chor3a rahA ho, to usapara mAtA-pitA aura samIpavartiyoM ke lie sAdhAraNa niyamAnusAra vasiyyata (uttaradAna) karanA anivArya kara diyA gayA hai| ye AjJAkAriyoM ke lie sunizcita[1] hai|
phira jisane vasiyyata sunane ke pazcAta use badala diyA, to usakA pApa unapara hai, jo use badaleMge aura allAha saba kucha sunatA-jAnatA hai|
phira jise Dara ho ki vasiyyata karane vAle ne pakSapAta yA atyAcAra kiyA hai, phira usane unake bIca sudhAra karA diyA, to usapara koI pApa nahIM| nizcaya allAha ati kSamAzIla tathA dayAvAn hai|
he ImAna vAlo! tumapara roz2e[1] usI prakAra anivArya kara diye gaye haiM, jaise tumase pUrva ke logoM para anivArya kiye gaye, tAki tuma allAha se Daro|

vaha ginatI ke kucha dina haiM| phira yadi tumameM se koI rogI athavA yAtrA para ho, to ye ginatI, dUsare dinoM se pUrI kare aura jo usa roz2e ko sahana na kara sake[1], vaha fidyA (prAyazcitta) de, jo eka nirdhana ko khAnA khilAnA hai aura jo svecchA bhalAI kare, vaha usake lie acchI bAta hai| yadI tuma samajho, to tumhAre lie roz2A rakhanA hI acchA hai|

ramaz2Ana kA mahInA vaha hai, jisameM qurAna utArA gayA, jo saba mAnava ke lie mArgadarzana hai tathA mArgadarzana aura satyosatya ke bIca antara karane ke khule pramANa rakhatA hai| ataH jo vyakti isa mahIne meM upasthita[1] ho, vaha usakA roz2A rakhe, phira yadi tumameM se koI rogI[2] athavA yAtrA[3] para ho, to use dUsare dinoM meM ginatI purI karanI cAhie| allAha tumhAre lie suvidhA cAhatA hai, taMgI (asuvidhA) nahIM cAhatA aura cAhatA hai ki tuma ginatI pUrI karo tathA isa bAtapara allAha kI mahimA kA varNana karo ki usane tumheM mArgadarzana diyA aura (isa prakAra) tuma usake kRtajJa[4] bana sako|

(he nabI!) jaba mere bhakta mere viSaya meM Apase prazna kareM, to unheM batA deM ki nizcaya maiM samIpa hU~| maiM prArthI kI prArthanA kA uttara detA hU~| ataH, unheM bhI cAhiye ki mere AjJAkArI baneM tathA mujhapara ImAna (vizvAsa) rakheM, tAki ve sIdhI rAha pAyeM|

tumhAre lie roz2e kI rAta meM apanI striyoM se sahavAsa ha़lAla (ucita) kara diyA gayA hai| ve tumhArA vastra[1] haiM tathA tuma unakA vastra ho, allAha ko jJAna ho gayA hai ki tuma apanA upabhoga[2] kara rahe the| usane tumhArI taubA (kSamA yAcanA) svIkAra kara lI tathA tumheM kSamA kara diyA| aba unase (rAtri meM) sahavAsa karo aura allAha ke (apane bhAgya meM) likhe kI khoja karo aura rAtri meM khAo tathA pio, yahA~ taka kI bhora kI sapheda dhArI rAta kI kAlI dhArI se ujAgara ho[3] jAye, phira roz2e ko rAtri (sUryAsta) taka pUrA karo aura unase sahavAsa na karo, jaba masjidoM meM aitikAfa (ekAntavAsa) meM raho| ye allAha kI sImAyeM haiM, inake samIpa bhI na jAo| isI prakAra allAha logoM ke lie apanI AyatoM ko ujAgara karatA hai, tAki ve (unake ullaMghana se) baceM|
tathA Apasa meM eka-dUsare kA dhana avaidha rUpa se na khAo aura na adhikAriyoM ke pAsa use isa dheya se le jAo ki logoM ke dhana kA koI bhAga, jAna-bUjha kara pApa[1] dvArA khA jAo|

(he nabI!) loga Apase caMdramA ke (ghaTane-bar3hane) ke viSaya meM prazna karate haiM? to Apa kaha deM, isase logoM ko tithiyoM ke nirdhAraNa tathA ha़ja ke samaya kA jJAna hotA hai aura ye koI bhalAI nahIM hai ki gharoM meM unake pIche se praveza karo, parantu bhalAI to allAha kI avajJA se bacane meM hai| gharoM meM unake dvAroM se Ao tathA allAha se Darate raho, tAki tuma[1] saphala ho jAo|
tathA allAha kI rAha meM, unase yudhda karo, jo tumase yudhda karate hoM aura atyAcAra na karo, allAha atyAcAriyoM se prema nahIM karatA|

aura unheM hata karo, jahA~ pAo aura unheM nikAlo, jahA~ se unhoMne tumheM nikAlA hai, isalie ki fitanA[1] (upadrava), hata karane se bhI burA hai aura unase masjide ha़rAma ke pAsa yudhda na karo, jaba taka ve tumase vahA~ yudhda[2] na kareM| parantu, yadi ve tumase yudhda kareM, to unakI hatyA karo, yahI kAfiroM kA badalA hai|
phira yadi ve (AkramaNa karane se) ruka jAyeM, to allAha ati kSamI, dayAvAn hai|
tathA unase yudhda karo, yahA~ taka ki fitanA na raha jAye aura dharma kevala allAha ke lie raha jAye, phira yadi ve ruka jAyeM, to atyAcAriyoM ke atirikta kisI aura para atyAcAra nahIM karanA cAhie|

sammAnita[1] mAsa, sammAnita mAsa ke badale hai aura sammAnita viSayoM meM barAbarI hai| ataH, jo tumapara atikramaNa (atyAcAra) kare, to tuma bhI usapara usI ke samAna (atikramaNa) karo tathA allAha ke AjJAkArI raho aura jAna lo ki allAha AjJAkAriyoM ke sAtha hai|
tathA allAha kI rAha (jihAda) meM dhana qharca karo aura apane-Apako vinAza meM na DAlo tathA upakAra karo, nizcaya allAha upakAriyoM se prema karatA hai|

tathA ha़ja aura umaraha allAha ke lie pUrA karo aura yadi roka diye jAo[1], to jo qurbAnI sulabha ho (kara do) aura apane sira na mu~DAo, jaba taka ki qurbAnI apane sthAna taka na pahu~ca[2] jAye, yadi tumameM se koI vyakti rogI ho yA usake sira meM koI pIr3A ho (aura sira mu~DA le), to usake badale meM roz2A rakhanA yA dAna[3] denA yA qurbAnI denA hai aura jaba tuma nirbhaya (zAnta) raho, to jo umare se ha़ja taka lAbhAnvita[4] ho, vaha jo qurbAnI sulabha ho, use kare aura jise upalabdha na ho, vaha tIna roz2e ha़ja ke dinoM meM rakhe aura sAta, jaba rakhe, jaba tuma (ghara) vApasa Ao| ye pUre dasa hue| ye usake lie hai, jo masjide ha़rAma kA nivAsI na ho aura allAha se Daro tathA jAna lo ki allAha kI yAtanA bahuta kar3I hai|

ha़ja ke mahIne prasidhda haiM, jo vyakti inameM ha़ja kA nizcaya kara le, to (ha़ja ke bIca) kAma vAsanA tathA avajJA aura jhagar3e kI bAteM na kare tathA tuma jo bhI acche karma karoge, usakA jJAna allAha ko ho jAyegA aura apane lie pAtheya banA lo, uttama pAtheya allAha kI AjJAkAritA hai tathA he samajha vAlo! mujhI se Daro|

tathA tumapara koI doSa[1] nahIM ki apane pAlanahAra ke anugraha kI khoja karo, phira jaba tuma arafAta[2] se calo, to mazare ha़rAma (muz2adalifaha) ke pAsa allAha kA smaraNa karo, jisa prakAra allAha ne tumheM batAyA hai| yadyapi isase pahale tuma kupathoM meM se the|
phira tuma[1] bhI vahIM se phiro, jahA~ se loga phirate haiM tathA allAha se kSamA mA~go| nizcaya allAha ati kSamAzIla, dayAvAn hai|

aura jaba tuma apane ha़ja ke manAsika (karma) pUre kara lo, to jisa prakAra pahale apane pUrvajoM kI carcA karate rahe, usI prakAra balki usase bhI adhika allAha kA smaraNa[1] karo| unameM se kucha aise haiM, jo ye kahate haiM ki he hamAre pAlanahAra! (hameM jo denA hai,) saMsAra hI meM de de| ataH aise vyakti ke lie paraloka meM koI bhAga nahIM hai|
tathA unameM se kucha aise haiM, jo ye kahate haiM ki hamAre pAlanahAra! hameM saMsAra meM bhalAI de tathA paraloka meM bhI bhalAI de aura hameM naraka kI yAtanA se surakSita rakha|
inhIM ko inakI kamAI ke kAraNa bhAga milegA aura allAha zIghra ha़isAba cukAne bAlA hai|

tathA ina ginatI[1] ke kucha dinoM meM allAha ko smaraNa (yAda) karo, phira jo vyakti zIghratA se do hI dina meM (minA se) cala[2] de, usapara koI doSa nahIM aura jo vilamba[3] kare, usapara bhI koI doSa nahIM, usa vyakti ke lie jo allAha se DarA tathA tuma allAha se Darate raho aura ye samajha lo ki tuma usI ke pAsa pralaya ke dina ekatra kie jAogo|

(he nabI!) logoM[1] meM aisA vyakti bhI hai, jisakI bAta Apako sAMsArika viSaya meM bhAtI hai tathA jo kucha usake dila meM hai, vaha usapara allAha ko sAkSI banAtA hai, jabaki baha bar3A jhagar3AlU hai|
tathA jaba vaha Apake pAsa se jAtA hai, to dharatI meM upadrava macAne kA prayAsa karatA hai aura khetI tathA pazuoM kA vinAza karatA hai aura allAha upadrava se prema nahIM karatA|
tathA jaba usase kahA jAtA hai ki allAha se Dara, to abhimAna use pApa para ubhAra detA hai| ataH usake (daNDa) ke lie naraka kAfI hai aura vaha bahuta burA bichaunA hai|
tathA logoM meM aisA vyakti bhI hai, jo allAha kI prasannatA kI khoja meM apanA prANa beca[1] detA hai aura allAha apane bhaktoM ke lie ati karuNAmaya hai|
he ImAna vAlo! tuma sarvathA islAma meM praveza[1] kara jAo aura zaitAna kI rAhoM para mata calo, nizcaya vaha tumhArA khulA zatru hai|
phira yadi tuma khule tarkoM (dalIloM)[1] ke Ane ke pazcAta vicalita ho gaye, to jAna lo ki allAha prabhutvazAlI tathA tatvajJa[2] hai|

kyA (ina khule tarkoM ke A jAne ke pazcAt) ve isakI pratIkSA kara rahe haiM ki unake samakSa allAha tathA farizte bAdaloM ke chatra meM A jAyeM aura nirNaya hI kara diyA jAye? aura sabhI viSaya allAha hI kI ora phere[1] jAyeMge|
banI isrAIla se pUcho ki hamane unheM kitanI khulI nizAniyA~ dIM? isapara bhI jisane allAha kI anukampA ko, usake apane pAsa A jAne ke pazcAt badala diyA, to allAha kI yAtanA bhI bahuta kar3I hai|

kAfiroM ke lie sAMsArika jIvana zobhanIya (manohara) banA diyA gayA hai tathA jo ImAna lAye ye unakA upahAsa[1] karate haiM aura pralaya ke dina allAha ke AjJAkArI unase ucca sthAna[1] para raheMge tathA allAha jise cAhe, agaNita AjIvikA pradAna karatA hai|

(AraMbha meM) sabhI mAnava eka hI (svAbhAvika) satdharma para the| (phira vibheda huA) to allAha ne nabiyoM ko zubha samAcAra sunAne[1] aura (avajJA) se saceta karane ke lie bhejA aura unapara satya ke sAtha pustaka utArI, tAki ve jina bAtoM meM vibheda kara rahe haiM, unakA nirNaya kara de| aura ApakI durAgraha ke kAraNa unhoMne hI vibheda kiyA, jinheM (vibheda nivAraNa ke lie) ye pustaka dI gayI| (albattA) jo ImAna lAye, allAha ne usa vibheda meM unheM apanI anumati se satpatha darzA diyA aura allAha jise cAhe, satpatha darzA detA hai|

kyA tumane samajha rakhA hai ki yU~ hI svarga meM praveza kara jAoge, ha़AlA~ki abhI taka tumhArI vaha dazA nahIM huI, jo tumase pUrva ke ImAna vAloM kI huI? unheM taMgiyoM tathA ApadAoM ne ghera liyA aura ve jhaMjhor3a diye gaye, yahA~ taka ki rasUla aura jo usapara ImAna lAye, guhArane lage ki allAha kI sahAyatA kaba AyegI? (usa samaya kahA gayAH)suna lo! allAha kI sahAyatA samIpa[1] hai|

(he nabI!) ve Apase prazna karate haiM ki kaise vyaya (qharca) kareM? unase kaha dIjiye ki jo bhI dhana tuma qharca karo, to apane mAtA-pitA, samIpavartiyoM, anAthoM, nirdhanoM tathA yAtriyoM (ko do)| tathA jo bhI bhalAI tuma karate ho, use allAha bhali-bhA~ti jAnatA hai|

(he ImAna vAlo!) tumapara yudhda karanA anivArya kara diyA gayA hai, ha़lA~ki vaha tumheM apriya hai| ho sakatA hai ki koI cIz2a tumheM apriya ho aura vahI tumhAre lie acchI ho aura isI prakAra sambhava hai ki koI cIz2a tumheM priya ho aura vaha tumhAre lie burI ho| allAha jAnatA hai aura tuma nahIM[1] jAnate|

(he nabI!) ve[1] Apase prazna karate haiM ki sammAnita mAsa meM yudhda karanA kaisA hai? Apa unase kaha deM ki usameM yudhda karanA ghora pApa hai, parantu allAha kI rAha se rokanA, usakA inkAra karanA, masjide ha़rAma se rokanA aura usake nivAsiyoM ko usase nikAlanA, allAha ke samIpa usase bhI ghora pApa hai tathA fitanA (satdharma se vicalAnA) hatyA se bhI bhArI hai| aura ve to tumase yudhda karate hI jAyeMge, yahA~ taka ki unake basa meM ho, to tumheM tumhAre dharma se phera deM aura tumameM se jo vyakti apane dharma (islAma) se phira jAyegA, phira kufra para hI usakI mauta hogI, aisoM kA kiyA-karAyA, saMsAra tathA paraloka meM vyartha ho jAyegA tathA vahI nArakI haiM aura ve usameM sadAvAsI hoMge|
(isake viparIta) jo loga ImAna lAye, hijarata[1] kI tathA allAha kI rAha meM jihAda kiyA, vAstava meM, vahI allAha kI dayA kI AzA rakhate haiM tathA allAha ati kSamAzIla aura bahuta dayAlu hai|

(he nabI!) ve Apase madirA aura juA ke viSaya meM prazna karate haiM| Apa batA deM ki ina donoM meM bar3A pApa hai tathA logoM kA kucha lAbha bhI hai; parantu unakA pApa unake lAbha se adhika[1] bar3A hai| tathA ve Apase prazna karate haiM ki allAha kI rAha meM kyA qharca kareM? unase kaha dIjiye ki jo apanI AvazyaktA se adhika ho| isI prakAra allAha tumhAre lie AyatoM (dharmAdezoM) ko ujAgara karatA hai, tAki tuma soca-vicAra karo|

duniyA aura Aqharita dono meM aura ve Apase anAthoM ke viSaya meM prazNa karate haiM| unase kaha dIjie ki jisa bAta meM unakA sudhAra ho vahI sabase acchI hai| yadi tuma unase milakara raho, to ve tumhAre bhAI hI haiM aura allAha jAnatA hai ki kauna sudhArane aura kauna bigAr3ane vAlA hai aura yadi allAha cAhatA, to tumapara sakhtI[1] kara detA| vAstava meM, allAha prabhutvazAlI, tatvajJa hai|

tathA muzrika[1] striyoM se tuma vivAha na karo, jaba taka ve ImAna na lAyeM aura ImAna vAlI dAsI muzrika strI se uttama hai, yadyapi vaha tumhAre mana ko bhA rahI ho aura apanI striyoM kA nikAha़ muzrikoM se na karo, jaba taka ve ImAna na lAyeM aura ImAna vAlA dAsa muzrika se uttama hai, yadyapi vaha tumheM bhA rahA ho| ve tumheM agni kI ora bulAte haiM tathA allAha svarga aura kSamA kI ora bulA rahA hai aura (allAha) sabhI mAnava ke lie apanI AyateM (Adeza) ujAgara kara rahA hai, tAki vaha zikSA grahana kareM|

tathA ve Apase mAsika dharma ke viSaya meM pUchate haiM| Apa kaha deM: vaha eka taraha kI gaMdagI hai| ataH mAsika dharma kI sthiti meM auratoM se alaga raho aura unake pAsa na jAo, yahA~ taka ki ve pAka ho jAe~| phira jaba ve (snAna karake) pAka-sAfa ho jAe~, to unake pAsa Ao, jahA~ se allAha ne tumheM anumati dI hai| niHsaMdeha allAha unase prema karatA hai jo bahuta taubA karane vAle haiM aura unase prema karatA hai jo bahuta pAka rahane vAle haiM|

tumhArI patniyA~ tumhAre lie khetiyA~[1] haiM| tumheM anumati hai ki jaise cAho, apanI khetiyoM meM jAo; parantu bhaviSya ke lie bhI satkarma karo tathA allAha se Darate raho aura vizvAsa rakho ki tumheM usase milanA hai aura ImAna vAloM ko zubha sUcanA sunA do|
tathA allAha ke nAma para, apanI zapathoM ko upakAra tathA sadAcAra aura logoM meM milApa karAne ke lie roka[1] na banAo aura allAha saba kucha sunatA-jAnatA hai|
allAha tamhArI nirarthaka zapathoM para tumheM nahIM pakar3egA, parantu jo zapatha apane diloM ke saMkalpa se loge, unapara pakar3egA aura allAha ati kSamAzIla, sahanazIla hai|
tathA jo loga apanI patniyoM se saMbhoga na karane kI zapatha lete hoM, ve cAra mahIne pratIkSA kareM| phira[1] yadi (isa bIca) apanI zapatha se phira jAyeM, to allAha ati kSamAzIla, dayAvAn hai|
aura yadi unhoMne talAqa kA saMkalpa le liyA ho, to niHsaMdeha allAha saba kucha sunatA aura jAnatA hai|

tathA jina striyoM ko talAqa dI gayI ho, ve tIna bAra rajavatI hone taka apane Apako vivAha se roke rakheM| unake lie ha़lAla (vaidha) nahIM hai ki allAha ne jo unake garbhAzayoM meM paidA kiyA[1] hai, use chupAyeM, yadi ve allAha tathA Aqhirata (paraloka) para ImAna rakhatI hoM tathA unake pati isa avadhi meM apanI patniyoM ko lauTA lene ke adhikArI[2] haiM, yadi ve milApa[3] cAhate hoM tathA sAmAnya niyamAnusAra striyoM[4] ke lie vaise hI adhikAra haiM, jaise puruSoM ke unake Upara haiM| phira bhI puruSoM ko striyoM para eka pradhAnatA prApta hai aura allAha ati prabhutvazAlI, tatvajJa hai|

talAqa do bAra hai; phira niyamAnusAra strI ko roka liyA jAye yA bhalI-bhA~ti vidA kara diyA jAye aura tumhAre lie ye ha़lAla (vaidha) nahIM hai ki unheM jo kucha tumane diyA hai, usameM se kucha vApisa lo| phira yadi tumheM ye bhaya[1] ho ki pati patni allAha kI nirdhArita sImAoM ko sthApita na rakha sakeMge, to una donoM para koI doSa nahIM ki patni apane pati ko kucha dekara mukti[2] karA le| ye allAha kI sImAyeM haiM, inakA ullaMghana na karo aura jo allAha kI sImAoM kA ullaMghana kareMge, vahI atyAcArI haiM|

phira yadi use (tIsarI bAra) talAqa de dI, to vaha strI usake lie ha़lAla (vaidha) nahIM hogI, jaba taka dUsare pati se vivAha na kara le| aba yadi dUsarA pati (saMbhoga ke pazcAt) use talAka de de, taba prathama pati se (nirdhArita avadhi pUrI karake) phira vivAha kara sakatI hai, yadi ve donoM samajhate hoM ki allAha kI sImAoM ko sthApita rakha[1] sakeMge aura ye allAha kI sImAyeM haiM, jinheM una logoM ke lie ujAgara kara rahA hai, jo jJAna rakhate haiM|

aura yadi striyoM ko (eka yA do) talAqa de do aura unakI nirdhArita avadhi (iddata) pUrI hone lage, to niyamAnusAra unheM roka lo athavA niyamAnusAra vidA kara do| unheM hAni pahu~cAne ke lie na roko, tAki unapara atyAcAra karo aura jo koI aisA karegA, vaha svayaM apane Upara atyAcAra karegA tathA allAha kI AyatoM (AdezoM) ko upahAsa na banAo aura apane Upara allAha ke upakAra tathA pustaka (qurAna) evaM ha़ikmata (sunnata) ko yAda karo, jinheM usane tumapara utArA hai aura unake dvArA tumheM zikSA de rahA hai tathA allAha se Daro aura vizvAsa rakho ki allAha saba kucha jAnatA hai|[1]

aura jaba tuma apanI patniyoM ko (tIna se kama) talAqa do aura ve apanI nizcita avadhi (iddata) pUrI kara leM, to (striyoM ke saMrakSako!) unheM apane patiyoM se vivAha karane se na roko, jabaki sAmAnya niyamAnusAra ve Apasa meM vivAha karane para sahamata hoM, ye tumameM se use nirdeza diyA jA rahA hai, jo allAha tathA aMtima dina (pralaya) para ImAna (vizvAsa) rakhatA hai, yahI tumhAre lie adhika svaccha tathA pavitra hai aura allAha jAnatA hai, tuma nahIM jAnate|

aura mAtAyeM apane baccoM ko pUre do varSa dUdha pilAyeM aura pitA ko niyamAnusAra unheM khAnA-kapar3A denA hai, kisI para usakI sakata se adhika bhAra nahIM DAlA jAyegA; na mAtA ko usake bacce ke kAraNa hAni pahu~cAI jAye aura na pitA ko usake bacce ke kAraNa| aura isI prakAra usa (pitA) ke vArisa (uttarAdhikArI) para (khAnA kapar3A dene kA) bhAra hai| phira yadi donoM Apasa kI sahamati tathA prAmarza se (do varSa se pahale) dUdha chur3AnA cAheM, to donoM para koI doSa nahIM aura yadi (tumhArA vicAra kisI anya strI se) dUdha pilavAne kA ho, to isameM bhI tumapara koI doSa nahIM, jabaki jo kucha niyamAnusAra use denA hai, use cukA do tathA allAha se Darate raho aura jAna lo ki tuma jo kucha karate ho, use allAha dekha rahA[1] hai|

aura tumameM se jo mara jAyeM aura apane pIche patniyA~ chor3a jAyeM, to ve svayaM ko cAra mahIne dasa dina roke rakheM|[1] phira jaba unakI avadhi pUrI ho jAye, to ve sAmAnya niyamAnusAra apane viSaya meM jo bhI kareM, usameM tumapara koI doSa[2] nahIM tathA allAha tumhAre karmoM se sUcita hai|

isa avadhi meM yadi tuma (una) striyoM ko vivAha kA saMketa do athavA apane mana meM chupAye rakho, to tumapara koI doSa nahIM| allAha jAnatA hai ki unakA vicAra tumhAre mana meM AyegA, parantu unheM gupta rUpa se vivAha kA vacana na do| parantu ye ki niyamAnusAra[1] koI bAta kaho tathA vivAha ke baMdhana kA nizcaya usa samaya taka na karo, jaba taka nirdhArita avadhi pUrI na ho jAye[2] tathA jAna lo ki jo kucha tumhAre mana meM hai, use allAha jAnatA hai| ataH usase Darate raho aura jAna lo ki allAha kSamAzIla, sahanazIla hai|

aura tumapara koI doSa nahIM, yadi tuma striyoM ko saMbhoga karane tathA mahara (vivAha upahAra) nirdhArita karane se pahale talAqa de do, (albattA) unheM niyamAnusAra kucha do; dhanI para apanI zakti ke anusAra tathA nirdhana para apanI zakti ke anusAra denA hai| ye upakAriyoM para Avazyaka hai|

aura yadi tuma unaheM, unase saMbhoga karane se pahale talAqa do, isa sthiti meM ki tumane unake lie mahara (vivAha upahAra) nirdhArita kiyA hai, to nirdhArita mahara kA AdhA denA anivArya hai| ye aura bAta hai ki ve kSamA kara deM athavA ve kSamA kara deM jinake hAtha meM vivAha kA baMdhana[1] hai aura kSamA kara denA saMyama se adhika samIpa hai aura Apasa meM upakAra ko na bhUlo| tuma jo kucha kara rahe ho, allAha saba dekha rahA hai|
namAz2oM kA, vizeSa rUpa se mAdhyamika namAz2a (asra) kA dhyAna rakho[1] tathA allAha ke lie vinaya pUrvaka khar3e raho|

aura yadi tumheM bhaya[1] ho, to paidala yA savAra (jaise sambhava ho) namAz2a par3ho, phira jaba nizciMta ho jAo, to allAha ne tumheM jaise sikhAyA hai, jise pahale tuma nahIM jAnate the, vaise allAha ko yAda karo|

aura jo tumameM se mara jAyeM tathA patniyA~ chor3a jAyeM, ve apanI patniyoM ke lie eka varSa taka, unaheM kharca dene tathA (ghara se) na nikAlane kI vasiyyata kara jAyeM, yadi ve svayaM nikala jAyeM[1] tathA sAmAnya niyamAnusAra apane viSaya meM kucha bhI kareM, to tumapara koI doSa nahIM| allAha prabhAvazAlI tatvajJa hai|
tathA jina striyoM ko talAqa dI gayI ho, to unheM bhI ucita rUpa se sAmagrI milanI cAhie| ye AjJAkAriyoM para Avazyaka hai|
isI prakAra allAha tumhAre lie apanI AyatoM ko ujAgara kara detA hai, tAki tuma samajho|

kyA Apane unakI dazA para vicAra nahIM kiyA, jo apane gharoM se mauta ke bhaya se nikala gaye[1], jabaki unakI saMkhyA haz2AroM meM thI, to allAha ne unase kahA ki mara jAo, phira unheM jIvita kara diyA| vAstava meM, allAha logoM ke lie bar3A upakArI hai, parantu adhikAMza loga kRtajJatA nahIM karate|[1]
aura tuma allAha (ke dharma ke samarthana) ke lie yudhda karo aura jAna lo ki allAha saba kucha sunatA-jAnatA hai|
kauna hai, jo allAha ko acchA udhAra[1] detA hai, tAki allAha use usake lie kaI gunA adhika kara de? aura allAha hI thor3A aura adhika karatA hai aura usI kI ora tuma saba phere jAoge|

(he nabI!) kyA Apane banI isrAIla ke pramukhoM ke viSaya para vicAra nahIM kiyA, jo mUsA ke bAda sAmane AyA? jaba usane apane nabI se kahAH hamAre lie eka rAjA banA do| hama allAha kI rAha meM yudhda kareMge, (nabI ne) kahAH aisA to nahIM hogA ki tumheM yudhda kA Adeza de diyA jAye to avajJA kara jAo? unhoMne kahAH aisA nahIM ho sakatA ki hama allAha kI rAha meM yudhda na kareM| jabaki hama apane gharoM aura apane putroM se nikAla diye gaye haiM| parantu, jaba unheM yudhda kA Adeza de diyA gayA, to unameM se thor3e ke sivA saba phira gaye| aura allAha atyAcAriyoM ko bhalI bhA~ti jAnatA hai|

tathA unake nabI ne kahAH allAha ne 'tAlUta' ko tumhArA rAjA banA diyA hai| ve kahane lageH 'tAlUta' hamArA rAjA kaise ho sakatA hai? hama usase adhika rAjya kA adhikAra rakhate haiM, vaha to bar3A dhanI bhI nahIM hai| (nabI ne) kahAH allAha ne use tumapara nirvAcita kiyA hai aura use adhika jJAna tathA zArIrika bala pradAna kiyA hai aura allAha jise cAhe, apanA rAjya pradAna kare tathA allAha hI vizAla, ati jJAnI[1] hai|

tathA unake nabI ne unase kahAH usake rAjya kA lakSaNa ye hai ki vaha tAbUta tumhAre pAsa AyegA, jisameM tumhAre pAlanahAra kI ora se tumhAre lie saMtoSa tathA mUsA aura hArUna ke gharAne ke chor3e hue avazeSa haiM, use farizte uThAye hue hoMge| nizcaya yadi tuma ImAna vAle ho, to isameM tumhAre lie bar3I nizAnI[1] (lakSaNa) hai|

phira jaba tAlUta senA lekara calA, to usane kahAH nizcaya allAha eka nahara dvArA tumhArI parIkSA lene vAlA hai| jo usameM se piyegA vaha merA sAtha nahIM degA aura jo use nahIM cakhegA, vaha merA sAtha degA, parantu jo apane hAtha se cullU bhara pI le, (to koI doSa nahIM)| to thor3e ke sivA sabane usameM se pI liyA| phira jaba usa (tAlUta) ne aura jo usake sAtha ImAna lAye, use (nahara ko) pAra kiyA, to kahAH Aja hamameM (zatru) jAlUta aura usakI senA se yudhda karane kI zakti nahIM| (parantu) jo samajha rahe the ki unheM allAha se milanA hai, unhoMne kahAH bahuta-se choTe dala, allAha kI anumati se, bhArI daloM para vijaya prApta kara cuke haiM aura allAha sahanazIloM ke sAtha hai|

aura jaba ve, jAlUta aura usakI senA ke sammukha hue, to prArthanA kIH he hamAre pAlanahAra! hameM dhairya pradAna kara tathA hamAre caraNoM ko (raNakSetra meM) sthira kara de aura kAfiroM para hamArI sahAyatA kara|

to unhoMne allAha kI anumati se unheM parAjita kara diyA aura dAvUda ne jAlUta ko vadha kara diyA tathA allAha ne use (dAvUda[1] ko) rAjya aura ha़ikmata (nubUvata) pradAna kI tathA use jo jJAna cAhA, diyA aura yadi allAha kucha logoM kI kucha logoM dvArA rakSA na karatA, to dharatI kI vyavasthA bigar3a jAtI, parantu saMsAra vAsiyoM para allAha bar3A dayAzIla hai|
(he nabI!) ye allAha kI AyateM haiM, jo hama Apako sunA rahe haiM tathA vAstava meM, Apa rasUloM meM se haiM|

vo rasUla haiM| unaheM hamane eka-dUsare para pradhAnatA dI hai| unameM se kucha ne allAha se bAta kI aura kucha ko kaI zreNiyA~ U~cA kiyA tathA maryama ke putra IsA ko khulI nizAniyA~ dIM aura rUha़ulaqudusa[1] dvArA use samarthana diyA aura yadi allAha cAhatA, to ina rasUloM ke pazcAt khulI nizAniyA~ A jAne para loga Apasa meM na lar3ate, parantu unhoMne vibheda kiyA, to unameM se koI ImAna lAyA aura kisI ne kufra kiyA aura yadi allAha cAhatA, to ve nahIM lar3ate, parantu allAha jo cAhatA hai, karatA hai|

he ImAna vAlo! hamane tumheM jo kucha diyA hai, usameM se dAna karo, usa dina (arthAtaH pralaya) ke Ane se pahale, jisameM na koI saudA hogA, na koI maitrI aura na hI koI anuzaMsA (sifAriza) kAma AegI tathA kAfira loga[1] hI atyAcArI[2] haiM|

allAha ke sivA koI pUjya nahIM, vaha jIvita[1] tathA nitya sthAyI hai, use U~gha tathA nidrA nahIM AtI| AkAza aura dharatI meM jo kucha hai, saba usI kA[2] hai| kauna hai, jo usake pAsa usakI anumati ke binA anuzaMsA (sifAriza) kara sake? jo kucha unake samakSa aura jo kucha unase ojhala hai, saba jAnatA hai| usake jJAna meM se vahI jAna sakate haiM, jise vaha cAhe| usakI kursI AkAza tathA dharatI ko samoye hue hai| una donoM kI rakSA use nahIM thakAtI| vahI sarvocca[3], mahAna hai|

dharma meM bala prayoga nahIM| supatha, kupatha se alaga ho cukA hai| ataH, aba jo tAg2Uta (arthAta allAha ke sivA pUjyoM) ko nakAra de tathA allAha para ImAna lAye, to usane dRr3ha kar3A (sahArA) pakar3a liyA, jo kabhI khaNDita nahIM ho sakatA tathA allAha saba kucha sunatA-jAnatA[1] hai|

allAha unakA sahAyaka hai, jo ImAna lAye| vaha unaheM aMdheroM se nikAlatA hai aura prakAza meM lAtA hai aura jo kAfira (vizvAsahIna) haiM, unake sahAyaka tAg2Uta (unake mithyA pUjya) haiM| jo unheM prakAza se aMdheroM kI aura le jAte haiM| yahI nArakI haiM, jo usameM sadAvAsI hoMge|

(he nabI!) kyA Apane usa vyakti kI dazA para vicAra nahIM kiyA, jisane ibrAhIma se usake pAlanahAra ke viSaya meM vivAda kiyA, isalie ki allAha ne use rAjya diyA thA? jaba ibrAhIma ne kahAH merA pAlanahAra vo hai, jo jIvita karatA tathA mAratA hai, to usane kahAH maiM bhI jIvita[1] karatA tathA mAratA hU~| ibrAhIma ne kahAH allAha sUrya ko pUrva se lAtA hai, tU use pazcima se le A! (ye sunakara) kAfira cakita raha gayA aura allAha atyAcAriyoM ko mArgadarzana nahIM detA|

athavA usa vyakti ke prakAra, jo eka aisI nagarI se guz2arA, jo apanI chatoM sahita dhvasta par3I thI? usane kahAH allAha isake dhvasta ho jAne ke pazcAt ise kaise jIvita (AbAda) karegA? phira allAha ne use sau varSa taka mauta de dI| phira use jIvita kiyA aura kahAH tuma kitanI avadhi taka murdA par3e rahe? usane kahAH eka dina athavA dina ke kucha kSaNa| (allAha ne) kahAH balki tuma sau varSa taka par3e rahe| apane khAne pIne ko dekho ki tanika parivartana nahIM huA hai tathA apane gadhe kI ora dekho, tAkI hama tumheM logoM ke lie eka nizAnI (cinha) banA deM tathA (gadhe kI) asthiyoM ko dekho ki hama unheM kaise khar3A karate haiM aura unapara kaise mA~sa car3hAte haiM? isa prakAra jaba usake samakSa bAteM ujAgara ho gayIM, to vaha[1] pukAra uThA ki majhe (pratyakSa) jJAna ho gayA ki allAha jo cAhe, kara sakatA hai|

tathA (yAda karo) jaba ibrAhIma ne kahAH he mere pAlanahAra! mujhe dikhA de ki tU murdoM ko kaise jIvita kara detA hai? (allAha ne) kahAH kyA tuma ImAna nahIM lAye? usane kahAH kyoM nahIM? parantu tAki mere dila ko saMtoSa ho jAye| allAha ne kahAH cAra pakSI le Ao aura unaheM apane se paracA lo| (phira unheM vadha karake) unakA eka-eka aMza (bhAga) parvata para rakha do| phira unheM pukAro| ve tumhAre pAsa daur3e cale AyeMge aura ye jAna le ki allAha prabhutvazAlI, tatvajJa hai|

jo allAha kI rAha meM apanA dhana dAna karate haiM, usa (dAna) kI dazA usa eka dAne jaisI hai, jisane sAta bAliyA~ ugAyI hoM| (usakI) pratyeka bAlI meM sau dAne hoM aura allAha jise cAhe aura bhI adhika detA hai tathA allAha vizAla[1], jJAnI hai|

jo apanA dhana allAha kI rAha meM dAna karate haiM, phira dAna karane ke pazcAt upakAra nahIM jatAte aura na (jise diyA ho use) duHkha dete haiM, unhIM ke lie unake pAlanahAra ke pAsa unakA pratikAra (badalA) hai aura unapara koI Dara nahIM hogA aura na hI ve udAsIna[1] hoMge|
bhalI bAta bolanA tathA kSamA, usa dAna se uttama hai, jisake pazcAt duHkha diyA jAye tathA allAha nispRha, sahanazIla hai|

he ImAna vAlo! usa vyakti ke samAna upakAra jatAkara tathA duHkha dekara, apane dAnoM ko vyartha na karo, jo logoM ko dikhAne ke lie dAna karatA hai aura allAha tathA antima dina (paraloka) para ImAna nahIM rakhatA| usakA udAharaNa usa caTela patthara jaisA hai, jisapara miTTI par3I ho aura usapara ghora varSA ho jAye aura usa (patthara) ko caTela chor3a de| ve apanI kamAI kA kucha bhI na pA sakeMge aura allAha kAfiroM ko sIdhI Dagara nahIM dikhAtA|

tathA unakI upamA, jo apanA dhana allAha kI prasannatA kI icchA meM apane mana kI sthiratA ke sAtha dAna karate haiM, usa bAg2a (udyAna) jaisI hai, jo pRthvI tala ke kisI U~ce bhAga para ho, usapara ghora varSA huI, to dogunA phala lAyA aura yadi ghora varSA nahIM huI, to (usake lie) phuhAra hI basa[1] ho tathA tuma jo kucha kara rahe ho, use allAha dekha rahA hai|

kyA tumameM se koI cAhegA ki usake khajUra tathA a~gUroM ke bAg2a hoM, jinameM nahareM baha rahI hoM, unameM usake lie pratyeka prakAra ke phala hoM tathA vaha bUr3hA ho gayA ho aura usake nirbala bacce hoM, phira vaha bagola ke AghAta se jisameM Aga ho, jhulasa jAye|[1] isI prakAra allAha tumhAre lie AyateM ujAgara karatA hai, tAki tuma soca vicAra karo|

he ImAna vAlo! una svaccha cIjoM meM se, jo tumane kamAI haiM tathA una cIz2oM meM se, jo hamane tumhAre lie dharatI se upajAyI haiM, dAna karo tathA usameM se usa cIz2a ko dAna karane kA nizcaya na karo, jise tuma svayaM na le sako, parantu ye ki anadekhI kara jAo tathA jAna lo ki allAha niHspRha, prazaMsita hai|
zaitAna tumheM nirdhanatA se DarAtA hai tathA nirlajjA kI preraNA detA hai tathA allAha tumheM apanI kSamA aura adhika dene kA vacana detA hai tathA allAha vizAla jJAnI hai|
vaha jise cAhe, prabodha (dharma kI samajha) pradAna karatA hai aura jise prabodha pradAna kara diyA gayA, use bar3A kalyANa mila gayA aura samajha vAle hI zikSA grahaNa karate haiM|
tathA tuma jo bhI dAna karo athavA manautI[1] mAno, allAha use jAnatA hai tathA atyAcAriyoM kA koI sahAyaka na hogA|

yadi tuma khule dAna karo, to vaha bhI acchA hai tathA yadI chupAkara karo aura kaMgAloM ko do, to vaha tumhAre lie adhika acchA[1] hai| ye tumase tumhAre pApoM ko dUra kara degA tathA tuma jo kucha kara rahe ho, usase allAha sUcita hai|

unheM sIdhI Dagara para lagA denA, ApakA dAyitva nahIM, parantu allAha jise cAhe, sIdhI Dagara para lagA detA hai tathA tuma jo bhI dAna dete ho, to apane lAbha ke lie dete ho tathA tuma allAha kI prasannatA prApta karane ke lie hI dete ho tathA tuma jo bhI dAna doge, tumheM usakA bhara pUra pratiphala (badalA) diyA jAyegA aura tumapara atyAcAra[1] nahIM kiyA jAyegA|

dAna una nirdhanoM (kaMgAloM) ke lie hai, jo allAha kI rAha meM aise ghira gaye hoM ki dharatI meM daur3a-bhAga na kara[1] sakate hoM, unheM ajJAna loga na mA~gane ke kAraNa dhanI samajhate haiM, ve logoM ke pIche par3a kara nahIM mA~gate| tuma unheM unake lakSaNoM se pahacAna loge tathA jo bhI dhana tuma dAna karoge, niHsaMdeha allAha use bhali-bhA~ti jAnane vAlA hai|
jo loga apanA dhana rAta-dina khule-chupe dAna karate haiM, to unhIM ke lie unake pAlanahAra ke pAsa, unakA pratiphala (badalA) hai aura unheM koI Dara nahIM hogA aura na ve udAsIna hoMge|

jo loga byAja khAte haiM, aise uTheMge jaise vaha uThatA hai, jise zaitAna ne chUkara unamatta kara diyA ho| unakI ye dazA isa kAraNa hogI ki unhoMne kahA ki vyApAra bhI to byAja hI jaisA hai, jabaki allAha ne vyApAra ko ha़lAla (vaidha), tathA byAja ko ha़rAma (avaidha) kara[1] diyA hai| aba jisake pAsa usake pAlanahAra kI ora se nirdeza A gayA aura isa kAraNa usase ruka gayA, to jo kucha pahale liyA, vaha usI kA ho gayA tathA usakA mAmalA allAha ke ha़vAle hai aura jo (loga) phira vahI kareM, to vahI nArakI haiM, jo usameM sadAvAsI hoMge|
allAha byAja ko miTAtA hai aura dAnoM ko bar3hAtA hai aura allAha kisI kRtaghna, ghora pApI se prema nahIM karatA|

vAstava meM, jo ImAna lAye, sadAcAra kiye, namAz2a kI sthApnA karate rahe aura z2akAta dete rahe, unhIM ke lie unake pAlanahAra ke pAsa unakA pratiphala hai aura unheM koI Dara nahIM hogA aura na ve udAsIna hoMge|
he ImAna vAlo! allAha se Daro aura jo byAja zeSa raha gayA hai, use chor3a do, yadi tuma ImAna rakhane vAle ho to|

aura yadi tumane aisA nahIM kiyA, to allAha tathA usake rasUla se yudhda ke lie taiyAra ho jAo aura yadi tuma taubA (kSamA yAcanA) kara lo, to tumhAre lie tumhArA mUladhana hai| na tuma atyAcAra karo[1], na tumapara atyAcAra kiyA jAye|
aura yadi tumhArA RNi asuvidhA meM ho, to use suvidhA taka avasara do aura agara kSamA kara do, (arthAta dAna kara do) to ye tumhAre lie adhika acchA hai, yadi tuma samajho to|
tathA usa dina se Daro, jisameM tuma allAha kI ora phere jAoge, phira pratyeka prANI ko usakI kamAI kA bharapUra pratikAra diyA jAyegA tathA kisI para atyAcAra na hogA|

he ImAna vAlo! jaba tuma Apasa meM kisI nizcita avadhi taka ke lie udhAra lena-dena karo, to use likha liyA karo, tumhAre bIca nyAya ke sAtha koI lekhaka likhe, jise allAha ne likhane kI yogyatA dI hai, vaha likhane se inkAra na kare tathA vaha likhavAye, jisapara udhAra hai aura apane pAlanahAra allAha se Dare aura usameM se kucha kama na kare| yadi jisapara udhAra hai, vaha nirbodha athavA nirbala ho athavA likhavA na sakatA ho, to usakA saMrakSaka nyAya ke sAtha likhavAye tathA apane meM se do puruSoM ko sAkSI (gavAha) banA lo| yadi do puruSa na hoM, to eka puruSa tathA do striyoM ko, una sAkSiyoM meM se, jinheM sAkSI banAnA pasanda karo| tAki donoM (striyoM) meM se eka bhUla jAye, to dUsarI yAda dilA de tathA jaba sAkSI bulAye jAyeM, to inkAra na kareM tathA viSaya choTA ho yA bar3A, usakI avadhi sahita likhavAne meM Alasya na karo, ye allAha ke samIpa adhika nyAya hai tathA sAkSya ke lie adhika sahAyaka aura isase adhika samIpa hai ki saMdeha na karo| parantu yadi tuma vyApArika lena-dena hAthoM-hAtha (nagada karate ho), to tumapara koI doSa nahIM ki use na likho tathA jaba Apasa meM lena-dena karo, to sAkSI banA lo aura lekhaka tathA sAkSI ko hAni na pahu~cAI jAye aura yadi aisA karogo, to tumhArI avajJA hI hogI tathA allAha se Daro aura allAha tumheM sikhA rahA hai aura niHsaMdeha allAha saba kucha jAnatA hai|

aura yadi tuma yAtrA meM raho tathA likhane ke lie kisI ko na pAo, to dharohara rakha do aura yadi tumameM paraspara eka-dUsare para bharosA ho, (to dharohara kI bhI AvazyaktA nahIM,) jisapara amAnata (udhAra) hai, vaha use cukA de tathA allAha (apane pAlanahAra) se Dare aura sAkSya na chupAo aura jo use chupAyegA, usakA dila pApI hai tathA tuma jo karate ho, allAha saba jAnatA hai|

AkAzoM tathA dharatI meM jo kucha hai, saba allAha kA hai aura jo tumhAre mana meM hai, use bolo athavA mana hI meM rakho, allAha tumase usakA ha़isAba legA| phira jise cAhe, kSamA kara degA aura jise cAhe, daNDa degA aura allAha jo cAhe, kara sakatA hai|

rasUla usa cIz2a para ImAna lAyA, jo usake lie allAha kI ora se utArI gaI tathA saba ImAna vAle usapara ImAna lAye| ve saba allAha tathA usake fariztoM aura usakI saba pustakoM evaM rasUloM para ImAna lAye| (ve kahate haiH) hama usake rasUloM meM se kisI ke bIca antara nahIM karate| hamane sunA aura hama AjJAkArI ho gaye| he hamAre pAlanahAra! hameM kSamA kara de aura hameM tere hI pAsa[1] AnA hai|

allAha kisI prANI para usakI sakata se adhika (dAyitva kA) bhAra nahIM rakhatA| jo sadAcAra karegA, usakA lAbha usI ko milegA aura jo durAcAra karegA, usakI hAni bhI usI ko hogI| he hamAre pAlanahAra! yadi hama bhUla cUka jAyeM, to hameM na pakar3a| he hamAre pAlanahAra! hamAre Upara itanA bojha na DAla, jitanA hamase pahale ke logoM para DAlA gayA| he hamAre pAlanahAra! hamAre pApoM kI anadekhI kara de, hameM kSamA kara de tathA hamapara dayA kara| tU hI hamArA svAmI hai tathA kAfiroM ke virudhda hamArI sahAyatA kara|
alifa, lAma, mIma|
allAha ke sivA koI pUjya nahIM, vaha jIvita, nitya sthAyI hai|
usIne Apapara satya ke sAtha pustaka (qurAna) utArI hai, jo isase pahale kI pustakoM ke lie pramANakArI hai aura usIne taurAta tathA iMjIla utArI hai|
isase pUrva, logoM ke mArgadarzana ke lie aura furqAna utArA hai[1] tathA jinhoMne allAha kI AyatoM ko asvIkAra kiyA, unhIM ke lie kar3I yAtanA hai aura allAha prabhutvazAlI, badalA lene vAlA hai|
niHsaMdeha allAha se AkAzoM tathA dharatI kI koI cIz2a chupI nahIM hai|
vahI tumhArA rUpa AkAra garbhASayoM meM jaise cAhatA hai, banAtA hai| koI pUjya nahIM, parantu vahI prabhutvazAlI, tatvajJa|

usIne Apapara[1] ye pustaka (qurAna) utArI hai, jisameM kucha AyateM muha़kama[2] (sudRr3ha) haiM, jo pustaka kA mUla AdhAra haiM tathA kucha dUsarI mutazAbiha[3] (saMdigdha) haiM| to jinake diloM meM kuTilatA hai, ve upadrava kI khoja tathA manamAnA artha karane ke lie, saMdigdha ke pIche par3a jAte haiM| jabaki unakA vAstavika artha, allAha ke sivA koI nahIM jAnatA tathA jo jJAna meM pakke haiM, ve kahate haiM ki saba, hamAre pAlanahAra ke pAsa se hai aura budhdimAna loga hI zikSA grahaNa karate haiM|
(tathA kahate haiH) he hamAre pAlanahAra! hamAre diloM ko, hameM mArgadarzana dene ke pazcAt kuTila na kara, vAstava meM, tU bahuta bar3A dAtA hai|
he mAre pAlanahAra! tU usa dina sabako ekatra karane vAlA hai, jisameM koI saMdeha nahIM| niHsaMdeha allAha apane nirdhArita samaya kA virudhda nahIM karatA|
nizcaya jo qAfira ho gaye, unake dhana tathA unakI saMtAna allAha (kI yAtanA) se (bacAne meM) unake kucha kAma nahIM AyegI tathA vahI agni ke IMdhana baneMge|
jaise firaauniyoM tathA unake pahale logoM kI dazA huI, unhoMne hamArI nizAniyoM ko mithyA kahA, to allAha ne unake pApoM ke kAraNa unako dhara liyA tathA allAha kar3A daNDa dene vAlA hai|
(he nabI!) kAfiroM se kaha do ki tuma zIghra hI prAsta kara diye jAoge tathA naraka kI ora ekatra kiye jAoge aura vaha bahuta burA ThikAnA[1] hai|

vAstava meM, tumhAre lie una do daloM meM, jo (badra meM) sammukha ho gaye, eka nizAnI thI; eka allAha kI rAha meM yudhda kara rahA thA tathA dUsarA kAfira thA, ve (arthAta kAfira giroha ke loga) apanI A~khoM se dekha rahe the ki ye (musalamAna) to dugane laga rahe haiM tathA allAha apanI sahAyatA dvArA jise cAhe, samarthana detA hai| niHsaMdeha isameM samajha-bUjha vAloM ke lie bar3I zikSA[1] hai|

logoM ke lie unake manako mohane vAlI cIz2eM, jaise striyA~, saMtAna, sone cA~dI ke Dhera, nizAna lage ghor3e, pazuoM tathA khetI zobhanIya banA dI gaI haiM| ye saba sAMsArika jIvana ke upabhogya haiM aura uttama AvAsa allAha ke pAsa hai|

(he nabI!) kaha doH kyA maiM tumheM isase uttama cIz2a batA dU~? unake lie jo DareM, unake pAlanahAra ke pAsa aise svarga haiM, jinameM nahareM baha rahI haiM| ve unameM sadAvAsI hoMge aura nirmala patniyA~ hoMgI tathA allAha kI prasannatA prApta hogI aura allAha apane bhaktoM ko dekha rahA hai|
jo (ye) prArthanA karate haiM ki hamAre pAlanahAra! hama ImAna lAye, ataH hamAre pApa kSamA kara de aura hameM naraka kI yAtanA se bacA|
jo sahanazIla haiM, satyavAdI haiM, AjJAkArI haiM, dAnazIla tathA bhoroM meM allAha se kSamA yAcanA karane vAle haiM|
allAha sAkSI hai, jo nyAya ke sAtha qAyama hai ki usake sivA koI pUjya nahIM hai, isI prakAra farizte aura jJAnI loga bhI (sAkSI haiM) ki usake sivA koI pUjya nahIM| vaha prabhutvazAlI, tatvajJa hai|

niHsaMdeha (vAstavika) dharma allAha ke pAsa islAma hI hai aura ahle kitAba ne jo vibheda kiyA, to apane pAsa jJAna Ane ke pazcAt Apasa meM dveSa ke kAraNa kiyA tathA jo allAha kI AyatoM ke sAtha kufra (asvIkAra) karegA, to nizcaya allAha zIghra ha़isAba lene vAlA hai|

phira yadi ve Apase vivAda kareM, to kaha deM ki maiM svayaM tathA jisane merA anusaraNa kiyA allAha ke AjJAkArI ho gaye tathA ahle kitAba aura ummiyoM (arthAta jinake pAsa koI kitAba nahIM AyI) se kaho ki kyA tuma bhI AjJAkArI ho gaye? yadi ve AjJAkArI ho gaye, to mArgadarzana pA gaye aura yadi vimukha ho gaye, to ApakA dAyitva (saMdeza) pahu~cA[1] denA hai tathA allAha bhaktoM ko dekha rahA hai|

jo loga allAha kI AyatoM ke sAtha kufra karate hoM tathA nabiyoM ko avaidha vadha karate hoM, tathA una logoM kA vadha karate hoM, jo nyAya kA Adeza dete haiM, to unheM duHkhadAyI yAtanA[1] kI zubha sUcanA sunA do|
yahI haiM, jinake karma saMsAra tathA paraloka meM akAratha gaye aura unakA koI sahAyaka nahIM hogA|

(he nabI!) kyA Apane unakI[1] dazA nahIM dekhI, jinheM pustaka kA kucha bhAga diyA gayA? ve allAha kI pustaka kI ora bulAye jA rahe haiM, tAki unake bIca nirNaya[2] kare, to unakA eka giroha mu~ha phera rahA hai aura ve haiM hI mu~ha pherane vAle|
unakI ye dazA isalie hai ki unhoMne kahA ki naraka kI agni hameM ginatI ke kucha dina hI chuegI tathA unheM apane dharma meM unakI mithyA banAyI huI bAtoM ne dhokhe meM DAla rakhA hai|
