to unakI kyA dazA hogI, jaba hama unheM usa dina ekatra kareMge, jisa (ke Ane) meM koI saMdeha nahIM tathA pratyeka prANI ko usake kiye kA bharapUra pratiphala diyA jAyegA aura kisI ke sAtha koI atyAcAra nahIM kiyA jAyegA?

(he nabI!) kahoH he allAha! rAjya ke[1] adhipati (svAmI)! tU jise cAhe, rAjya de aura jisase cAhe, rAjya chIna le tathA jise cAhe, sammAna de aura jise cAhe, apamAna de| tere hI hAtha meM bhalAI hai| niHsaMdeha tU jo cAhe, kara sakatA hai|

tU rAta ko dina meM praviSTa kara detA hai tathA dina ko rAta meM praviSTa kara[1] detA hai aura jIva ko nirjIva se nikAlatA hai tathA nirjIva ko jIva se nikAlatA hai aura jise cAhe agaNita AjIvikA pradAna karatA hai|

mominoM ko cAhie ki vo ImAna vAloM ke virudhda kAfiroM ko apanA sahAyaka mitra na banAyeM aura jo aisA karegA, usakA allAha se koI saMbaMdha nahIM| parantu unase bacane ke lie[1] aura allAha tumheM svayaM apane se DarA rahA hai aura allAha hI kI ora jAnA hai|

(he nabI!) kaha do ki jo tumhAre mana meM hai, use mana hI meM rakho yA vyakta karo, allAha use jAnatA hai tathA jo kucha AkAzoM tathA dharatI meM hai, vaha sabako jAnatA hai aura allAha jo cAhe, kara sakatA hai|

jisa dina pratyeka prANI ne jo sukarma kiyA hai, use upasthita pAyegA tathA jisane kukarma kiyA hai, vaha kAmanA karegA ki usake tathA usake kukarmoM ke bIca bar3I dUrI hotI tathA allAha tumheM svayaM se DarAtA[1] hai aura allAha apane bhaktoM ke lie ati karuNAmaya hai|
(he nabI!) kaha doH yadi tuma allAha se prema karate ho, to merA anusaraNa karo, allAha tumase prema[1] karegA tathA tumhAre pApa kSamA kara degA aura allAha ati kSamAzIla, dayAvAn hai|
(he nabI!) kaha doH allAha aura rasUla kI AjJA kA anupAlana karo| phira bhI yadi ve vimukha hoM, to niHsaMdeha allAha kAfiroM se prema nahIM karatA|
vastutaH, allAha ne Adama, nUha़, ibrAhIma kI saMtAna tathA imarAna kI saMtAna ko saMsAra vAsiyoM meM cuna liyA thA|
ye eka-dUsare kI saMtAna haiM aura allAha saba sunatA aura jAnatA hai|

jaba imarAna kI patnI[1] ne kahAH he mere pAlanahAra! jo mere garbha meM hai, maiMne tere[3] lie use mukta karane kI manautI mAna lI hai| tU ise mujhase svIkAra kara le| vAstava meM, tU hI saba kucha sunatA aura jAnatA hai|

phira jaba usane bAlikA janI, to (saMtApa se) kahAH mere pAlanahAra! mujhe to bAlikA ho gayI, hAlA~ki jo usane janA, usakA allAha ko bhalI-bhA~ti jJAna thA -aura nara nArI ke samAna nahIM hotA- aura maiMne usakA nAma maryama rakhA hai aura maiM use tathA usakI saMtAna ko dhikkAre hue zaitAna se terI zaraNa meM detI hU~|[1]

to tere pAlanahAra ne use bhalI-bhA~ti svIkAra kara liyA tathA usakA acchA pratipAlana kiyA aura z2akariyyA ko usakA saMrakSaka banAyA| z2akariyyA jababhI usake meha़rAba (upAsanA koSTa) meM jAtA, to usake pAsa kucha khAdya padArtha pAtA, vaha kahatA ki he maryama! ye kahA~ se (AyA) hai? vaha kahatIH ye allAha ke pAsa se (AyA) hai| vAstava meM, allAha jise cAhatA hai, agaNita jIvikA pradA karatA hai|
taba z2akariyyA ne apane pAlanahAra se prArthanA kIH he mere pAlanahAra! mujhe apanI ora se sadAcArI saMtAna pradAna kara| niHsaMdeha tU prArthanA sunane vAlA hai|

to fariztoM ne use pukArA- jaba vaha meha़rAba meM khar3A namAz2a par3ha rahA thA- ki allAha tujhe 'yaha़yA' kI zubha sUcanA de rahA hai, jo allAha ke zabda (IsA) kA puSTi karane vAlA, pramukha tathA saMyamI aura sadAcAriyoM meM se eka nabI hogA|
usane kahAH mere pAlanahAra! mere koI putra kahA~ se hogA, jabaki maiM bUr3hA ho gayA hU~ aura merI patnI bA~jha[1] hai? usane kahAH allAha isI prakAra jo cAhatA hai, kara detA hai|

usane kahAH mere pAlanahAra! mere lie koI lakSaNa banA de| usane kahAH terA lakSaNa ye hogA ki tIna dina taka logoM se bAta nahIM kara sakegA, parantu saMketa se tathA apane pAlanahAra kA bahuta smaraNa karatA raha aura saMdhyA-prAtA usI kI pavitratA kA varNana kara|
aura (yAda karo) jaba phariztoM ne maryama se kahAH he maryama! tujhe allAha ne cuna liyA tathA pavitratA pradAna kI aura saMsAra kI striyoM para tujhe cuna liyA|
he maryama! apane pAlanahAra kI AjJAkArI raho, sajdA karo tathA rukUa karane vAloM ke sAtha rukUa karatI raho|

ye g2aiba (parokSa) kI sUcanAyeM haiM, jinheM hama ApakI ora prakAzanA kara rahe haiM aura Apa unake pAsa upasthita nahIM the, jaba ve apanI lekhaniyA~[1] pheMka rahe the ki kauna maryama kA abhirakSaNa karegA aura na unake pAsa upasthita the, jaba ve jhagar3a rahe the|

jaba fariztoM ne kahAH he maryama! allAha tujhe apane eka zabda[1] kI zubha sUcanA de rahA hai, jisakA nAma masIha़ IsA putra maryama hogA| vaha loka-praloka meM pramukha tathA (mere) samIpavartiyoM meM hogA|
vaha logoM se goda meM tathA adher3a Ayu meM bAteM karegA aura sadAcAriyoM meM hogA|

maryama ne (Azcarya se) kahAH mere pAlanahAra! mujhe putra kahA~ se hogA, mujhe to kisI puruSa ne hAtha bhI nahIM lagAyA hai? usane[1] kahAH isI prakAra allAha jo cAhatA hai, utpanna kara detA hai| jaba vaha kisI kAma ke karane kA nirNaya kara letA hai, to usake lie kahatA hai kiH "ho jA", to vaha ho jAtA hai|
aura allAha use pustaka tathA prabodha aura taurAta tathA iMjIla kI zikSA degA|

aura phira vaha banI isrAIla kA eka rasUla hogA (aura kahegAH) ki maiM tumhAre pAlanahAra kI ora se nizAnI lAyA hU~| maiM tumhAre lie miTTI se pakSI ke AkAra ke samAna banAU~gA, phira usameM phU~ka dU~gA, to vaha allAha kI anumati se pakSI bana jAyegA aura allAha kI anumati se janma se aMdhe tathA kor3hI ko svastha kara dU~gA aura murdoM ko jIvita kara dU~gA tathA jo kucha tuma khAte tathA apane gharoM meM saMcita karate ho, use tumheM batA dU~gA| niHsaMdeha, isameM tumhAre lie bar3I nizAniyA~ haiM, yadi tuma ImAna vAle ho|

tathA maiM usakI sidhdi karane vAlA hU~, jo mujhase pahale kI hai 'taurAta'| tumhAre lie kucha cIz2oM ko ha़lAlA (vaidha) karane vAlA hU~, jo tumapara ha़rAma (avaidha) kI gayI haiM tathA maiM tumhAre pAsa tumhAre pAlanahAra kI nizAnI lekara AyA hU~| ataH tuma allAha se Daro aura mere AjJAkArI ho jAo|
vAstava meM, allAha merA aura tuma sabakA pAlanahAra hai| ataH usI kI ibAdata (vaMdanA) karo| yahI sIdhI Dagara hai|

tathA jaba IsA ne unase kufra kA saMvedana kiyA, to kahAH allAha ke dharma kI sahAyatA meM kauna merA sAtha degA? to ha़vAriyoM (sahacaroM) ne kahAH hama allAha ke sahAyaka haiM| hama allAha para ImAna lAye, tuma isake sAkSI raho ki hama muslima (AjJAkArI) haiM|
he hamAre pAlanahAra! jo kucha tUne utArA hai, hama usapara ImAna lAye tathA tere rasUla kA anusaraNa kiyA, ataH hameM bhI sAkSiyoM meM aMkita kara le|
tathA unhoMne SaDyaMtra[1] racA aura hamane bhI SaDyaMtra racA tathA allAha SaDyaMtra racane vAloM meM sabase acchA hai|

jaba allAha ne kahAH he IsA! maiM tujhe pUrNataH lene vAlA tathA apanI ora uThAne vAlA hU~ tathA tujhe kAfiroM se pavitra (mukta) karane vAlA hU~ tathA tere anuyAyiyoM ko pralaya ke dina taka kAfiroM ke Upara[1] karane vAlA hU~| phira tumhArA lauTanA merI hI ora hai| to maiM tumhAre bIca usa viSaya meM nirNaya kara dU~gA, jisameM tuma vibheda kara rahe ho|
phira jo kAfira ho gaye, unheM loka-praloka meM kar3I yAtanA dU~gA tathA unakA koI sahAyaka na hogA|
tathA jo ImAna lAye aura sadAcAra kiye, to unheM unakA bharapUra pratiphala dU~gA tathA allAha atyAcAriyoM se prema nahIM karatA|
(he nabI!) ye hamArI AyateM aura tatvajJatA kI zikSA hai, jo hama tumheM sunA rahe haiM|
vastutaH allAha ke pAsa IsA kI misAla aisI hI hai[1], jaise Adama kI| use (arthAta, Adama ko) miTTI se utpanna kiyA, phira usase kahAH "ho jA" to vaha ho gayA|
ye Apake pAlanahAra kI ora se satya[1] hai, ataH Apa saMdeha karane vAloM meM na hoM|

phira Apake pAsa jJAna A jAne ke pazcAt koI Apase IsA ke viSaya meM vivAda kare, to kaho ki Ao, hama apane putroM tathA tumhAre putroM aura apanI striyoM tathA tumhArI striyoM ko bulAte haiM aura svayaM ko bhI, phira allAha se savinaya prArthanA kareM ki allAha kI dhikkAra mithyAvAdiyoM para[1] ho|
vAstava meM, yahI satya varNana hai tathA allAha ke sivA koI pUjya nahIM| nizcaya allAha hI prabhutvazAlI tatvajJa hai|
phira bhI yadi ve mu~ha[1] phereM, to niHsaMdeha allAha upadraviyoM ko bhalI-bhA~ti jAnatA hai|

(he nabI!) kaho ki he ahle kitAba! eka aisI bAta kI ora A jAo, jo hamAre tathA tumhAre bIca samAna rUpa se mAnya hai ki allAha ke sivA kisI kI ibAdata (vaMdanA) na kareM aura kisI ko usakA sAjhI na banAyeM tathA hamameM se koI eka-dUsare ko allAha ke sivA pAlanahAra na banAye| phira yadi ve vimukha hoM, to Apa kaha deM ki tuma sAkSI raho ki hama (allAha ke)[1] AjJAkArI haiM|
he ahle kitAba! tuma ibrAhIma ke bAre meM vivAda[1] kyoM karate ho, jabaki taurAta tathA iMjIla ibrAhIma ke pazcAt utArI gaI haiM? kyA tuma samajha nahIM rakhate?

aura phira tumhIM ne usa viSaya meM vivAda kiyA, jisakA tumheM kucha jJAna[1] thA, to usa viSaya meM kyoM vivAda kara rahe ho, jisakA tumheM koI jJAna[2] nahIM thA? tathA allAha jAnatA hai aura tuma nahIM jAnate|
ibrAhIma na yahUdI thA, na nasrAnI (IsAI)| parantu vaha ekezvaravAdI, muslima 'AjJAkArI' thA tathA vaha mizraNavAdiyoM meM se nahIM thA|
vAstava meM, ibrAhIma se sabase adhika samIpa to vaha loga haiM, jinhoMne usakA anusaraNa kiyA tathA ye nabI[1] aura jo ImAna lAye aura allAha ImAna vAloM kA saMrakSakabhamitra hai|
ahle kitAba meM se eka giroha kI kAmanA hai ki tumheM kupatha kara de| jabaki ve svayaM ko kupatha kara rahe haiM, parantu ve samajhate nahIM haiM|
he ahle kitAba! tuma allAha kI AyatoM[1] ke sAtha kufra kyoM kara rahe ho, jabaki tuma sAkSI[2] ho?
he ahle kitAba! kyoM satya ko asatya ke sAtha milAkara saMdigdha kara dete ho aura satya ko chupAte ho, jabaki tuma jAnate ho?

ahle kitAba ke eka samudAya ne kahA ki dina ke AraMbha meM usapara ImAna le Ao, jo ImAna vAloM para utArA gayA hai aura usake anta (arthAtaH saMdhyA-samaya) kufra kara do, saMbhavataH ve phira[1] jAyeM|

aura kevala usI kI mAno, jo tumhAre (dharma) kA anusaraNa kare| (he nabI!) kaha do ki mArgadarzana to vahI hai, jo allAha kA mArgadarzana hai| (aura ye bhI na mAno ki) jo (dharma) tumheM diyA gayA hai, vaisA kisI aura ko diyA jAyegA athavA ve tumase tumhAre pAlanahAra ke pAsa vivAda kara sakeMge| Apa kaha deM ki pradAna allAha ke hAtha meM hai, vaha jise cAhe, detA hai aura allAha vizAla jJAnI hai|
vaha jise cAhe, apanI dayA ke sAtha vizeSa kara detA hai tathA allAha bar3A dAnazIla hai|

tathA ahle kitAba meM se vo bhI hai, jisake pAsa cA~dI-sone kA Dhera dharohara rakha do, to use tumheM cukA degA tathA unameM vo bhI hai, jisake pAsa eka dInAra[1] bhI dharohara rakha do, to tumheM nahIM cukAyegA, parantu jaba sadA usake sira para savAra raho| ye (bAta) isalie hai ki unhoMne kahA ki ummiyoM ke bAre meM hamapara koI doSa[2] nahIM tathA allAha para jAnate hue jhUTha bolate haiM|
kyoM nahIM, jisane apanA vacana pUrA kiyA aura (allAha se) DarA, to vAstava meM allAha Darane vAloM se prema karatA hai|

niHsaMdeha jo allAha ke[1] vacana tathA apanI zapathoM ke badale tanika mUlya kharIdate haiM, unhIM kA Aqhirata (paraloka) meM koI bhAga nahIM, na pralaya ke dina allAha unase bAta karegA aura na unakI ora dekhegA aura na unheM pavitra karegA tathA unhIM ke lie duHkhadAyI yAtanA hai|

aura bezaka unameM se eka giroha[1] aisA hai, jo apanI z2abAnoM ko kitAba par3hate samaya maror3ate haiM, tAki tuma use pustaka meM se samajho, jabaki vaha pustaka meM se nahIM hai aura kahate haiM ki vaha allAha ke pAsa se hai, jabaki vaha allAha ke pAsa se nahIM hai aura allAha para jAnate hue jhUTha bolate haiM|

kisI puruSa jise allAha ne pustaka, nirNaya zakti aura nubuvvata dI ho, usake lie yogya nahIM ki logoM se kahe ki allAha ko chor3akara mere dAsa bana jAo[1], apitu (vaha to yahI kahegA ki) tuma allAha vAle bana jAo| isa kAraNa ki tuma pustaka kI zikSA dete ho tathA isa kAraNa ki usakA adhyayana svayaM bhI karate rahate ho|
tathA vaha tumheM kabhI Adeza nahIM degA ki fariztoM tathA nabiyoM ko apanA pAlanahAra[1] (pUjya) banA lo| kyA tumheM kufra karane kA Adeza degA, jabaki tuma allAha ke AjJAkArI ho?

tathA (yAda karo) jaba allAha ne nabiyoM se vacana liyA ki jababhI maiM tumheM koI pustaka aura prabodha (tatvadarzitA) dU~, phira tumhAre pAsa koI rasUla use pramANita karate hue Aye, jo tumhAre pAsa hai, to tuma avazya usapara ImAna lAnA aura usakA samarthana karanA| (allAha) ne kahAH kyA tumane svIkAra kiyA aura isapara mere vacana kA bhAra uThAyA? to sabane kahAH hamane svIkAra kara liyA| allAha ne kahAH tuma sAkSI raho aura maiM bhI tumhAre[1] sAtha sAkSiyoM meM se hU~|
phira jisane isake[1] pazcAt mu~ha phera liyA, to vahI avajJAkArI hai|

to kyA ve allAha ke dharma (islAma) ke sivA (koI dUsarA dharma) khoja rahe haiM? jabaki jo AkAzoM tathA dharatI meM hai, svecchA tathA anicchA usI ke AjJAkArI[1] haiM tathA saba usI kI ora phere[2] jAyeMge|

(he nabI!) Apa kaheM ki hama allAha para tathA jo hamapara utArA gayA aura jo ibrAhIma, ismAIla, isha़Aqa, yAqUba evaM (unakI) saMtAnoM para utArA gayA tathA jo mUsA, IsA tathA anya nabiyoM ko unake pAlanahAra kI ora se pradAna kiyA gayA hai, (unapara) ImAna lAye| hama una (nabiyoM) meM kisI ke bIca koI aMtara nahIM[1] karate aura hama usI (allAha) ke AjJAkArI haiM|
aura jo bhI islAma ke sivA (kisI aura dharma) ko cAhegA, to use usase kadApi svIkAra nahIM kiyA jAyegA aura ve praloka meM kSatigrastoM meM hogA|

allAha aisI jAti ko kaise mArgadarzana degA, jo apane ImAna ke pazcAt kAfira ho gaye aura sAkSI rahe ki ye rasUla satya haiM tathA unake pAsa khule tarka A gaye? aura allAha atyAcAriyoM ko mArgadarzana nahIM detA|
inhIM kA pratikAra (badalA) ye hai ki unapara allAha tathA fariztoM aura saba logoM kI dhikkAra hogI|
ve usameM sadAvAsI hoMge, unase yAtanA kama nahIM kI jAyegI aura na unheM avakAza diyA jAyegA|
parantu jinhoMne isake pazcAt taubA (kSamA yAcanA) kara lI tathA sudhAra kara liyA, to nizcaya allAha ati kSamAzIla dayAvAn hai|
vAstava meM, jo apane ImAna lAne ke pazcAt kAfira ho gaye, phira kufra meM bar3hate gaye, to unakI taubA (kSamA yAcanA) kadApi[1] svIkAra nahIM kI jAyegI tathA vahI kupatha haiM|

nizcaya jo kAfira ho gaye tathA kAfira rahate hue mara gaye, to unase dharatI bhara sonA bhI svIkAra nahIM kiyA jAyegA, yadyapi usake dvArA arthadaNaDa de| unhIM ke lie duHkhadAyI yAtanA hai aura unakA koI sahAyaka na hogA|
tuma puNya[1] nahIM pA sakoge, jaba taka usameM se dAna na karo, jisase moha rakhate ho tathA tuma jo bhI dAna karoge, vAstava meM, allAha use bhalI-bhA~ti jAnatA hai|

pratyeka khAdya padArtha banI isrAIla[1] ke lie ha़lAla (vaidha) the, parantu jise isrAIla ne apane Upara ha़rAma (avaidha) kara liyA, isase pahale ki taurAta utArI jAye| (he nabI!) kaho ki taurAta lAo tathA use par3ho, yadi tuma satyavAdi ho|
phira isake pazcAt jo allAha para mithyA Aropa lagAyeM, to vahI vAstava, meM atyAcArI haiM|
unase kaha do, alalAha saccA hai, isalie tuma ekezvaravAdI ibrAhIma ke dharma para calo tathA vaha mizraNavAdiyoM meM se nahIM thA|
niHsaMdeha pahalA ghara, jo mAnava ke lie (allAha kI vaMdanA kA keMdra) banAyA gayA, vaha vahI hai, jo makkA meM hai, jo zubha tathA saMsAra vAsiyoM ke lie mArgadarzana hai|

usameM khulI nizAniyA~ haiM, (jinameM) maqAme[1] ibrAhIma hai tathA jo koI usa (kI sImA) meM praveza kara gayA, to vaha zAMta (surakSita) ho gayA| tathA allAha ke lie logoM para isa ghara kA ha़ja anivArya hai, jo usataka rAha pA sakatA ho tathA jo kufra karegA, to allAha saMsAra vAsiyoM se nispRha hai|
(he nabI!) Apa kaha deM ki he ahle kitAba! ye kyA hai ki tuma allAha kI AyatoM ke sAtha kufra kara rahe ho, jabaki allAha tumhAre karmoM kA sAkSI hai?
he ahle kitAba! kisa lie logoM ko, jo ImAna lAnA cAheM, allAha kI rAha se roka rahe ho, use ulajhAnA cAhate ho, jabaki tuma sAkSI[1] ho aura allAha tumhAre karmoM se asUcita nahIM hai?
he ImAna vAlo! yadi tuma ahle kitAba ke kisI giroha kI bAta mAnoge, to vaha tumhAre ImAna ke pazcAt phira tumheM kAfira banA deMge|

tathA tuma kufra kaise karoge, jabaki tumhAre sAmane alalAha kI AyateM par3hI jA rahI haiM aura tumameM usake rasUla[1] maujUda haiM? aura jisane allAha ko[2] thAma liyA, to use supatha dikhA diyA gayA|
he ImAna vAlo! allAha se aise Daro, jo vAstava meM, usase DaranA ho tathA tumhArI mauta islAma para rahate hue hI AnI cIhi|

tathA allAha kI rassI[1] ko saba milakara dRr3hatA se pakar3a lo aura vibheda meM na par3o tathA apane Upara alalAha ke puraskAra ko yAda karo, jaba tuma eka-dUsare ke zatru the, to tumhAre diloM ko jor3a diyA aura tuma usake puraskAra ke kAraNa bhAI-bhAI ho gae tathA tuma agni ke gar3ahe ke kinAre para the, to tumheM usase nikAla diyA| isI prakAra allAha tumhAre lie apanI AyateM ujAgara karatA hai, tAki tuma mArgadarzana pA jAo|
tathA tumameM eka samudAya aisA avazya honA cAhie, jo bhalI bAtoM[1] kI ora bulAye, bhalAI kA Adeza detA rahe, burAI[2] se rokatA rahe aura vahI saphala hoMge|
tathA unake[1] samAna na ho jAo, jo khulI nizAniyA~ Ane ke pazcAt, vibheda tathA ApasI virodha meM par3a gaye aura unhIM ke lie ghora yAtanA hai|

jisa dina bahuta-se mukha ujale tathA bahuta-se mukha kAle hoMge| phira jinake mukha kAle hoMge (unase kahA jAyegAH) kyA tumane apane ImAna ke pazcAt kufra kara liyA thA? to apane kufra karane kA daNDa cakho|
tathA jinake mukha ujale hoMge, ve allAha kI dayA (svarga) meM raheMge| va usameM sadAvAsI hoMge|
ye allAha kI AyateM haiM, jo hama Apako ha़qa ke sAtha sunA rahe haiM tathA allAha saMsAra vAsiyoM para atyAcAra nahIM karanA cAhatA|
tathA allAha hI kA hai, jo AkAzoM meM aura jo dharatI meM hai tathA allAha hI kI ora saba viSaya phere jAyeMge|

tuma, sabase acchI ummata ho, jise saba logoM ke lie utpanna kiyA gayA hai ki tuma bhalAI kA Adeza dete ho tathA burAI se rokate ho aura allAha para ImAna (vizvAsa) rakhate[1] ho| yadi ahle kitAba ImAna lAte, to unake lie acchA hotA| unameM kucha ImAna vAle haiM aura adhiktara avajJAkArI haiM|
ve tumheM satAne ke sivA koI hAni pahu~cA nahIM sakeMge aura yadi tumase yudhda kareMge, to ve tumheM pITha dikhA deMge| phira sahAyatA nahIM die jAyeMge|

ina (yahUdiyoM) para jahA~ bhI raheM, apamAna thoMpa diyA gayA hai, (ye aura bAta hai ki) allAha kI zaraNa[1] athavA logoM kI zaraNa meM hoM[2], ye allAha ke prakopa ke adhikArI ho gaye tathA inapara daridratA thoMpa dI gayI| ye isa kAraNa huA ki ye allAha kI AyatoM ke sAtha kufra kara rahe the aura nabiyoM kA avaidha vadha kara rahe the| ye isa kAraNa ki inhoMne avajJA kI aura (dharma kI) sImA kA ullaMghana kara rahe the|
ve sabhI samAna nahIM haiM; ahle kitAba meM eka( satya para) sthita ummata[1] bhI hai, jo allAha kI AyateM rAtoM meM par3hate haiM tathA sajdA karate rahate haiM|
allAha tathA aMtima dina (pralaya) para ImAna rakhate haiM, bhalAI kA Adeza dete haiM, burAI se rokate haiM, bhalAIyoM meM agrasara rahate haiM aura yahI sadAcAriyoM meM haiM|
ve, jo bhI bhalAI kareMge, usakI upekSA (anAdara) nahIM kI jAyegI aura allAha AjJAkAriyoM ko bhalI-bhA~ti jAnatA hai|
(parantu) jo kAfira[1] ho gaye, unake dhana aura unakI saMtAna allAha (kI yAtanA) se unheM tanika bhI bacA nahIM sakegI tathA vahI nArakI haiM, vahI usameM sadAvAsI hoMge|

jo dAna, ve isa sAMsArika jIvana meM karate haiM, vo usa vAyu ke samAna hai, jisameM pAlA ho, jo kisI qauma kI khetI ko laga jAye, jinhoMne apane Upara atyAcAra[1] kiyA ho aura usakA nAza kara de tathA allAha ne unapara atyAcAra nahIM kiyA, parantu ve svayaM apane Upara atyAcAra kara rahe the|

he ImAna vAlo! apanoM ke sivA kisI ko apanA bhedI na banAo[1], ve tumhArA bigAr3ane meM tanika bhI nahIM cUkeMge, unaheM vahI bAta bhAtI hai, jisase tumheM duHkha ho| unake mukhoM se zatrutA khula cukI hai tathA jo unake dila chupA rahe haiM, vo isase bar3hakara hai| hamane tumhAre lie AyatoM kA varNana kara diyA hai, yadi tuma samajho|

sAvadhAna! tumahI vo ho ki unase prema karate ho, jabaki ve tumase prema nahIM karate aura tuma sabhI pustakoM para ImAna rakhate ho, jabaki ve jaba tumase milate haiM, to kahate haiM ki hama ImAna lAye aura jaba akele hote haiM, to krodha se tumapara u~galiyoM kI poreM cabAte haiM| kaha do ki apane krodha se mara jAo| niHsaMdeha allAha sInoM kI bAtoM ko jAnatA hai|

yadi tumhArA kucha bhalA ho, to unheM burA lagatA hai aura yadi tumhArA kucha burA ho jAye, to ve usase prasanna ho jAte haiM| alabattA, yadi tuma sahana karate rahe aura AjJAkArI rahe, to unakA chala tumheM koI hAni nahIM pahu~cAyegA| unake sabhI karma allAha ke ghere meM haiM|
tathA (he nabI! vo samaya yAda kareM) jaba Apa prAtaH apane ghara se nikale, ImAna vAloM ko yudhda[1] ke sthAnoM para niyukta kara rahe the tathA allAha saba kucha sunane-jAnane vAlA hai|

he ImAna vAlo! tuma dhairya rakho[1], eka-dUsare ko thAme rakho, jihAda ke lie taiyAra raho aura allAha se Darate raho, tAki tuma apane uddezya ko pahu~co|

he manuSyoM! apane[1] usa pAlanahAra se Daro, jisane tumheM eka jIva (Adama) se utpanna kiyA tathA usIse usakI patnI (havvA) ko utpanna kiyA aura una donoM se bahuta-se nara-nArI phailA diye| usa allAha se Daro, jisake dvArA tuma eka-dUsare se (adhikAra) mAMgate ho tathA rakta saMbaMdhoM ko tor3ane se Daro| niHsaMdeha allAha tumhArA nirIkSaka hai|

tathA (he saMrakSako!) anAthoM ko unake dhana cukA do aura (unakI) acchI cIz2a se (apanI) burI cIz2a na badalo aura unake dhana, apane dhanoM meM milAkara na khAo| niHsaMdeha ye bahuta bar3A pApa hai|

aura yadi tuma Daro ki anAtha (bAlikAoM) ke viSaya[1] meM nyAya nahIM kara sakoge, to nAriyoM meM se jo bhI tumheM bhAyeM, do se, tIna se, cAra taka se vivAha kara lo aura yadi Daro ki (unake bIca) nyAya nahIM kara sakoge, to eka hI se karo athavA jo tumhAre svAmitva[2] meM ho, usIpara basa karo| ye adhika samIpa hai ki anyAya na karo|
tathA striyoM ko unake mahara (vivAha upahAra) prasannatA se cukA do| phira yadi ve usameM se kucha tumheM apanI icchA se de deM, to prasanna hokara khAo|
tathA apane dhana, jise allAha ne tumhAre lie jIvana sthApana kA sAdhana banAyA hai, ajJAnoM ko na[1] do| hA~, usameM se unheM khAnA-kapar3A do aura unase bhalI bAta bolo|

tathA anAthoM kI parIkSA lete raho, yahA~ taka ki ve vivAha kI Ayu ko pahu~ca jAyeM, to yadi tuma unameM sudhAra dekho, to unakA dhana unheM samarpita kara do aura use apavyaya tathA zIghratA se isalie na khAo ki ve bar3e ho jAyeMge aura jo dhanI ho, to vaha bace tathA jo nirdhana ho, vaha niyamAnusAra khA le tathA jaba tuma unakA dhana unake ha़vAle karo, to unapara sAkSI banA lo aura allAha ha़isAba lene ke lie kAfI hai|

aura puruSoM ke lie usameM se bhAga hai, jo mAtA-pitA tathA samIpavartiyoM ne chor3A hai tathA striyoM ke lie usameM se bhAga hai, jo mAtA-pitA tathA samIpavartiyoM ne chor3A ho, vaha thor3A ho athavA adhika, sabake bhAga[1] nirdhArita haiM|
aura jaba mIrAsa vibhAjana ke samaya samIpavartI[1], anAtha aura nirdhana upasthita hoM, to unheM bhI thor3A bahuta de do tathA unase bhalI bAta bolo|
aura una logoM ko DaranA cAhie, jo apane pIche nirbala saMtAna chor3a jAyeM aura unake nAza hone kA bhaya ho, ataH unheM cAhie ki allAha se DareM aura sIdhI bAta boleM|
jo loga anAthoM kA dhana atyAcAra se khAte haiM, ve apane peToM meM Aga bharate haiM aura zIghra hI naraka kI agni meM praveza kareMge|

allAha tumhArI saMtAna ke saMbaMdha meM tumheM Adeza detA hai ki putra kA bhAga, do putriyoM ke barAbara hai| yadi putriyA~ do[1] se adhika hoM, to unake lie chor3e hue dhana kA do tihAI (bhAga) hai| yadi eka hI ho, to usake lie AdhA hai aura usake mAtA-pitA, donoM meM se pratyeka ke lie usameM se chaThA bhAga hai, jo chor3A ho, yadi usake koI saMtAna[2] hoM| aura yadi usake koI saMtAna (putra yA putrI) na hoM aura usakA vArisa usakA pitA ho, to usakI mAtA kA tihAI (bhAga)[3] hai, (aura zeSa pitA kA)| phira yadi (mAtA pitA ke sivA) usake eka se adhika bhAI athavA bahaneM hoM, to usakI mAtA ke lie chaThA bhAga hai, jo vasiyyata[4] tathA qarz2a cukAne ke pazcAt hogA| tuma nahIM jAnate ki tumhAre pitAoM aura putroM meM se kauna tumhAre lie adhika lAbhadAyaka haiM| vAstava meM, allAha ati bar3A tathA guNI, jJAnI, tatvajJa hai|

aura tumhAre lie usakA AdhA hai, jo tumhArI patniyA~ chor3a jAyeM, yadi unake koI saMtAna (putra yA putrI) na hoM| phira yadi unake koI saMtAna hoM, to tumhAre lie usakA cauthAI hai, jo ve chor3a gayI hoM, vasiyyata (uttaradAna) yA RNa cukAne ke pazcAt| jabaki (patnayoM) ke lie usakA cauthAI hai, jo (mAla Adi) tumane chor3A ho, yadi tumhAre koI saMtAna (putra yA putrI) na hoM| phira yadi tumhAre koI saMtAna hoM, to unake lie usakA AThavA~[1] (bhAga) hai, jo tumane chor3A hai, vasiyyata (uttaradAna) jo tumane kI ho, pUrI karane athavA RNa cukAne ke pazcAt| phira yadi kisI aise puruSa yA strI kA vArisa hone kI bAta ho, jo 'kalAlA'[2] ho tathA (dUsarI mAtA se) usakA bhAI athavA bahana ho, to unameM se pratyeka ke lie chaThA (bhAga) hai| phira yadi (mA~ jAye) (bhAI yA bahaneM) isase adhika hoM, to ve saba tihAI (bhAga) meM (barAbara ke) sAjhI hoMge| ye vasiyyata (uttaradAna) tathA RNa cukAne ke pazcAta hogA| kisI ko hAni nahIM pahu~cAyI jAyegI| ye allAha kI ora se vasiyyata hai aura allAha jJAnI tathA ha़ikmata vAlA hai|

ye allAha kI (nirdhArita) sImAyeM haiM aura jo allAha tathA usake rasUla kA AjJAkArI rahegA, to vaha use aise svargoM meM praveza degA, jinameM nahareM pravAhita hoMgI| unameM ve sadAvAsI hoMge tathA yahI bar3I saphalatA hai|
aura jo allAha tathA usake rasUla kI avajJA tathA usakI sImAoM kA ullaMghana karegA, use naraka meM praveza degA| jisameM vaha sadAvAsI hogA aura usI ke lie apamAnakArI yAtanA hai|

tathA tumhArI striyoM meM se, jo vyabhicAra kara jAye~, to unapara apanoM meM se cAra sAkSI lAo| phira yadi ve sAkSya (gavAhI) deM, to unheM gharoM meM baMda kara do, yahA~ taka ki unheM mauta A jAye athavA allAha unake lie koI anya[1] rAha banA de|

aura tumameM se jo do vyakti aisA kareM, to donoM ko duHkha pahu~cAo, yahA~ taka ki (jaba) ve taubA (kSamA yAcanA) kara leM aura apanA sudhAra kara leM, to unheM chor3a do| nizcaya allAha bar3A kSamAzIla, dayAvAn hai|

allAha ke pAsa unhIM kI taubA (kSamA yAcanA) svIkArya hai, jo anajAne meM burAI kara jAte haiM, phira zIghra hI kSamA yAcanA kara lete haiM, to allAha unakI taubA (kSamA yAcanA) svIkAra kara letA hai tathA allAha bar3A jJAnI guNI hai|

aura unakI taubA (kSamA yAcanA) svIkArya nahIM, jo burAIyA~ karate rahate haiM, yahA~ taka ki jaba unameM se kisI kI mauta kA samaya A jAtA hai, to kahatA haiH aba maiMne taubA kara lI| na hI unakI (taubA svIkAra kI jAyegI) jo kAfira rahate hue mara jAte haiM, inhIM ke lie hamane duHkhadAyI yAtanA taiyAra kara rakhI hai|

he ImAna vAlo! tumhAre lie ha़lAla (vaidha) nahIM ki balapUrvaka striyoM ke vArisa bana jAo[1] tathA unheM isalie na roko ki unheM jo diyA ho, usameM se kucha mAra lo| parantu ye ki khulI burAI kara jAye~ tathA unake sAtha ucita[2] vyavahAra se raho| phira yadi ve tumheM apriya lageM, to saMbhava hai ki tuma kisI cIz2a ko apriya samajho aura allAha ne usameM bar3I bhalAI[3] rakha dI ho|

aura yadi tuma kisI patnI ke sthAna para kisI dUsarI patnI se vivAha karanA cAho aura tumane unameM se eka ko (sone cA~dI) kA Dhera bhI (mahara meM) diyA ho, to usameM se kucha na lo| kyA tuma cAhate ho ki use Aropa lagAkara tathA khule pApa dvArA le lo?
tathA tuma use le bhI kaise sakate ho, jabaki tuma eka-dUsare se milana kara cuke ho tathA unhoMne tumase (vivAha ke samaya) dRr3ha vacana liyA hai|
aura una striyoM se vivAha[1] na karo, jinase tumhAre pitAoM ne vivAha kiyA ho, parantu jo pahale ho cukA[2]| vAstava meM, ye nirlajjA kI tathA apriya bAta aura burI rIti thI|

tumapara[1] ha़rAma (avaidha) kara dI gayI haiM; tumhArI mAtAyeM, tumhArI putriyA~, tumhArI bahaneM, tumhArI phUphiyA~, tumhArI mosiyA~ aura bhatIjiyA~, bhA~jiyA~, tumhArI ve mAtAyeM jinhoMne tumheM dUdha pilAyA ho tathA dUdha pIne se saMbaMdhita bahaneM, tumhArI patniyoM kI mAtAyeM, tumhArI patniyoM kI putriyA~ jinakA pAlana poSaNa tumhArI goda meM huA ho aura una patniyoM se tumane saMbhoga kiyA ho, yadi unase saMbhoga na kiyA ho, to tumapara koI doSa nahIM, tumhAre sage putroM kI patniyA~ aura ye[2] ki tuma do bahanoM ko ekatra karo, parantu jo ho cukA| vAstava meM, allAha ati kSamAzIla dayAvAn hai|

tathA una striyoM se (vivAha varjita hai), jo dUsaroM ke nikAha़ meM hoM| parantu tumhArI dAsiyA~[1] jo (yudhda meM) tumhAre hAtha AyI hoM| (ye) tumapara allAha ne likha diyA[2] hai| aura inake sivA (dUsarI striyA~) tumhAre lie ha़lAla (ucita) kara dI gayI haiM| (pratibaMdha ye hai ki) apane dhanoM dvArA vyabhicAra se surakSita rahane ke lie vivAha karo| phira unameM se jisase lAbha uThAo, unheM unakA mahara (vivAha upahAra) avazya cukA do tathA mahara (vivAha upahAra) nirdhArita karane ke pazcAt (yadi) Apasa kI sahamati se (koI kamI yA adhiktA kara lo), to tumapara koI doSa nahIM| niHsaMdeha, allAha ati jJAnI, tatvajJa hai|

aura jo vyakti tumameM se svataMtra ImAna vAliyoM se vivAha karane kI sakata na rakhe, to vaha apane hAthoM meM AI huI apanI ImAna vAlI dAsiyoM se (vivAha kara le)| daraasala, allAha tumhAre ImAna ko adhika jAnatA hai| tuma Apasa meM eka hI ho[1]| ataH tuma unake svAmiyoM kI anumati se una (dAsiyoM) se vivAha kara lo aura unheM niyamAnusAra unake mahara (vivAha upahAra) cukA do, ve satI hoM, vyabhicAriNI na hoM, na gupta premI banA rakhI hoM| phira jaba ve vivAhita ho jAyeM, to yadi vyabhicAra kara jAyeM, to unapara usakA AdhA[2] daNDa hai, jo svataMtra striyoM para hai| ye (dAsI se vivAha) usake lie hai, jo tumameM se vyabhicAra se DaratA ho aura sahana karo, to ye tumhAre lie adhika acchA hai aura allAha ati kSamAzIla dayAvAn hai|
allAha cAhatA hai ki tumhAre lie ujAgara kara de tathA tumheM bhI unakI nItiyoM kI rAha darzA de, jo tumase pahale the aura tumhArI kSamA yAcanA svIkAra kare| allAha ati jJAnI tatvajJa hai|
aura allAha cAhatA hai ki tumapara dayA kare tathA jo loga AkAMkSAoM ke pIche par3e hue haiM, ve cAhate haiM ki tuma bahuta adhika jhuka[1] jAo|
allAha tumhArA (bojha) halkA karanA[1] cAhatA hai tathA mAnava nirbala paidA kiyA gayA hai|

he ImAna vAlo! Apasa meM eka-dUsare kA dhana avaidha rUpa se na khAo, parantu ye ki lena-dena tumhArI Apasa kI svIkRti se (dharma vidhAnusAra) ho aura Atma hatyA[1] na karo, vAstava meM, allAha tumhAre lie ati dayAvAn hai|
aura jo atikramaNa tathA atyAcAra se aisA karegA, samIpa hai ki hama use agni meM jhoMka deMge aura ye allAha ke lie sarala hai|
tathA yadi tuma, una mahA pApoM se bacate rahe, jinase tumheM rokA jA rahA hai, to hama tumhAre lie tumhAre doSoM ko kSamA kara deMge aura tumheM sammAnita sthAna meM praveza deMge|

tathA usakI kAmanA na karo, jisake dvArA allAha ne tumheM eka-dUsare para zreSThatA dI hai| puruSoM ke lie usakA bhAga hai, jo unhoMne kamAyA[1] aura striyoM ke lie usakA bhAga hai, jo unhoMne kamAyA hai| tathA allaha se usase adhika kI prArthanA karate raho| niHsaMdeha allAha saba kucha jAnatA hai|

aura hamane pratyeka ke lie vArisa (uttarAdhikArI) banA diye haiM, usameM se jo mAtA-pitA tathA samIpavartiyoM ne chor3A ho tathA jinase tumane samajhautA[1] kiyA ho, unheM unakA bhAga do| vAstava meM, allAha pratyeka cIz2a se sUcita hai|

puruSa striyoM ke vyavasthApaka[1] haiM, isa kAraNa ki allAha ne unameM se eka ko dUsare para pradhAnatA dI hai tathA isa kAraNa ki unhoMne apane dhanoM meM se (unapara) qharca kiyA hai| ataH, sadAcArI striyA~ vo haiM, jo AjJAkArI tathA unakI (arthAta, patiyoM kI) anupasthiti meM allAha kI rakSA meM unake adhikAroM kI rakSA karatI hoM| phira tumheM jinakI avajJA kA Dara ho, to unheM samajhAo aura zayanAgAroM (sone ke sthAnoM) meM unase alaga ho jAo tathA unheM mAro| phira yadi ve tumhArI bAta mAneM, to unapara atyAcAra kA bahAnA na khojo aura allAha sabase Upara, sabase bar3A hai|

aura yadi tumheM[1] donoM ke bIca viyoga kA Dara ho, to eka madhyasta usa (pati) ke gharAne se tathA eka madhyasta usa (patnI) ke gharAne se niyukta karo, yadi ve donoM saMdhi karAnA cAheMge, to allAha una donoM[2] ke bIca saMdhi karA degA| vAstava meM, allAha ati jJAnI sarvasUcita hai|

tathA allAha kI ibAdata (vaMdanA) karo, kisI cIz2a ko usakA sAjhI na banAo tathA mAtA-pitA, samIpavartiyoM, anAthoM, nirdhanoM, samIpa aura dUra ke par3osI, yAtrA ke sAthI, yAtri aura apane dAsa dAsiyoM ke sAtha upakAra karo| niHsaMdeha allAha usase prema nahIM karatA, jo abhimAnI ahaMkArI[1] ho|

aura jo svayaM kRpaNa (kaMjUsI) karate haiM tathA dUsaroM ko bhI kRpaNa (kaMjUsI) kA Adeza dete haiM aura use chupAte haiM, jo allAha ne unheM apanI dayA se pradAna kiyA hai| hamane kRtaghnoM ke lie apamAnakArI yAtanA taiyAra kara rakhI hai|
tathA jo loga apanA dhana, logoM ko dikhAne ke lie dAna karate haiM aura allaha tathA aMtima dina (pralaya) para ImAna nahIM rakhate tathA zaitAna jisakA sAthI ho, to vaha bahuta burA sAthI[1] hai|

aura unakA kyA bigar3a jAtA, yadi ve allAha tathA antima dina (paraloka) para ImAna (vizvAsa) rakhate aura allAha ne jo unheM diyA hai, usameM se dAna karate? aura allAha unheM bhalI-bhA~ti jAnatA hai|
allAha kaNa bhara bhI kisI para atyAcAra nahIM karatA, yadi kucha bhalAI (kisI ne) kI ho, to (allAha) use adhika kara detA hai tathA apane pAsa se bar3A pratiphala pradAna karatA hai|
to kyA dazA hogI, jaba hama pratyeka ummata (samudAya) se eka sAkSI lAyeMge aura (he nabI!) Apako unapara (banAkara) sAkSI lAyeMge[1]|
usa dina, jo kAfira tathA rasUla ke avajJAkArI ho gaye, ye kAmanA kareMge ki unake sahita bhUmi barAbara[1] kara dI jAye aura ve allAha se koI bAta chupA nahIM sakeMge|

he ImAna vAlo! tuma jaba naze[1] meM raho, to namAz2a ke samIpa na jAo, jaba taka jo kucha bolo, use na samajho aura na janAbata[2] kI sthiti meM (masjidoM ke samIpa jAo), parantu rAstA pAra karate hue| yadi tuma rogI ho athavA yAtrA meM raho yA striyoM se sahavAsa kara lo, phira jala na pAo, to pavitra miTTI se tayammuma[3] kara lo; use apane mukhoM tathA hAthoM para phera lo| vAstava meM, allAha ati kSAMta (sahiSNu) kSamAzIla hai|
kyA Apane unakI dazA nahIM dekhI, jinheM pustaka[1] kA kucha bhAga diyA gayA? ve kupatha qharIda rahe haiM tathA cAhate haiM ki tumabhI supatha se vicalita ho jAo|
tathA allAha tumhAre zatruoM se bhalI-bhA~ti avagata hai aura (tumhAre lie) allAha kI rakSA kAfI hai tathA allAha kI sahAyatA kAfI hai|

(he nabI!) yahUdiyoM meM se kucha loga aise haiM, jo zabdoM ko unake (vAstavika) sthAnoM se pherate haiM aura (Apase) kahate haiM ki hamane suna liyA tathA (ApakI) avajJA kI aura Apa sunie, Apa sunAye na jAyeM! tathA apanI z2ubAneM mor3akara "rAinA" kahate aura satdharma meM vyaMga karate haiM aura yadi ve "hamane suna liyA aura AjJAkArI ho gaye" aura "hameM dekhie" kahate, to unake lie adhika acchI tathA sahI bAta hotI| parantu allAha ne unake kufra ke kAraNa unheM dhikkAra diyA hai| ataH, unameM se thor3e hI ImAna lAyeMge|

he ahle kitAba! usa (qurAna) para ImAna lAo, jise hamane una (pustakoM) kA pramANakArI banAkara utArA hai, jo tumhAre sAtha haiM, isase pahale ki hama cehare bigAr3a kara pIche kara deM athavA unheM aise hI dhikkAra[1] deM, jaise zanivAra vAloM ko dhikkAra diyA| allAha kA Adeza pUrA ho kara rahA|
niHsaMdeha allAha ye nahIM kSamA karegA ki usakA sAjhI banAyA jAye[1] aura usake sivA jise cAhe, kSamA kara degA| jo allAha kA sAjhI banAtA hai, to usane mahA pApa gar3ha liyA|
kyA Apane unheM nahIM dekhA, jo apane Apa pavitra bana rahe haiM? balki allAha jise cAhe, pavitra karatA hai aura (logoM para) kaNa barAbara atyAcAra nahIM kiyA jAyegA|
dekho, ye loga kaise allAha para mithyA Aropa lagA rahe[1] haiM! unake khule pApa ke lie yahI bahuta hai|

(he nabI!) kyA Apane unakI dazA nahIM dekhI, jinheM pustaka kA kucha bhAga diyA gayA? ve mUrtiyoM tathA zaitAnoM para ImAna (vizvAsa) rakhate haiM aura kAfiroM[1] ke bAre meM kahate haiM ki ye ImAna vAloM se adhika sIdhI Dagara para haiM|
aura jise allAha dhikkAra de, Apa usakA kadApi koI sahAyaka nahIM pAeMge|
kyA unake pAsa rAjya kA koI bhAga hai, isalie logoM ko (usameM se) tanika bhI nahIM deMge?

balki ve logoM[1] se usa anugraha para vidveSa kara rahe haiM, jo allAha ne unheM pradAna kiyA hai| to hamane (pahale bhI) ibrAhIma ke gharAne ko pustaka tathA ha़ikmata (tatvadarzitA) dI hai aura unheM vizAla rAjya pradAna kiyA hai|
phira unameM se koI ImAna lAyA aura koI usase vimukha ho gayA| (to vimukha hone vAle ke lie) naraka kI bhar3akatI agni bahuta hai|

vAstava meM, jina logoM ne hamArI AyatoM ke sAtha kufra (avizvAsa) kiyA, hama unheM naraka meM jhoMka deMge| jaba-jaba unakI khAleM pakeMgI, hama unakI khAleM badala deMge, tAki ve yAtanA cakheM, niHsaMdeha allAha prabhutvazAlI tatvajJa hai|

aura jo loga ImAna lAye tathA sadAcAra kiye, hama unheM aise svargoM meM praveza deMge, jinameM nahareM pravAhita haiM| jinameM ve sadAvAsI hoMge, unake lie unameM nirmala patniyA~ hoMgI aura hama unheM ghanI chA~voM meM rakheMge|

allAha[1] tumheM Adeza detA hai ki dharohara unake svAmiyoM ko cukA do aura jaba logoM ke bIca nirNaya karo, to nyAya ke sAtha nirNaya karo| allAha tumheM acchI bAta kA nirdeza de rahA hai| niHsaMdeha allAha saba kucha sunane-dekhane vAlA hai|

ai ImAna vAlo! allAha kA AjJApAlana karo aura rasUla kA AjJApAlana karo aura apane meM se adhikAra vAloM (zAsakoM) kA| phira yadi tuma Apasa meM kisI cIz2a meM matabheda kara baiTho, to use allAha aura rasUla kI ora lauTAo, yadi tuma allAha tathA aMtima dina (paraloka) para ImAna rakhate ho| yaha (tumhAre lie) bahuta behatara hai aura pariNAma kI dRSTi se bahuta acchA hai|

(he nabI!) kyA Apane una dvidhAvAdiyoM (munAfiqoM) ko nahIM jAnA, jinakA ye dAvA hai ki jo kucha Apapara avatarita huA hai tathA jo kucha Apase pUrva avatarita huA hai, unapara ImAna rakhate haiM, kintu cAhate haiM ki apane vivAda kA nirNaya vidrohI ke pAsa le jAyeM, jabaki unheM Adeza diyA gayA hai ki use asvIkAra kara deM? aura zaitAna cAhatA hai ki unheM satdharma se bahuta dUra[1] kara de|
tathA jaba unase kahA jAtA hai ki usa (qurAna) kI ora Ao, jo allAha ne utArA hai tathA rasUla kI (sunnata kI) ora, to Apa munAfiqoM (dvidhAvAdiyoM) ko dekhate haiM ki ve Apase mu~ha phera rahe haiM|

tathA (usane batAyA ki) ye (islAma hI) allAha kI sIdhI rAha[1] hai| ataH isIpara calo aura dUsarI rAhoM para na calo, anyathA vaha tumheM usakI rAha se dUra karake tittara-bittara kara deMge| yahI hai, jisakA Adeza usane tumheM diyA hai, tAki tuma usake AjJAkArI raho|

phira hamane mUsA ko pustaka (taurAta) pradAna kI thI, usapara puraskAra pUrA karane ke lie, jo sadAcArI ho tathA pratyeka vastu ke vivaraNa ke lie tathA ye mArgadarzana aura dayA thI, tAki ve apane pAlanahAra se milane para ImAna lAyeM|
tathA (usI prakAra) ye pustaka (qurAna) hamane avatarita kI hai, ye bar3A zubhakArI hai, ataH isapara calo[1] aura allAha se Darate raho, tAki tumapara dayA kI jAye|
tAki (he araba vAsiyo!) tuma ye na kaho ki hamase pUrva do samudAya (yahUda tathA IsAI) para pustaka utArI gayI aura hama unake par3hane-par3hAne se anajAna raha gaye|

yA ye na kaho ki yadi hamapara pustaka utArI jAtI, to hama nizcaya unase adhika sIdhI rAha para hote, to aba tumhAre pAsa tumhAre pAlanahAra kI ora se eka khulA tarka A gayA, mArgadarzana tathA dayA A gayI| phira usase bar3A atyacArI kauna hogA, jo allAha kI AyatoM ko mithyA kaha de aura unase katarA jAye? aura jo loga hamArI AyatoM se katarAte haiM, hama unake katarAne ke badale unheM kar3I yAtanA deMge|

kyA ve loga isI bAta kI pratIkSA kara rahe haiM ki unake pAsa farizte A jAyeM, yA svayaM unakA pAlanahAra A jAye yA Apake pAlanahAra kI koI Ayata (nizAnI) A jAye?[1] jisa dina Apake pAlanahAra kI koI nizAnI A jAyegI, to kisI prANI ko usakA ImAna lAbha nahIM degA, jo pahale ImAna na lAyA ho yA apane ImAna kI sthiti meM koI satkarma na kiyA ho| Apa kaha deM ki tuma pratIkSA karo, hama bhI pratIkSA kara rahe haiM|

jisakA koI sAjhI nahIM tathA mujhe isI kA Adeza diyA gayA hai aura maiM prathama musalamAnoM meM se hU~|

Apa unase kaha deM ki kyA maiM allAha ke sivA kisI aura pAlanahAra kI khoja karU~? jabaki vaha (allAha) pratyeka cIz2a kA pAlanahAra hai tathA koI prANI, koI bhI kukarma karegA, to usakA bhAra usI ke Upara hogA aura koI kisI dUsare kA bojha nahIM uThAyegA| phira (aMtataH) tumheM apane pAlanahAra ke pAsa hI jAnA hai| to jina bAtoM meM tuma vibheda kara rahe ho vo tumheM batA degA|

vahI hai, jisane tumheM dharatI meM adhikAra diyA hai aura tumameM se kucha ko (dhana zakti meM) dUsare se kaI zreNiyA~ U~cA kiyA hai| tAki usameM tumhArI parIkSA[1] le, jo tumheM diyA hai| vAstava meM, ApakA pAlanahAra zIghra hI daNDa dene vAlA[2] hai aura vAstava meM, vaha ati kSamI dayAvAn hai|
alifa, lAma, mIma, sAda|
ye pustaka hai, jo ApakI ora utArI gayI hai| ataH (he nabI!) Apake mana meM isase koI saMkoca na ho, tAki Apa isake dvArA sAvadhAna kareM[1] aura ImAna vAloM ke lie upadeza hai|
(he logo!) jo tumhAre pAlanahAra kI ora se tumapara utArA gayA hai, usapara calo aura usake sivA dUsare sahAyakoM ke pIche na calo| tuma bahuta thor3I zikSA lete ho|
tathA bahuta sI bastiyA~ haiM, jinheM hamane dhvasta kara diyA hai, unapara hamArA prakopa akasmAta rAtri meM AyA yA jaba ve dopahara ke samaya ArAma kara rahe the|
aura jaba unapara hamArA prakopa A par3A, to unakI pukAra yahI thI ki vAstava meM hama hI atyAcArI[1] the|
to hama unase avazya prazna kareMge, jinake pAsa rasUloM ko bhejA gayA tathA rasUloM se bhI avazya[1] prazna kareMge|
phira hama apane jJAna se unake samakSa vAstaviktA kA varNana kara deMge tathA hama anupasthita nahIM the|
tathA usa (pralaya ke) dina (karmoM kI) tola nyAya ke sAtha hogI| phira jisake palar3e bhArI hoMge, vahI saphala hoMge|
aura jinake palar3e halake hoMge, vahI svayaM ko kSati meM DAla lie hoMge| kyoMki ve hamArI AyatoM ke sAtha atyAcAra karate[1] rahe|
tatha hamane tumheM dharatI meM adhikAra diyA aura usameM tumhAre lie jIvana ke saMsAdhana banAye| tuma thor3e hI kRtajJa hote ho|
aura hamane tumheM paidA kiyA[1], phira tumhArA rUpa banAyA, phira hamane fariztoM se kahA ki Adama ko sajdA karo, to iblIsa ke sivA sabane sajdA kiyA| vaha sajdA karane vAloM meM se na huA|
allAha ne usase kahAH kisa bAta ne tujhe sajdA karane se roka diyA, jabaki maiMne tujhe Adeza diyA thA? usane kahAH maiM usase uttama hU~| merI racanA tUne agni se kI hai aura usakI miTTI se|
to allAha ne kahAH isa (svarga) se utara jA| tere lie ye yogya nahIM ki isameM ghamaNDa kare| tU nikala jA| vAstava meM, tU apamAnitoM meM hai|
usane kahAH mujhe usa dina taka ke lie avasara de do, jaba loga phira jIvita kiye jAyeMge|
allAha ne kahAH tujhe avasara diyA jA rahA hai|
usane kahAH to jisa prakAra tUne mujhe kupatha kiyA hai, maiMbhI terI sIdhI rAha para inakI ghAta meM lagA rahU~gA|
phira unake pAsa unake Age aura pIche tathA dAyeM aura bAyeM se AU~gA[1] aura tU unameM se adhiktara ko (apanA) kRtajJa nahIM pAyegA[2]|
allAha ne kahAH yahA~ se apamAnita dhikkArA huA nikala jA| jo bhI unameM se terI rAha calegA, to maiM tuma sabhI se naraka ko avazya bhara dU~gA|
aura he Adama! tuma aura tumhArI patnI svarga meM raho aura jahA~ se cAho, khAo aura isa vRkSa ke samIpa na jAnA, anyathA atyAcariyoM meM ho jAoge|

to zaitAna ne donoM ko saMzaya meM DAla diyA, tAki donoM ke lie unake guptAMgoM ko khola de, jo unase chupAye gaye the aura kahAH tumhAre pAlanahAra ne tuma donoM ko isa vRkSa se kevala isalie roka diyA hai ki tuma donoM farizte athavA sadAvAsI ho jAoge|
tathA donoM ke lie zapatha dI ki vAstava meM, maiM tuma donoM kA hitaiSI hU~|

to una donoM ko dhokhe se rijhA liyA| phira jaba donoM ne usa vRkSa kA svAda liyA, to unake lie unake guptAMga khula gaye aura ve unapara svarga ke patte cipakAne lage aura unheM unake pAlanahAra ne AvAz2a dIH kyA maiMne tumheM isa vRkSa se nahIM rokA thA aura tuma donoM se nahIM kahA thA ki zaitAna tumhArA khulA zatru hai?
donoM ne kahAH he hamAre pAlanahAra! hamane apane Upara atyAcAra kara liyA aura yadi tU hameM kSamA tathA hamapara dayA nahIM karegA, to hama avazya hI nAza ho[1] jAyeMge|
usane kahAH tuma saba utaro, tuma eka-dUsare ke zatru ho aura tumhAre lie dharatI meM rahanA aura eka nirdhArita samaya taka jIvana kA sAdhana hai|
tathA kahAH tuma usImeM jIvita rahoge, usImeM maroge aura usIse (phira) nikAle jAoge|

he Adama ke putro! hamane tumapara aisA vastra utAra diyA hai, jo tumhAre guptAMgoM ko chupAtA tathA zobhA hai aura allAha kI AjJAkAritA kA vastra hI sarvottama hai| ye allAha kI AyatoM meM se eka hai, tAki ve zikSA leM[1]|

he Adama ke putro! aisA na ho ki zaitAna tumheM bahakA de, jaise tumhAre mAtA-pitA ko svarga se nikAla diyA, unake vastra utaravA diye, tAki unheM unake guptAMga dikhA de| vAstava meM, vaha tathA usakI jAti, tumheM aise sthAna se dekhatI hai, jahA~ se tuma unheM nahIM dekha sakate| vAstava meM, hamane zaitAnoM ko unakA sahAyaka banA diyA hai, jo ImAna nahIM rakhate|

tathA jaba ve (muzrika) koI nirlajjA kA kAma karate haiM, to kahate haiM ki isI (rIti) para hamane apane pUrvajoM ko pAyA hai tathA allAha ne hameM isakA Adeza diyA hai| (he nabI!) Apa unase kaha deM ki allAha kabhI nirlajjA kA Adeza nahIM detA| kyA tuma allAha para aisI bAta kA Aropa dharate ho, jise tuma nahIM jAnate?

Apa unase kaha deM ki mere pAlanahAra ne nyAya kA Adeza diyA hai| (aura vo ye hai ki) pratyeka masjida meM namAz2a ke samaya apanA dhyAna sIdhe usI kI ora karo[1] aura usake lie dharma ko vizudhda karake usI ko pukAro| jisa prakAra, usane tumheM pahale paidA kiyA hai, usI prakAra, (pralaya meM) phira jIvita kara diye jAoge|

he Adama ke putro! pratyeka masjida ke pAsa (namAz2a ke samaya) apanI zobhA dhAraNa karo,[1] khAo-pio aura bejA qharca na karo| vastutaH, vaha bejA qharca karane vAloM se prema nahIM karatA|

(he nabI!) ina (mizraNavAdiyoM) se kahie ki kisane allAha kI usa zobhA ko ha़rAma (varjita) kiyA hai,[1] jise usane apane sevakoM ke lie nikAlA hai? tathA svaccha jIvikAoM ko? Apa kaha deM: ye sAMsArika jIvana meM unake lie (ucita) hai, jo ImAna lAye tathA pralaya ke dina unhIM ke lie vizeSa[2] hai| isI prakAra, hama apanI AyatoM kA savistAra varNana unake lie karate haiM, jo jJAna rakhate hoM|

(he nabI!) Apa kaha deM ki mere pAlanahAra ne to kevala khule tathA chupe kukarmoM, pApa tathA avaidha vidroha ko hI ha़rAma (varjita) kiyA hai tathA isa bAta ko ki tuma use allAha kA sAjhI banAo, jisakA koI tarka usane nahIM utArA hai tathA allAha para aisI bAta bolo, jise tuma nahIM jAnate|
pratyeka samudAya kA[1] eka nirdhArita samaya hai, phira jaba vaha samaya A jAyegA, to kSaNa bhara dera yA savera nahIM hogI|

aura jo hamArI AyateM jhuThalAyeMge aura unase ghamaNDa kareMge vahI nArakI hoMge aura vahI usameM sadAvAsI hoMge|

phira usase bar3A atyAcArI kauna hai, jo allAha para mithyA bAteM banAye athavA usakI AyatoM ko mithyA kahe? unheM unake bhAgya meM likhA bhAga mila jAyegA| yahA~ taka ki jisa samaya hamAre farizte unakA prANa nikAlane ke lie AyeMge, to unase kaheMge ki ve kahA~ haiM, jinheM tuma allAha ke sivA pukArate the? ve kaheMge ki ve to hamase kho gaye tathA apane hI virUdhda sAkSI (gavAha) bana jAyeMge ki vastutaH ve kAfira the|

allAha kA Adeza hogA ki tuma bhI praveza kara jAo, una samudAyoM meM, jo tumase pahale ke jinnoM aura manuSyoM meM se naraka meM| jaba bhI koI samudAya naraka meM praveza karegA, to apane samAna dUsare samudAya ko dhikkAra karegA, yahA~ taka ki jaba usameM saba ekatra ho jAyeMge, to unakA pichalA apane pahale ke lie kahegAH he hamAre pAlanahAra! inhoMne hI hameM kupatha kiyA hai| ataH inheM duganI yAtanA de| vaha (allAha) kahegAH tumameM se pratyeka ke lie duganI yAtanA hai, parantu tumheM jJAna nahIM|
tathA unakA pahalA samudAya apane dUsare samudAya se kahegAH (yadi hama doSI the) to hamapara tumhArI koI pradhAnatA nahIM[1] huI, to tuma apane kukarmoM kI yAtanA kA svAda lo|

vAstava meM, jinhoMne hamArI AyatoM ko jhuThalA diyA aura unase abhimAna kiyA, unake lie AkAza ke dvAra nahIM khole jAyeMge aura na ve svarga meM praveza kareMge, jaba taka[1] U~Ta sUI ke nAke se pAra na ho jAye aura hama isI prakAra aparAdhiyoM ko badalA dete haiM|
unhIM ke lie naraka kA bichaunA aura unake Upara se or3hanA hogA aura isI prakAra hama atyAcAriyoM ko pratikAra (badalA[1]) dete haiM|
aura jo ImAna lAye aura satkarma kiye aura hama kisIpara usakI sakata se (adhika) bhAra nahIM rakhate| vahI svargI haiM, aura vahI usameM sadAvAsI hoMge|

tathA unake diloM meM jo dveSa hogA, use hama nikAla deMge[1]| una (svargoM meM) bahatI nahareM hoMgI tathA ve kaheMge ki usa allAha kI prazaMsA hai, jisane hameM isakI rAha dikhAI aura yadi allAha hameM mArgadarzana na detA, to hameM mArgadarzana na milatA| hamAre pAlanahAra ke rasUla satya lekara Aye tathA unheM pukArA jAyegA ki isa svarga ke adhikArI tuma apane satkarmoM ke kAraNa hue ho|

jo logoM ko allAha kI rAha (satdharma) se rokate tathA use Ter3hA karanA cAhate the aura vahI praloka ke prati vizvAsa nahIM rakhate|

aura donoM (naraka tathA svarga) ke bIca eka paradA hogA aura kucha loga ArAfa[1] (U~cAiyoM) para hoMge, jo pratyeka ko unake lakSaNoM se pahacAneMge aura svarga vAsiyoM ko pukArakara unheM salAma kareMge aura unhoMne usameM praveza nahIM kiyA hogA, parantu usakI AzA rakhate hoMge|

(Aja unase kahA jA rahA hai ki) svarga meM praveza kara jAo, na tumapara kisI prakAra kA bhaya hai aura na tuma udAsIna hoge|

jabaki hamane unake lie eka aisI pustaka dI, jise hamane jJAna ke AdhAra para savistAra varNita kara diyA hai, jo mArgadarzana tathA dayA hai, una logoM ke lie, jo ImAna (vizvAsa) rakhate haiM|

(phira) kyA ve isakI pratIkSA kara rahe haiM ki isakA pariNAma sAmane A jAye? jisa dina isakA pariNAma A jAyegA, to vahI, jo isase pahale ise bhUle hue the, kaheMge ki hamAre pAlanahAra ke rasUla saca lekara Ae the, (parantu hamane nahIM mAnA) to kyA hamAre lie koI anuzaMsaka (sifArizI) hai, jo hamArI anuzaMsA (sifAriza) kare? athavA hama saMsAra meM phera die jAye~, to jo karma hama karate rahe, unake viparIta karma kareMge! unahoMne svayaM ko chati meM DAla diyA tathA unase jo mithyA bAteM banA rahe the kho gaIM|

tumhArA pAlanahAra vahI allAha hai, jisane AkAzoM tathA dharatI ko chaH dinoM meM banAyA[1], phira arza (siMhAsana) para sthita ho gayA| vaha rAtri se dina ko Dhaka detA hai, dina usake pIche daur3atA huA A jAtA hai, sUrya tathA cA~da aura tAre usakI AjJA ke adhIna haiM| suna lo! vahI utpattikAra hai aura vahI zAsaka[2] hai| vahI allAha ati zubha saMsAra kA pAlanahAra hai|

aura svaccha bhUmi apanI upaja allAha kI anumati se bharapUra detI hai tathA kharAba bhUmi kI upaja thor3I hI hotI hai| isI prakAra, hama apanI[1] AyateM (nizAniyA~) unake lie duharAte haiM, jo zukra adA karate haiM|

hamane nUha़[1] ko usakI jAti kI ora (apanA saMdeza pahu~cAne ke lie) bhejA thA, to usane kahAH he merI jAti ke logo! (kevala) allAha kI ibAdata (vaMdanA) karo, usake sivA tumhArA koI pUjya nahIM| maiM tumapara eka bar3e dina kI yAtanA se DaratA hU~|

phira jaba mUsA kA krodha zAnta ho gayA, to usane lekha taqhtiyA~ uThA lIM, jinake likhe AdezoM meM mArgadarzana tathA dayA thI, una logoM ke lie, jo apane pAlanahAra se hI Darate hoM|

jo bace rahe tAg2Uta (asura)[1] kI pUjA se tathA dhyAnamagna ho gaye allAha kI ora, to unhIM ke lie zubha sUcanA hai| ataH, Apa zubha sUcanA sunA deM mere bhaktoM ko|
jo dhyAna se sunate haiM isa bAta ko, phira anusaraNa karate haiM isa sarvottama bAta kA, to vahI haiM, jinheM supatha darzA diyA hai allAha ne tathA vahI matimAna haiM|
to kyA jisapara yAtanA kI bAta sidhda ho gayI, kyA Apa nikAla sakeMge use, jo naraka meM haiM?
kintu, jo apane pAlanahAra se Dare, unhIM ke lie ucca bhavana haiM| jinake Upara nirmita bhavana haiM| pravAhita haiM jinameM nahareM, ye allAha kA vacana hai aura allAha vacana bhaMga nahIM karatA|

kyA tumane nahIM dekhA[1] ki allAha ne utArA AkAza se jala? phira pravAhita kara diye usake srota dharatI meM| phira nikAlatA hai usase khetiyA~ vibhinna raMgoM kI| phira sUkha jAtI haiM, to tuma dekhate ho unheM pIlI, phira use cUra-cUra kara detA hai| nizcaya isameM bar3I zikSA hai matimAnoM ke lie|

to kyA khola diyA ho allAha ne jisakA sInA islAma ke lie, to vaha eka prakAza para ho apane pAlanahAra kI ora se| to vinAza hai jinake dila kar3e ho gaye allAha ke smaraNa se, vahI khule kupatha meM haiM|

allAha hI hai, jisane sarvottama ha़dIsa (qurAna) ko avatarita kiyA hai| aisI pustaka, jisakI AyateM milatI-julatI bAra-bAra duharAI jAne vAlI haiM| jise (sunakara) khar3e ho jAte haiM unake rU~gaTe, jo Darate haiM apane pAlanahAra se| phira komala ho jAte haiM unake aMga tathA dila, allAha ke smaraNa kI ora| yahI hai allAha kA mArgadarzana, jisake dvArA vaha saMmArga para lagA detA hai, jise cAhatA hai aura jise allAha kupatha kara de, to usakA koI pathadarzaka nahIM hai|
to kyA jo apanI rakSA karegA apane mukha[1] se, burI yAtanA se, pralaya ke dina? tathA kahA jAyegA atyAcAriyoM seH cakho, jo tuma kara rahe the|
jhuThalA diyA unhoMne, jo inase pUrva the| to A gayI yAtanA unake pAsa, jahA~ se unheM anumAna (bhI) na thA|
to cakhA diyA allAha ne unheM apamAna, sAMsArika jIvana meM aura Aqhirata (paraloka) kI yAtanA nizcaya atyadhika bar3I hai| kyA hI acchA hotA, yadi ve jAnate|
aura hamane manuSya ke lie isa qurAna meM pratyeka udAharaNa diye haiM, tAki ve zikSA grahaNa kareM|
arabI bhASA meM qurAna, jisameM koI Ter3hApana nahIM hai, tAki ve allAha se DareM|

allAha ne eka udAharaNa diyA hai eka vyakti kA, jisameM bahuta-se paraspara virodhI sAjhI haiM tathA eka vyakti pUrA eka vyakti kA (dAsa) hai| to kyA dazA meM donoM samAna ho jAyeMge?[1] saba prazaMsA allAha ke lie hai, balki unameM se adhiktara nahIM jAnate|
(he nabI!) nizcaya Apako maranA hai tathA unheM bhI maranA hai|
phira tuma sabhI[1] pralaya ke dina allAha ke samakSa jhagar3oge|
to usase bar3A atyAcArI kauna ho sakatA hai jo allAha para jhUTha bole tathA saca ko jhuThalAye, jaba usake pAsa A gayA? to kyA naraka meM nahIM hai, aise kAfiroM kA sthAna?
tathA jo satya lAye[1] aura jisane use saca mAnA, to vahI (yAtanA se) surakSita rahane vAle haiM|
unhIM ke lie hai, jo vaha cAheMge unake pAlanahAra ke yahA~ aura yahI sadAcAriyoM kA pratiphala hai|
tAki allAha kSamA kara de, jo kukarma unhoMne kiye haiM tathA unheM pradAna kare unakA pratiphala unake uttama karmoM ke badale, jo ve kara rahe the|
kyA allAha prayApta nahIM hai apane bhakta ke lie? tathA vaha Apako DarAte haiM unase, jo usake sivA haiM tathA jise allAha kupatha kara de, to nahIM hai use koI supatha darzAne vAlA|
aura jise allAha supatha darzA de, to nahIM hai use koI kupatha karane vAlA| kyA nahIM hai allAha prabhutvazAlI, badalA lene vAlA?

aura yadi Apa, unase prazna kareM ki kisane paidA kiyA hai AkAzoM tathA dharatI ko? to ve avazya kaheMge ki allAha ne| Apa kahiye ki tuma batAo, jise tuma allAha ke sivA pukArate ho, yadi allAha mujhe koI hAni pahu~cAnA cAhe, to kyA ye usakI hAni dUra kara sakatA haiM? athavA mere sAtha dayA karanA cAhe, to kyA ye roka sakate haiM usakI dayA ko? Apa kaha deM ki mujhe paryApta hai allAha aura usIpara bharosA karate haiM, bharosA karane vAle|
Apa kaha deM ki he merI jAti ke logo! tuma kAma karo apane sthAna para, maiMbhI kAma kara rahA hU~| to zIghra hI tumheM jJAna ho jAyegA|
ki kisake pAsa AtI hai aisI yAtanA, jo use apamAnita kara de tathA utaratI hai kisake Upara sthAyI yAtanA?

vAstava meM, hamane hI avatarita kI hai Apapara ye pustaka, logoM ke lie satya ke sAtha| to jisane mArgadarzana prApta kara liyA, to usake apane (lAbha ke) lie hai tathA jo kupatha ho gayA, to vaha kupatha hotA hai apane Upara tathA Apa unapara saMrakSaka nahIM haiM|

allAha hI khIMcatA hai prANoM ko, unake maraNa ke samaya tathA jisake maraNa kA samaya nahIM AyA, usakI nidrA meM| phira roka letA hai jisapara nirNaya kara diyA ho maraNa kA tathA bheja detA hai anya ko, eka nirdhArita samaya taka ke lie| vAstava meM, isameM kaI nizAniyA~ haiM unake lie, jo manana-cintana[1] karate hoM|
kyA unhoMne banA lie haiM allAha ke atirikta bahuta-se abhistAvaka (sifArizI)? Apa kaha deM: kyA (ye sifAriza kareMge) yadi ve adhikAra na rakhate hoM kisI cIz2a kA aura na hI samajha sakate hoM?
Apa kaha deM ki anuzaMsA (sifAriza) to saba allAha ke adhikAra meM hai| usI ke lie hai AkAzoM tathA dharatI kA rAjya| phira usI kI ora tuma phirAye jAoge|

tathA jaba varNana kiyA jAtA hai akele allAha kA, to saMkIrNa hone lagate haiM unake dila, jo ImAna nahIM rakhate Aqhirata[1] para tathA jaba varNana kiyA jAtA hai unakA, jo usake sivA haiM, to ve sahasA prasanna ho jAte haiM|
(he nabI!) Apa kaheM: he allAha AkAzoM tathA dharatI ke paidA karane vAle, parokSa tathA pratyakSa ke jJAnI! tU hI nirNaya karegA apane bhaktoM ke bIca, jisa bAta meM ve jhagar3a rahe the|

aura yadi unakA, jinhoMne atyAcAra kiyA hai, jo kucha dharatI meM hai, saba ho jAye tathA usake samAna usake sAtha aura A jAye, to ve use daNDa meM de deMge[1] ghora yAtanA ke badale, pralaya ke dina tathA khula jAyegI unake lie allAha kI ora, se vo bAta, jise ve samajha nahIM rahe the|
tathA khula jAyeMgI unake lie unake karatUtoM kI burAIyA~ aura unheM ghera legA, jisakA ve upahAsa kara rahe the|

aura jaba pahu~catA hai manuSyoM ko koI duHkha, to hameM pukAratA hai| phira jaba hama pradAna karate haiM koI sukha apanI ora se, to kahatA haiH ye to mujhe pradAna kiyA gayA hai jJAna ke kAraNa| balki, ye eka parIkSA hai| kintu, logoM meM se adhiktara (ise) nahIM jAnate|
yahI bAta, una logoM ne bhI kahI thI, jo inase pUrva the| to nahIM kAma AyA unake, jo kucha ve kamA rahe the|
phira A par3e unapara unake saba kukarma aura jo atyAcAra kiye haiM inameM se, A par3eMge unapara (bhI) unake kukarma tathA ve (hameM) vivaza karane vAle nahIM haiM|
kyA unheM jJAna nahIM ki allAha phailAtA hai jIvikA, jisake lie cAhatA hai tathA nApakara detA hai (jisake lie cAhatA hai)? nizcaya isameM kaI nizAniyA~ haiM, una logoM ke lie, jo ImAna rakhate haiM|

Apa kaha deM mere una bhaktoM se, jinhoMne apane Upara atyAcAra kiye haiM ki tuma nirAza[1] na ho allAha kI dayA se| vAstava meM, allAha kSamA kara detA hai saba pApoM ko| nizcaya vaha ati kSamI, dayAvAn hai|
tathA jhuka par3o apane pAlanahAra kI ora aura AjJAkArI ho jAo usake, isase pUrva ki tumapara yAtanA A jAye, phira tumhArI sahAyatA na kI jAye|
tathA pAlana karo usa sarvottama (qarAna) kA, jo avatarita kiyA gayA hai tumhArI ora tumhAre pAlanahAra kI ora se, isase pUrva ki A par3e tumapara yAtanA aura tumheM jJAna na ho|
(aisA na ho ki) koI vyakti kahe ki hAya saMtApa! isa bAta para ki maiM Alasya kiyA allAha ke pakSa meM tathA maiM upahAsa karane vAloM meM raha gayA|
athavA kahe ki yadi allAha mujhe supatha dikhAtA, to maiM Darane vAloM meM se ho jAtA|
athavA kahe jaba dekha le yAtanA ko ki yadi mujhe (saMsAra meM) phirakara jAne kA avasara ho jAye, to maiM avazya sadAcAriyoM meM se ho jAU~gA|
hA~, AIM tumhAre pAsa merI nizAniyA~, to tumane unheM jhuThalA diyA aura abhimAna kiyA tathA tuma the hI kAfiroM meM se|
aura pralaya ke dina Apa unheM dekheMge, jinhoMne allAha para jhUTha bole ki unake mukha kAle hoMge| to kyA naraka meM nahIM hai abhimAniyoM kA sthAna?
tathA bacA legA allAha jo AjJAkArI rahe, unheM, unakI saphalatA ke sAtha| nahIM lagegA unheM koI duHkha aura na ve udAsIna hoMge|
allAha hI pratyeka vastu kA paidA karane vAlA tathA vahI pratyeka vastu kA rakSaka hai|
usI ke adhikAra meM haiM AkAzoM tathA dharatI kI kuMjiyA~[1] tathA jinhoMne nakAra diyA allAha kI AyatoM ko, vahI kSati meM haiM|
Apa kaha deM: to kyA allAha se anya kI tuma mujhe ibAdata (vaMdanA) karane kA Adeza dete ho, he ajJAno?
tathA vaha़yI kI gaI hai ApakI ora tathA una (nabiyoM) kI ora, jo Apase pUrva (hue) ki yadi Apane zirka kiyA, to avazya vyartha ho jAyegA ApakA karma tathA Apa ho jAyeMge[1] kSatigrastoM meM se|
balki Apa allAha hI kI ibAdata (vaMdanA) kareM tathA kRjJayoM meM raheM|

tathA unhoMne allAha kA sammAna nahIM kiyA, jaise usakA sammAna karanA cAhiye thA aura dharatI pUrI usakI eka muTThI meM hogI, pralaya ke dina tathA AkAza lapeTe hue hoMge usake hAtha[1] meM| vaha pavitra tathA ucca hai usa zirka se, jo ve kara rahe haiM|

tathA sUra (narasiMdhaghA) phU~kA[1] jAyegA, to nizceta hokara gira jAyeMge, jo AkAzoM tathA dharatI meM haiM| parantu jise allAha cAhe, phira use punaH phU~kA jAyegA, to sahasA saba khar3e dekha rahe hoMge|

tathA jagamagAne lagegI dharatI, apane pAlanahAra kI jyoti se aura prastuta kiye jAyeMge karma lekha tathA lAyA jAyegA nabiyoM aura sAkSiyoM ko tathA nirNaya kiyA jAyegA unake bIca satya (nyAya) ke sAtha aura unapara atyAcAra nahIM kiyA jAyegA|
tathA pUrA-pUrA diyA jAyegA pratyeka jIva ko, usakA karmaphala tathA vaha bhalI-bhA~ti jAnane vAlA hai use, jo ve kara rahe haiM|

tathA hA~ke jAyeMge, jo kAfira ho gaye naraka kI ora, jhuNDa banAkara| yahA~taka ki jaba ve usake pAsa AyeMge, to khola diye jAyeMge usake dvAra tathA unase kaheMge usake rakSaka (farizteH) kyA nahIM Aye tumhAre pAsa rasUla tumameM se, jo tumheM sunAte, tumhAre pAlanahAra kI AyateM tathA saceta karate tumheM, isa dina kA sAmanA karane se? ve kaheMgeH kyoM nahIM? parantu, sidhda ho gayA yAtanA kA zabda, kAfiroM para|
kahA jAyegA ki praveza kara jAo naraka ke dvAroM meM, sadAvAsI hokara usameM| to burA hai ghamaMDiyoM kA nivAsa sthAna|

tathA bheja diye jAyeMge, jo loga Darate rahe apane pAlanahAra se, svarga kI ora jhuNDa banAkara| yahA~taka ki jaba ve A jAyeMge usake pAsa tathA khola diye jAyeMge usake dvAra aura kaheMge unase usake rakSakaH salAma hai tumapara, tuma prasanna raho| tuma praveza kara jAo usameM, sadAvAsI hokara|

tathA ve kaheMgeH saba prazaMsA allAha ke lie haiM, jisane saca kara dikhAyA hamase apanA vacana tathA hameM uttarAdhikArI banA diyA isa dharatI kA, hama raheM svarga meM, jahA~ cAheM| kyA hI acchA hai kAryakartAoM[1] kA pratiphala|

tathA Apa dekheMge fariztoM ko ghere hue arza (siMhAsana) ke caturdika, ve pavitratA gAna kara rahe hoMge apane pAlanahAra kI prazaMsA ke sAtha, nirNaya kara diyA jAyegA logoM ke bIca satya ke sAtha tathA kaha diyA jAyegA ki saba prazaMsA allAha, sarvaloka ke pAlanahAra ke lie hai|[1]
ha़A mIma|
isa pustaka kA utaranA allAha kI ora se hai, jo saba cIz2oM aura guNoM ko jAnane vAlA hai|
pApa kSamA karane, taubA svIkAra karane, kSamAyAcanA kA svIkArI, kar3I yAtanA dene vAlA, samAI vAlA, jisake sivA koI ( saccA) vaMdanIya nahIM| usI kI ora (sabako) jAnA hai|
nahIM jhagar3ate haiM allAha kI AyatoM meM unake sivA, jo kAfira ho gaye| ataH, dhokhe meM na DAla de Apako unakI yAtAyAta dezoM meM|

jhuThalAyA inase pUrva, nUha़ kI jAti ne tathA bahuta-se samudAyoM ne unake pazcAt tathA vicAra kiyA pratyeka samudAya ne apane rasUla ko baMdI banA lene kA tathA vivAda kiyA asatya ke sahAre, tAki asatya banA deM satya ko| to hamane unheM pakar3a liyA| phira kaisI rahI hamArI yAtanA?
aura isI prakAra, sidhda ho gaI Apake pAlanahAra kI bAta unapara, jo kAfira ho gaye ki vahI nArakI haiM|

ve (farizte) jo apane Upara uThAye hue haiM arza (siMhAsana) ko tathA jo usake Asa-pAsa haiM, ve pavitratA gAna karate rahate haiM apane pAlanahAra kI prazaMsA ke sAtha tathA usapara ImAna rakhate haiM aura kSamA yAcanA karate rahate haiM unake lie, jo ImAna lAye haiM|[1] he hamAre pAlanahAra! tUne ghera rakhA hai pratyeka vastu ko (apanI) dayA tathA jJAna se| ataH, kSamA kara de unako jo kSamA mA~geM tathA caleM tere mArga para tathA bacA le unheM, naraka kI yAtanA se|

he hamAre pAlanahAra! tathA praveza kara de unheM,una sthAyI svargoM meM, jinakA tUne unheM vacana diyA hai tathA jo sadAcArI haiM, unake pUrvajoM, patniyoM aura unakI saMtAnoM meM se| nizcaya tU saba cIz2oM aura guNoM ko jAnane vAlA hai|
tathA unheM surakSita rakha duSkarmoM se tathA tUne jise bacA liyA duSkarmoM se usa dina, to dayA kara dI usapara aura yahI bar3I saphalatA hai|

jina logoM ne kufra kiyA hai, unheM (pralaya ke dina) pukArA jAyegA ki allAha kA krodha tumapara usase adhika thA, jitanA tumheM Aja apane Upara krodha A rahA hai, jaba tuma saMsAra meM ImAna kI ora bulAye[1] jA rahe the|
ve kaheMgeH he hamAre pAlanahAra! tUne hameM do bAra mArA[1] tathA jIvita (bhI) do bAra kiyA| ataH, hamane mAna liyA apane pApoM ko| to kyA (yAtanA se) nikalane kI koI rAha (upAya) hai?

(ye yAtanA) isa kAraNa hai ki jaba tumheM (saMsAra meM) bulAyA gayA akele allAha kI ora, to tumane kufra kara diyA aura yadi zirka kiyA jAtA usake sAtha, to tuma mAna lete the| to Adeza dene kA adhikAra allAha ko hai, jo sarvocca, sarvamahAn hai|
vahI dikhAtA hai tumheM apanI nizAniyA~ tathA utAratA hai tumhAre lie AkAza se jIvikA aura zikSA grahaNa nahIM karatA, parantu vahI, jo (usakI ora) dhyAna karatA hai|
to tuma pukAro allAha ko zudhda karake usake lie dharma ko, yadyapi burA lage kAfiroM ko|
vaha ucca zreNiyoM vAlA arza kA svAmI hai| vaha utAratA hai apane Adeza se rUha़[1] (vaha़yI), jisapara cAhatA hai, apane bhaktoM meM se, tAki vaha saceta kare, milane ke dina se|
jisa dina saba loga (jIvita hokara) nikala par3eMge| nahIM chupI hogI allAha para unakI koI cIz2a| kisakA rAjya hai Aja?[1] akele prabhutvazAlI allAha kA|
Aja pratikAra diyA jAyegA pratyeka prANI ko, usake karatUta kA| koI atyAcAra nahIM hai Aja| vAstava meM, allAha ati zIghra ha़isAba lene vAlA hai|
tathA Apa sAvadhAna kara deM unheM AgAmI samIpa dina se, jaba dila mu~ha ko A rahe hoMge| loga zoka se bhare hoMge| nahIM hogA atyAcAriyoM kA koI mitra, na koI sifArizI, jisakI bAta mAnI jAye|
vaha jAnatA hai A~khoM kI corI tathA jo (bheda) sIne chupAte haiM|
allAha hI nirNaya karegA satya ke sAtha tathA jinheM ve pukArate haiM allAha ke atirikta, ve koI nirNaya nahIM kara sakate| nizcaya allAha hI bhalI-bhA~ti sunane-dekhane vAlA hai|

kyA vaha cale-phire nahIM dharatI meM, tAki dekhate ki kaisA rahA unakA pariNAma, jo inase pUrva the? ve inase adhika the bala meM tathA adhika cinha chor3a gaye dharatI meM| to pakar3a liyA allAha ne unheM unake pApoM ke kAraNa aura nahIM thA unake lie allAha se koI bacAne vAlA|
ye isa kAraNa huA ki unake pAsa lAte the hamAre rasUla khulI nizAniyA~, to unhoMne kufra kiyA| antataH, pakar3a liyA unheM allAha ne| vastutaH, vaha ati zaktizAlI, ghora yAtanA dene vAlA hai|
tathA hamane bhejA mUsA ko apanI nizAniyoM aura hara prakAra ke pramANa ke sAtha|
firaauna aura (usake maMtrI) hAmAna tathA qArUna ke pAsa| to unhoMne kahAH ye to bar3A jhUThA jAdUgara hai|

to jaba vaha unake pAsa satya lAyA hamArI ora se, to sabane kahAH vadha kara do unake putroM ko, jo ImAna loye haiM usake sAtha tathA jIvita rahane do unakI striyoM ko aura kAfiroM kA SaDyaMtra niSphala (vyartha) hI huA|[1]

aura kahA firaauna ne (apane pramukhoM seH) mujhe chor3o, maiM vadha kara dU~ mUsA ko aura use cAhiye ki pukAre apane pAlanahAra ko| vAstava meM, maiM DaratA hU~ ki vaha badala degA tumhAre dharma[1] ko athavA paidA kara degA isa dharatI (misra) meM upadrava|
tathA mUsA ne kahAH maiMne zaraNa lI hai apane pAlanahAra tathA tumhAre pAlanahAra kI pratyeka ahaMkArI se, jo ImAna nahIM rakhatA ha़isAba ke dina para|

tathA kahA eka ImAna vAle vyakti ne firaauna ke gharAne ke, jo chupA rahA thA apanA ImAnaH kyA tuma vadha kara doge eka vyakti ko ki vaha kaha rahA haiH merA pAlanahAra allAha hai? jabaki vaha tumhAre pAsa lAyA hai khulI nizAniyA~ tumhAre pAlanahAra kI ora se? aura yadi vaha jhUThA ho, to usI ke Upara hai unakA jhUTha aura yadi saccA ho, to A par3egA vaha kucha, jisakI tumheM dhamakI de rahA hai| vAstava meM, allAha mArgadarzana nahIM detA use, jo ullaMghanakArI bahuta jhUThA ho|

he merI jAti ke logo! tumhArA rAjya hai Aja, tuma prabhAvazAlI ho dharatI meM, to kauna hamArI rakSA karegA allAha kI yAtanA se, yadi vaha hamapara A jAye? firaauna ne kahAH maiM tuma saba ko vahI samajhA rahA hU~, jise maiM ucita samajhatA hU~ aura tumheM sIdhI hI rAha dikhA rahA hU~|
tathA usane kahA, jo ImAna lAyAH he merI jAti! maiM tumapara DaratA hU~ (agale) samudAyoM ke dina jaise (dina)[1] se|
nUha़ kI jAti kI jaisI dazA se tathA Ada aura samUda kI evaM jo unake pazcAt hue tathA allAha nahIM cAhatA koI atyAcAra bhaktoM ke lie|
tathA he merI jAti! maiM Dara rahA hU~ tumapara, eka-dUsare ko pukArane ke dina[1] se|

Apa kaha deM ki vaha unake lie, jo ImAna lAye, mArgadarzana tathA Arogyakara hai aura jo ImAna na lAyeM, unake kAnoM meM bojha hai aura vaha unapara aMdhApana hai aura vahI pukAre jA rahe haiM dUra sthAnoM se|[1]

tathA hama pradAna kara cuke haiM mUsA ko pustaka (taurAta)| to usameM bhI vibheda kiyA gayA aura yadi eka bAta pahale hI se nirdhArita na hotI[1] Apake pAlanahAra kI ora se, to nirNaya kara diyA jAtA unake bIca| niHsaMdeha, vaha unake viSaya meM saMdeha meM DA~vADola haiM|
jo sadAcAra karegA, to vaha apane hI lAbha ke lie karegA aura jo durAcAra karegA, to usakA duSpariNAma usIpara hogA aura ApakA pAlanahAra tanika bhI atyAcAra karane vAlA nahIM hai bhaktoM para|[1]

usI kI ora pherA jAtA hai pralaya kA jJAna tathA nahIM nikalate koI phala apane gAbhoM se aura nahIM garbha dhAraNa karatI koI mAdA aura na janma detI hai, parantu usake jJAna se aura jisa dina vaha pUkAregA unheM ki kahA~ haiM mere sAjhI? to ve kaheMge ki hamane tujhe batA diyA thA ki hamameM se koI usakA gavAha nahIM hai|
aura kho jAyeMge[1] unase ve, jinheM pukArate the isase pUrva tathA ve vizvAsa kara leMge ki nahIM hai unake lie koI zaraNa kA sthAna|
nahIM thakatA manuSya bhalAI (sukha) kI prArthanA se aura yadi use pahu~ca jAye burAI (duHkha), to (hatAza) nirAza[1] ho jAtA hai|

aura yadi hama use[1] cakhA deM apanI dayA, duHkha ke pazcAt, jo use pahu~cA ho, to avazya kaha detA hai ki maiM to isake yogya hI thA aura maiM nahIM samajhatA ki pralaya honI hai aura yadi maiM punaH apane pAlanahAra kI ora gayA, to nizcaya hI mere lie usake pAsa bhalAI hogI| to hama avazya avagata kara deMge kAfiroM ko unake karmoM se tathA unheM avazya ghora yAtanA cakhAyeMge|
tathA jaba hama upakAra karate haiM manuSya para, to vaha vimukha ho jAtA hai tathA akar3a jAtA hai aura jaba use duHkha pahu~ce, to lambI-caur3I prArthanA karane lagatA hai|
Apa kaha deM: bhalA tuma ye to batAo, yadi ye qurAna allAha kI ora se ho, fira tuma kufra kara jAo usake sAtha, to kauna usase adhika kupatha hogA, jo usake virodha meM dUra taka calA jAye?

hama zIghra hI dikhA deMge unheM apanI nizAniyA~ saMsAra ke kinAroM meM tathA svayaM unake bhItara| yahA~taka ki khula jAyegI unake lie ye bAta ki yahI saca hai[1] aura kyA ye bAta prayApta nahIM ki ApakA pAlanahAra hI pratyeka vastu kA sAkSI (gavAha) hai?
sAvadhAna! vahI saMdeha meM haiM, apane pAlanahAra se milane ke viSaya meM| sAvadhAna! vahI (allAha), pratyeka vastu ko ghere hue hai|
ha़A mIma|
aina sIna qAfa|
isI prakAra, (allAha) ne prakAzanA[1] bhejI hai Apa tathA una rasUloM kI ora, jo Apase pUrva hue haiM| allAha sabase prabala aura saba guNoM ko jAnane vAlA hai|
usI kA hai, jo AkAzoM tathA dharatI meM hai aura vaha bar3A ucca, mahAna hai|

samIpa hai ki AkAza phaTa[1] par3eM apane Upara se, jabaki farizte pavitratA kA gAna karate haiM apane pAlanahAra kI prazaMsA ke sAtha tathA kSamAyAcanA karate haiM unake lie, jo dharatI meM haiM| suno! vAstava meM, allAha hI atyaMta kSamA karane tathA dayA karane vAlA hai|
tathA jina logoM ne banA lie haiM allAha ke sivA saMrakSaka, allAha hI unapara nirIkSaka (nigarA~) hai aura Apa unake uttara dAyI[1] nahIM haiM|

tathA isI prakAra, hamane vaha़yI (prakAzanA) kI hai ApakI ora arabI qurAna kI| tAki Apa sAvadhAna kara deM makkA[1] vAsiyoM ko aura jo usake Asa-pAsa haiM tathA sAvadhAna kara deM ekatra hone ke dina[2] se, jisa dina ke hone meM koI saMzaya nahIM| eka pakSa svarga meM tathA eka pakSa naraka meM hogA|
aura yadi allAha cAhatA, to sabhI ko eka samudAya[1] banA detA| parantu, vaha praveza karAtA hai jise cAhe, apanI dayA meM tathA atyAcAriyoM kA koI saMrakSaka tathA sahAyaka na hogA|
kyA unhoMne banA lie haiM usake sivA saMrakSaka? to allAha hI saMrakSaka hai aura jIvita karegA murdoM ko aura vahI jo cAhe, kara sakatA hai|[1]
aura jisa bAta meM bhI tumane vibheda kiyA hai, usakA nirNaya allAha hI ko karanA hai|[1] vahI allAha merA pAlanahAra hai, usIpara maiMne bharosA kiyA hai tathA usI kI ora dhyAnamagna hotA hU~|

vaha AkAzoM tathA dharatI kA racayitA hai| usane banAye haiM tumhArI jAti meM se tumhAre jor3e tathA pazuoM ke jor3e| vaha phailA rahA hai tumheM isa prakAra| usakI koI pratimA[1] nahIM aura vaha saba kucha sunane-jAnane vAlA hai|
usI ke[1] adhikAra meM haiM AkAzoM tathA dharatI kI kuMjiyA~| vaha phailA detA hai jIvikA, jisake lie cAhe tathA nApa kara detA hai| vAstava meM, vahI pratyeka vastu kA jAnane vAlA hai|

usane niyata[1] kiyA hai tumhAre lie vahI dharma, jisakA Adeza diyA thA nUha़ ko aura jise vaha़yI kiyA hai ApakI ora tathA jisakA Adeza diyA thA ibrAhIma tathA mUsA aura IsA ko ki isa dharma kI sthApanA karo aura isameM bheda bhAva na karo| yahI bAta apriya lagI hai muzrikoM ko, jisakI ora Apa bulA rahe haiM| allAha hI cunatA hai isake lie jise cAhe aura sIdhI rAha usI ko dikhAtA hai, jo usI kI ora dhyAnamagna ho|

aura unhoMne[1] isake pazcAt hI vibheda kiyA, jaba unake pAsa jJAna A gayA, Apasa ke virodha ke kAraNa tathA yadi eka bAta pahale se nizcita[2] na hotI Apake pAlanahAra kI ora se, to avazya nirNaya kara diyA gayA hotA unake bIca aura jo pustaka ke uttarAdhikArI banAye[3] gaye unake pazcAt, usakI ora se saMdeha meM ulajhe hue haiM|

to Apa logoM ko isI dharma kI ora bulAte raheM tathA jaise Apako Adeza diyA gayA hai usapara sthita raheM aura unakI icchAoM para na caleM tathA kaha deM ki maiM ImAna lAyA una sabhI pustakoM para, jo allAha ne utArI[1] haiM tathA mUjhe Adeza diyA gayA hai ki tumhAre bIca nyAya karU~| allAha hamArA tathA tumhArA pAlanahAra hai| hamAre lie hamAre karma haiM tathA tumhAre lie tumhAre karma| hamAre aura tumhAre bIca koI jhagar3A nahIM| allAha hI hameM ekatra karegA tathA usI kI ora saba ko jAnA hai|[2]

tathA jo loga jhagar3ate haiM allAha (ke dharma ke bAre) meM, jabaki use[1] mAna liyA gayA hai| unakA vivAda (kutarka) asatya hai allAha ke samIpa tathA unhIM para krodha hai aura unhIM ke lie kar3I yAtanA hai|
allAha hI ne utArI haiM saba pustakeM satya ke sAtha tathA tarAjU[1] ko aura Apako kyA patA zAyada pralaya kA samaya samIpa ho|

zIghra mA~ga kara rahe haiM usa (pralaya) kI, jo ImAna nahIM rakhate usapara aura jo ImAna lAye haiM, ve usase Dara rahe haiM tathA vizvAsa rakhate haiM ki vaha saca hai| suno! nizcaya jo vivAda kara rahe haiM, pralaya ke viSaya meM, ve kupatha meM bahuta dUra cale gaye haiM|
allAha bar3A dayAlu hai apane bhaktoM para| vaha jIvikA pradAna karatA hai, jise cAhe tathA vaha bar3A prabala, prabhAvazAlI hai|

jo Aqhirata (paraloka) kI khetI[1] cAhatA ho, to hama usake lie usakI khetI bar3hA dete haiM aura jo saMsAra kI khetI cAhatA ho, to hama use usameM se kucha de dete haiM aura usake lie paraloka meM koI bhAga nahIM|

kyA ina (muzrikoM) ke kucha aise sAjhI[1] haiM, jinhoMne unake lie koI aisA dhArmika niyama banA diyA hai, jisakI anumati allAha ne nahIM dI hai? aura yadi nirNaya kI bAta nizcita na hotI, to (abhI) inake bIca nirNaya kara diyA jAtA tathA nizcaya atyAcAriyoM ke lie hI duHkhadAyI yAtanA hai|

tuma atyAcAriyoM ko Darate hue dekhogo una duSkarmoM ke kAraNa, jo unhoMne kiye haiM aura vaha unapara Akara rahegA tathA jo ImAna lAye aura sadAcAra kiye, ve svarga ke bAgoM meM hoMge| ve jisakI icchA kareMge unake pAlanahAra ke yahA~ milegA| ye bar3I dayA hai|

ye vaha (dayA) hai, jisakI zubha sUcanA detA hai allAha apane bhaktoM ko, jo ImAna lAye tathA sadAcAra kiye| Apa kaha deM ki maiM nahIM mA~gatA hU~ isapara tumase koI badalA, usa prema ke sivA, jo saMbandhiyoM[1] meM (hotA) hai|

kyA ve kahate haiM ki usane allAha para jhUTha ghar3a liyA hai? to yadi allAha cAhe, to Apake dila para muhara lagA de|[1] aura allAha miTA detA hai jhUTha ko aura saca ko apane AdezoM dvArA saca kara dikhAtA hai| vaha sInoM (diloM) ke bhedoM kA jAnane vAlA hai|
vahI hai, jo svIkAra karatA hai apane bhaktoM kI taubA tathA kSamA karatA hai doSoM[1] ko aura jAnatA hai, jo kucha tuma karate ho|
aura unakI prArthanA svIkAra karatA hai, jo ImAna lAye aura sadAcAra kiye tathA unheM adhika pradAna karatA hai apanI dayA se aura kAfiroM hI ke lie kar3I yAtanA hai|

aura yadi phailA detA allAha jIvikA apane bhaktoM ke lie, to ve vidroha[1] kara dete dharatI meM| parantu, vaha utAratA hai eka anumAna se jaise vaha cAhatA hai| vAstava meM, vaha apane bhaktoM se bhalI-bhA~ti sUcita hai| (tathA) unheM dekha rahA hai|
tathA vahI hai, jo varSA karatA hai isake pazcAt ki loga nirAza ho jAyeM tathA phailA[1] detA hai apanI dayA aura vahI saMrakSaka, sarAhanIya hai|
tathA usakI nizAniyoM meM se hai, AkAzoM aura dharatI kI utpatti tathA jo phailAyeM haiM una donoM meM jIva aura vaha unheM ekatra karane para jaba cAhe,[1] sAmarthya rakhane vAlA hai|
aura jo bhI duHkha tumheM pahu~catA hai, vaha tumhAre apane karatUta se pahucatA hai tathA vaha kSamA kara detA hai tumhAre bahuta-se pApoM ko|[1]
aura tuma vivaza karane vAle nahIM ho dharatI meM aura na tumhArA allAha ke sivA koI saMrakSaka aura na sahAyaka hai|
tathA usake (sAmarthya) kI nizAniyoM meM se haiM calatI huI nAva sAgaroM meM, parvatoM ke samAna|
yadi vaha cAhe, to roka de vAyu ko aura vaha khar3I raha jAyeM usake Upara| nizcaya isameM bar3I nizAniyA~ haiM pratyeka bar3e dhairyavAna[1] kRtajJa ke lie|
athavA vinAza[1] kara de una (nAvoM) kA, unake karatUtoM ke badale aura vaha kSamA karatA hai bahuta kucha|
tathA vaha jAnatA hai unheM, jo jhagar3ate haiM hamArI AyatoM meM| unhIM ke lie koI bhAgane kA sthAna nahIM hai|

tumheM jo kucha diyA gayA hai, vaha sAMsArika jIvana kA saMsAdhana hai tathA jo kucha allAha ke pAsa hai, vaha uttama aura sthAyI[1] hai unake lie, jo allAha para ImAna lAye tathA apane pAlanahAra hI para bharosA rakhate haiM|
tathA jo bacate haiM bar3e pApoM tathA nirlajjA ke karmoM se aura jaba krodha A jAye to kSamA kara dete haiM|

tathA jinhoMne apane pAlanahAra ke Adeza ko mAna liyA, sthApanA kI namAz2a kI aura unake pratyeka kArya Apasa ke vicAra-vimarza se hote haiM[1] aura jo kucha hamane unheM pradAna kiyA hai usameM se dAna karate haiM|
aura yadi unapara atyAcAra kiyA jAye, to ve barAbarI kA badalA lete haiM|

aura burAI kA pratikAra (badalA) burAI hai, usI jaisI|[1] phira jo kSamA kara de tathA sudhAra karale, to usakA pratiphala allAha ke Upara hai| vAstava meM, vaha prema nahIM karatA hai atyAcAriyoM se|
tathA jo badalA leM apane Upara atyAcAra hone ke pazcAt, to unapara koI doSa nahIM hai|
doSa kevala unapara hai, jo logoM para atyAcAra karate haiM aura nAha़qa z2amIna meM upadrava karate haiM| unhIM ke lie dardanAka yAtanA hai|
aura jo sahana kare tathA kSamA kara de, to ye nizcaya bar3e sAhasa[1] kA kArya hai|
tathA jise allAha kupatha kara de, to usakA koI rakSaka nahIM hai, usake pazcAta tathA Apa dekheMge atyAcAriyoM ko jaba ve dekheMge yAtanA ko, ve kaha rahe hoMgeH kyA vApasI kI koI rAha hai?[1]

tathA Apa unheM dekheMge ki ve prastuta kiye jA rahe haiM naraka para, sira jhukAye, apamAna ke kAraNa| ve dekha rahe hoMge kankhiyoM se tathA kaheMge jo ImAna lAye ki vAstava meM ghATe meM vahI haiM, jinhoMne ghATe meM DAla diyA svayaM ko tathA apane parivAra ko, pralaya ke dina| suno! atyAcArI hI sthAyI yAtanA meM hoMge|
tathA nahIM hoMge unake koI sahAyaka, jo allAha ke muqAbale meM unakI sahAyatA kareM aura jise kupatha kara de allAha, to usake lie koI mArga nahIM|

mAna lo apane pAlanahAra kI bAta, isase pUrva ki A jAye vaha dina, jise TalanA nahIM hai allAha kI ora se| nahIM hogA tumhAre lie koI zaraNa kA sthAna, usa dina aura na chipakara anajAna bana jAne kA|

phira bhI yadi ve vimukha hoM, to (he nabI!) hamane nahIM bhejA hai Apako unapara rakSaka banAkara| ApakA dAyitva kevala saMdeza pahu~cA denA hai aura vAstava meM, jaba hama cakhA dete haiM manuSya ko apanI dayA, to vaha itarAne lagatA hai, usapara aura yadi pahu~catA hai unheM koI duHkha, unake karatUta ke kAraNa, to manuSya bar3A kRtaghna bana jAtA hai|
allAha hI kA hai AkAzoM tathA dharatI kA rAjya| vaha paidA karatA hai, jo cAhatA hai| jise cAhe, putriyA~ pradAna karatA hai tathA jise cAhe, putra pradAna karatA hai|
athavA unheM putra aura[1] putriyA~ milAkara detA hai aura jise cAhe, bA~jha banA detA hai| vAstava meM, vaha saba kucha jAnane vAlA (tathA) sAmarthya rakhane vAlA hai|

aura nahIM saMbhava hai kisI manuSya ke lie ki bAta kare allAha usase, parantu vaha़yI[1] dvArA, athavA parde ke pIche se athavA bheja de koI rasUla (fariztA), jo vaha़yI kare usakI anumati se, jo kucha vaha cAhatA ho| vAstava meM, vaha sabase U~cA (tathA) sabhI guNa jAnane vAlA hai|

aura isI prakAra, hamane vaha़yI (prakAzanA) kI hai, ApakI ora, apane Adeza kI rUha़ (qurAna)| Apa nahIM jAnate the ki pustaka kyA hai aura ImAna[1] kyA hai| parantu, hamane ise banA diyA eka jyoti| hama mArga dikhAte haiM isake dvArA, jise cAhate haiM apane bhaktoM meM se aura vastutaH, Apa sIdhI rAha[1] dikhA rahe haiM|
allAha kI rAha, jisake adhikAra meM hai, jo kucha AkAzoM meM tathA jo kucha dharatI meM hai| sAvadhAna! allAha hI kI ora phirate haiM, sabhI kArya|
