zapatha hai pratyakSa (khulI) pustaka kI|
ise hamane banAyA hai arabI qurAna, tAki ve ise samajha sakeM|
tathA vaha mUla pustaka[1] meM hai, hamAre pAsa, bar3A ucca tathA jJAna se paripUrNa hai|
to kyA hama phera deM, isa zikSA ko, tumase, isalie ki tuma ullaMghanakArI loga ho?
tathA hamane bheje haiM bahuta-se nabI (guz2arI huyI) jAtiyoM meM|
aura nahIM AtA rahA unake pAsa koI nabI, parantu ve usake sAtha upahAsa karate rahe|
to hamane vinAza kara diyA inase[1] adhika zaktivAnoM kA tathA g2uz2ara cukA hai agaloM kA udAharaNa|
aura yadi Apa prazna kareM unase ki kisane paidA kiyA hai AkAzoM tathA dharatI ko? to avazya kaheMgeH unheM paidA kiyA hai bar3e prabhAvazAlI, saba kucha jAnane vAle ne|
jisane banAyA tumahAre lie dharatI ko pAlanA aura banAye usameM tumhAre lie mArga, tAki tuma mArga pA sako|[1]
tathA jisane utArA AkAza se jala, eka vizeSa mAtrA meM| phira jIvita kara diyA usake davArA murdA bhUmi ko| isI prakAra, tuma (dharatI se) nikAle jAoge|
tathA jisane paidA kiye saba prakAra ke jor3e tathA banAIM tumhAre lie naukAyeM tathA pazu jinapara tuma savAra hote ho|

tAki tuma savAra ho unake Upara, phira yAda karo apane pAlanahAra ke pradAna ko, jaba savAra ho jAo usapara aura ye[1] kahoH pavitra hai vaha, jisane vaza meM kara diyA hamAre lie ise| anyathA hama ise vaza meM nahIM kara sakate the|
tathA hama avazya hI apane pAlanahAra hI kI ora phirakara jAne vAle haiM|
aura banA liyA unhoMne[1] usake bhaktoM meM se kucha ko usakA aMza| vAstava meM, manuSya khulA kRtaghna hai|
kyA allAha ne usameM se, jo paidA karatA hai, putriyA~ banA lI haiM tathA tumheM vizeSa kara diyA hai putroM ke sAtha?
jabaki unameM se kisI ko zubha sUcanA dI jAye usa (ke janma lene) kI, jisakA usane udAharaNa diyA hai atyaMta kRpAzIla ke lie, to usakA mukha kAlA[1] ho jAtA hai aura zoka se bhara jAtA hai|
kyA (allAha ke lie) vaha hai, jisakA pAlanapoSaNa AbhUSaNa meM kiyA jAtA hai tathA vaha vivAda meM khulakara bAta nahIM kara sakatI?
aura unhoMne banA diyA fariztoM ko, jo atyaMta kRpAzIla ke bhakta haiM, putriyA~| kyA ve upasthita the unakI utpatti ke samaya? likha lI jAyegI unakI gavAhI aura unase pUcha hogI|
tathA unhoMne kahA ki yadi atyaMta kRpAzIla cAhatA, to hama unakI ibAdata nahIM karate| unheM isakA koI jJAna nahIM| vaha kevala tIra-tukke calA rahe haiM|
kyA hamane unheM pradAna kI hai koI pustaka isase pahale, jise ve dRr3hatA se pakar3e hue haiM?[1]
balki, ye kahate haiM ki hamane pAyA hai apane pUrvajoM ko eka rIti para aura hama unhIM ke padcinhoM para cala rahe haiM|

tathA (he nabI!) isI prakAra, hamane nahIM bhejI Apase pUrva kisI bastI meM koI sAvadhAna karane vAlA, parantu kahA usake sukhI logoM neH hamane pAyA hai apane pUrvajoM ko eka rIti para aura hama nizcaya unhIM ke padcinhoM para cala rahe haiM|[1]

nabI ne kahAH kyA (tuma unhIM kA anugamana karoge) yadpi maiM lAyA hU~ tumhAre pAsa usase adhika sIdhA mArga, jisapara tumane pAyA hai apane pUrvajoM ko? to unhoMne kahAH hama, jisa (dharma) ke sAtha tuma bheje gaye ho, use mAnane vAle nahIM hai|
antataH, hamane badalA cukA liyA unase| to dekho ki kaisA rahA jhuThalAne vAloM kA duSpariNAma|
tathA yAda karo, jaba kahA ibrAhIma ne apane pitA tathA apanI jAti seH nizcaya maiM virakta hU~ usase, jisakI vaMdanA tuma karate ho|
usake atirikta, jisane mujhe paidA kiyA hai| vahI mujhe rAha dikhAyegA|
tathA chor3a gayA vaha isa bAta (ekezvaravAda) ko[1] apanI saMtAna meM, tAki ve zirka se bacate raheM|
balki, maiMne inheM tathA inake bApa-dAdA ko jIvana kA sAmAna diyA| yahA~ taka ki A gayA unake pAsa satya (qurAna) aura eka khulA rasUla|[1]
tathA jaba A gayA unake pAsa satya, to unhoMne kaha diyA ki ye jAdU hai tathA hama, ise mAnane vAle nahIM haiM|

vahI haiM, svIkAra kara leMge hama jinase, unake sarvottama karmoM ko tathA kSamA kara deMge, unake duSkarmoM ko| (ve) svarga vAsiyoM meM se haiM, usa satya vacana ke anusAra, jo unase kiyA jAtA thA|

tathA pratyeka ke lie zreNiyA~ haiM, unake karmAnusAra aura unheM bharapUra badalA diyA jAyegA unake karmoM kA tathA unapara atyAcAra nahIM kiyA jAyegA|

aura jisa dina sAmane lAye jAyeMge, jo kAfira ho gaye, agni ke| (unase kahA jAyegAH) tuma le cuke apanA Annada apane sAMsArika jIvana meM aura lAbhAnvita ho cuke unase| to Aja tumheM apamAna kI yAtanA dI jAyegI usake badale, jo tuma ghamaMDa karate rahe dharatI meM anucita tathA usake badale, jo ullaMghana karate rahe|

tathA hama dhvasta kara cuke haiM tumhAre Asa-pAsa kI bastiyoM ko tathA hamane unheM aneka prakAra se AyateM sunA dIM, tAki ve vApasa A jAyeM|

to kyoM nahIM sahAyatA kI unakI, unhoMne jinheM banAyA thA allAha ke atirikta (allAha ke) sAmIpya ke lie pUjya (upAsya)? balki ve kho gaye unasa aura ye[1] unakA jhUTha thA tathA jise svayaM ve ghar3a rahe the|

unhoMne kahAH he hamArI jAti! hamane sUnI hai eka pustaka, jo utArI gayI hai musA ke pazcAt| vaha apane se pUrva kI kitAboM kI puSTi karatI hai aura satya tathA sIdhI rAha dikhAtI hai|

Apane kahAH mUjhe sUcita kiyA hai saba jAnane aura sabase sUcita rahane vAle ne|

tathA maryama, imarAna kI putrI kA, jisane rakSA kI apane satItva kI, to phU~ka dI hamane usameM apanI ora se rUha़ (AtmA) tathA usa (maryama) ne saca mAnA apane pAlanahAra kI bAtoM aura usakI pustakoM ko aura vaha ibAdata karane vAloM meM se thI|
